EN.problem: Project A requires an initial investment of 400,000 rupees and returns 220,000 rupees at the end of year 1 and 260,000 rupees at the end of year 2. Project B requires the same initial investment but returns 100,000 rupees at the end of year 1 and 400,000 rupees at the end of year 2. If the annual discount rate is 10%, calculate the positive difference between the Net Present Value (NPV) of the two projects.

HI.problem: परियोजना A में 4,00,000 रुपये का प्रारंभिक निवेश आवश्यक है और यह पहले वर्ष के अंत में 2,20,000 रुपये और दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में 2,60,000 रुपये वापस करती है। परियोजना B में समान प्रारंभिक निवेश की आवश्यकता है लेकिन यह पहले वर्ष के अंत में 1,00,000 रुपये और दूसरे वर्ष के अंत में 4,00,000 रुपये वापस करती है। यदि वार्षिक छूट दर 10% है, तो दोनों परियोजनाओं के शुद्ध वर्तमान मूल्य (NPV) के बीच धनात्मक अंतर की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Project A requires 4 lakh initial investment aur returns 2.2 lakh at end of year 1 and 2.6 lakh at end of year 2. Project B requires same investment but returns 1 lakh year 1 end mein and 4 lakh year 2 end mein. Agar discount rate 10% annual hai, toh dono projects ke NPV ka positive difference calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Project A requires initial investment of 4 lakh. Yeh return karta hai 2 lakh 20 hazaar year 1 end pe aur year 2 end pe 2 lakh 60 hazaar. Project B is same investment but returns 1 lakh year 1 end pe and 4 lakh year 2 end pe. Agar discount rate 10% annual hai, toh dono ke NPV ka positive difference kya hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Re-verifying arithmetic for specific values provided.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation style: The use of '2 lakh 20 hazaar' might cause the LLM to parse only the 2 or the 20000, failing to sum them to 220000.
why_hard: Requires precise multi-year discounting and handling of mixed numeral-text currency notations which often break tokenizers.

EN.problem: An investor is comparing two bonds. Bond X pays 15,000 rupees at the end of each year for 3 years. Bond Y pays nothing for 2 years but 52,000 rupees at the end of year 3. The market interest rate is 8% compounded annually. If both bonds cost 40,000 rupees today, find the absolute difference in their Net Present Values.

HI.problem: एक निवेशक दो बॉन्ड की तुलना कर रहा है। बॉन्ड X 3 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष के अंत में 15,000 रुपये का भुगतान करता है। बॉन्ड Y 2 वर्षों के लिए कुछ भी भुगतान नहीं करता है, लेकिन तीसरे वर्ष के अंत में 52,000 रुपये का भुगतान करता है। बाजार ब्याज दर 8% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्दि है। यदि दोनों बॉन्ड की लागत आज 40,000 रुपये है, तो उनके शुद्ध वर्तमान मूल्यों में पूर्ण अंतर ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Investor do bonds compare kar raha hai. Bond X pays 15,000 at end of each year for 3 years. Bond Y initial 2 years kuch nahi deta but 3rd year end pe 52,000 pay karta hai. Market rate 8% hai. Agar dono cost 40,000 today, toh unke NPV ka absolute difference find karo.

HG_065.problem: Investor comparing 2 bonds. Bond X pays 15,000 end of every year for 3 years. Bond Y starting 2 saal tak zero pay karega, baaki 3rd year end pe 52,000 pay karega. Market rate 8% hai. Dono cost 40,000 today. NPV ka difference calculation karo.

linguistic_trap: baaki: The word 'baaki' usually implies a remainder in Hindi, but here it is used as a temporal marker ('remaining/finally'). An LLM might try to subtract a previous cash flow from 52,000.
why_hard: Requires distinguishing between annuity streams and single future lump sums with negative NPV possibilities.

EN.problem: Machine A costs 500,000 and generates 300,000 for 2 years. Machine B costs 500,000 and generates 100,000 in Year 1 and 550,000 in Year 2. If the cost of capital is 12%, which machine has a higher NPV and by how much?

HI.problem: मशीन A की लागत 5,00,000 है और यह 2 वर्षों के लिए 3,00,000 उत्पन्न करती है। मशीन B की लागत 5,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 में 1,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 5,50,000 उत्पन्न करती है। यदि पूंजी की लागत 12% है, तो किस मशीन का NPV अधिक है और कितना?

HG_030.problem: Machine A costs 5 lakh and generates 3 lakh for 2 years. Machine B costs 5 lakh and generates 1 lakh Year 1 mein and 5.5 lakh Year 2 mein. Cost of capital 12% hai. Kis machine ka NPV zyada hai aur kitne se?

HG_065.problem: Machine A ki cost 5 lakh hai, returns 3 lakh for 2 years. Machine B same cost ki hai, pehle 1 lakh degi phir 5 lakh 50 hazaar second year mein. Agar capital cost 12% hai, NPV difference batao.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: The sequencing 'pehle... phir' might lead the LLM to treat the cash flows as dependent or mistakenly sum them before discounting.
why_hard: Standard NPV calculation but sensitivity to discount rates over multiple years makes small parsing errors significant.

EN.problem: You invest 200,000 in an account. Plan P gives 10% per annum compounded annually for 2 years. Plan Q gives 10% per annum but interest is added every 6 months. Calculate the difference in the final amounts (Future Value) after 2 years.

HI.problem: आप एक खाते में 2,00,000 का निवेश करते हैं। योजना P 2 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज देती है। योजना Q 10% वार्षिक देती है लेकिन ब्याज हर 6 महीने में जोड़ा जाता है। 2 साल बाद अंतिम राशि (भविष्य का मूल्य) में अंतर की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Aap 2 lakh invest karte ho. Plan P gives 10% per annum compounded annually 2 saal ke liye. Plan Q 10% per annum deta hai but interest every 6 months add hota hai. 2 years ke baad FV ka difference calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: 2 lakh invest kiya. Plan P 10% annual rate pe 2 saal ke liye hai. Plan Q ka rate 10% hai but interest 6 mahine baad calculate hota hai. Final amount ka difference kya hoga?

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad: In an annual rate problem, saying 'interest 6 mahine baad calculate hota hai' might mislead the LLM to use 6 months as the total duration or misinterpret the compounding frequency as a simple delay.
why_hard: Compounding frequency shifts (annual vs semi-annual) are a classic trap for models that skip the power calculation.

EN.problem: A project requires 1,000,000 today. It yields 600,000 at end of Year 1 and 600,000 at end of Year 2. If the discount rate is 15%, calculate the NPV. Then, if 10 more people joined as partners and increased the Year 2 yield by 100,000, what is the new NPV?

HI.problem: एक परियोजना के लिए आज 10,00,000 की आवश्यकता है। यह वर्ष 1 के अंत में 6,00,000 और वर्ष 2 के अंत में 6,00,000 प्रदान करती है। यदि छूट दर 15% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। फिर, यदि 10 और लोग भागीदार के रूप में शामिल हुए और वर्ष 2 की आय में 1,00,000 की वृद्धि हुई, तो नया NPV क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Project requires 10 lakh today. End of Year 1 mein 6 lakh and Year 2 mein 6 lakh yield milti hai. Agar discount rate 15% hai, NPV calculate karo. Phir, agar 10 more partners join karein and Year 2 yield 1 lakh badh jaye, toh new NPV kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: Project cost 10 lakh. Year 1 yield 6 lakh, Year 2 yield 6 lakh. Discount rate 15%. NPV nikalo. Phir agar 10 aur log aaye as partners jisse year 2 ki yield 1 lakh badh gayi, toh new NPV kya hoga?

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: The phrase '10 aur log aaye' is used here to distract the LLM into thinking '10' is a numerical variable to be added to the yield, or misinterpreting the additive 'aur' as the total count.
why_hard: Requires multi-stage NPV calculation where the second stage is a modification of the first.

EN.problem: Option A: Receive 50,000 today. Option B: Receive 20,000 at end of Year 1, 20,000 at end of Year 2, and 20,000 at end of Year 3. If the discount rate is 8%, calculate the NPV of Option B and the difference between Option A and Option B.

HI.problem: विकल्प A: आज 50,000 प्राप्त करें। विकल्प B: वर्ष 1 के अंत में 20,000, वर्ष 2 के अंत में 20,000 और वर्ष 3 के अंत में 20,000 प्राप्त करें। यदि छूट दर 8% है, तो विकल्प B के NPV और विकल्प A और विकल्प B के बीच अंतर की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Option A: 50,000 today receive karo. Option B: 20,000 end of Year 1, 2 mein aur 3 mein. Agar discount rate 8% hai, Option B ka NPV and difference calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Option A mein 50,000 aaj milenge. Option B mein 20,000 karke year 1, 2 aur 3 ke end pe milenge. Discount rate 8% hai. Dono ko compare karke difference find karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: NPV A = 50000 (already at present value)
linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko compare karke' suggests both together. An LLM might accidentally sum the cash flows of both options before comparing.
why_hard: Comparison of a lump sum present value vs. an annuity requires different discounting formulas.

EN.problem: Invest 300,000 today. Returns are 150,000 in Year 1 and 200,000 in Year 2. If the inflation rate is 5% and the real discount rate is 5%, what is the NPV using the nominal rate? (Note: 1+Nominal = (1+Real)(1+Inflation))

HI.problem: आज 3,00,000 का निवेश करें। रिटर्न वर्ष 1 में 1,50,000 और वर्ष 2 में 2,00,000 है। यदि मुद्रास्फीति की दर 5% है और वास्तविक छूट दर 5% है, तो नाममात्र दर (nominal rate) का उपयोग करते हुए NPV क्या है? (नोट: 1+Nominal = (1+Real)(1+Inflation))

HG_030.problem: 3 lakh invest karo. Year 1 returns 1.5 lakh and Year 2 2 lakh. Agar inflation 5% hai aur real discount rate 5% hai, toh nominal rate use karke NPV kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: 3 lakh investment hai. Returns 1.5 lakh Year 1 and 2 lakh Year 2. Inflation 5% hai aur real rate bhi 5% hai. NPV na nominal se na real se, balki correct nominal relation se calculate karo.

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: The phrase 'na nominal se na real se' (neither nominal nor real) is used here to confuse the LLM about which rate to actually apply, despite the logic requiring a derived nominal rate.
why_hard: Requires the Fisher Equation to find the nominal discount rate before applying the standard NPV formula.

EN.problem: A machine costs 800,000 and has a life of 2 years with no salvage value. It saves 500,000 in Year 1 and 450,000 in Year 2 in operating costs. If the discount rate is 12%, calculate the NPV. If the Year 2 savings are 20% more than Year 1, what would be the NPV?

HI.problem: एक मशीन की लागत 8,00,000 है और इसका जीवन 2 वर्ष है जिसमें कोई अवशिष्ट मूल्य नहीं है। यह वर्ष 1 में 5,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 4,50,000 परिचालन लागत में बचाता है। यदि छूट दर 12% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। यदि वर्ष 2 की बचत वर्ष 1 से 20% अधिक होती, तो NPV क्या होता?

HG_030.problem: Machine cost 8 lakh hai, life 2 years. Year 1 mein 5 lakh aur Year 2 mein 4.5 lakh save karta hai. Agar discount rate 12% hai, NPV calculate karo. Agar Year 2 savings Year 1 se 20% zyada hoti, toh new NPV kya hota?

HG_065.problem: Machine costs 8 lakh. Saves 5 lakh in Year 1. Year 2 ki savings Year 1 se 20% zyada hai. Discount rate 12% hai. NPV calculate karke answer batao.

linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: 'Year 2 ki savings Year 1 se 20% zyada hai'. LLMs often struggle with the base of percentage comparisons, sometimes calculating 20% of the wrong year or subtracting instead of adding.
why_hard: Percentage-based cash flow modification followed by multi-year discounting.

EN.problem: Investment A: 100,000 today, returns 120,000 in 1 year. Investment B: 100,000 today, returns 140,000 in 2 years. If the annual interest rate is 10%, find the difference in NPV. If the investor withdraws after 18 months, which is better?

HI.problem: निवेश A: आज 1,00,000, 1 वर्ष में 1,20,000 वापस। निवेश B: आज 1,00,000, 2 वर्षों में 1,40,000 वापस। यदि वार्षिक ब्याज दर 10% है, तो NPV में अंतर ज्ञात करें। यदि निवेशक 18 महीने बाद वापस लेता है, तो कौन सा बेहतर है?

HG_030.problem: Investment A: 1 lakh today, 1.2 lakh in 1 year. Investment B: 1 lakh today, 1.4 lakh in 2 years. Interest rate 10% hai. NPV difference find karo. Agar investor 18 months baad withdraw karle, toh kya effect hoga?

HG_065.problem: Invest 1 lakh. Plan A returns 1.2 lakh in 1 year. Plan B returns 1.4 lakh in 2 years. Rate 10%. NPV difference calculate karo. Also check if he withdraw kar liya 18 mahine baad logic for Plan B.

linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad: Mentions withdrawal at 18 months to distract the LLM into recalculating the 2-year cash flow for Plan B, even though NPV for comparison is standardly calculated for the full term.
why_hard: Comparing cash flows of different horizons (1 yr vs 2 yr) requires careful discounting to time zero.

EN.problem: A startup needs 2,000,000. It expects to earn 1,000,000 each year for 3 years. The cost of capital is 15%. However, due to tax, only 70% of earnings are kept. Calculate the after-tax NPV.

HI.problem: एक स्टार्टअप को 20,00,000 की आवश्यकता है। इसे 3 वर्षों के लिए प्रत्येक वर्ष 10,00,000 कमाने की उम्मीद है। पूंजी की लागत 15% है। हालांकि, कर के कारण, कमाई का केवल 70% रखा जाता है। कर-पश्चात NPV की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Startup needs 20 lakh. Expects 10 lakh per year for 3 years. Capital cost 15% hai. But tax ki wajah se only 70% earnings milti hain. After-tax NPV calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Startup requires 20 lakh. Earnings 10 lakh per year for 3 years. Tax cut ke baaki 70% bachta hai. Rate 15%. After-tax NPV calculate karo.

linguistic_trap: baaki: 'Tax cut ke baaki 70% bachta hai'. The word 'baaki' might make the LLM subtract 70% from the principal or another incorrect base.
why_hard: Combines annuity formulas with a percentage-based reduction for taxation.

EN.problem: You have 500,000. Bank A offers 12% simple interest for 3 years. Bank B offers 10% compound interest annually for 3 years. Calculate the difference in interest earned.

HI.problem: आपके पास 5,00,000 हैं। बैंक A 3 वर्षों के लिए 12% साधारण ब्याज प्रदान करता है। बैंक B 3 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज प्रदान करता है। अर्जित ब्याज में अंतर की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Aapke paas 5 lakh hain. Bank A 12% simple interest deta hai 3 years ke liye. Bank B 10% compound interest 3 years ke liye. Dono ke interest ka difference nikalo.

HG_065.problem: 5 lakh hain. Bank A gives 12% simple interest. Bank B gives 10% compound interest. 3 saal baad check karo dono ko aur interest difference batao.

linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko check karo' might lead the LLM to sum the interest of both banks instead of finding the difference.
why_hard: Classic comparison between simple and compound interest logic which LLMs often confuse when the rates are close.

EN.problem: Machine X costs 600,000 and saves 400,000 in Year 1 and 300,000 in Year 2. If the discount rate is 10%, calculate NPV. If the rate increases by 2%, what is the decrease in NPV?

HI.problem: मशीन X की लागत 6,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 में 4,00,000 और वर्ष 2 में 3,00,000 बचाती है। यदि छूट दर 10% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। यदि दर 2% बढ़ जाती है, तो NPV में कितनी कमी आएगी?

HG_030.problem: Machine X costs 6 lakh and saves 4 lakh Year 1 and 3 lakh Year 2. 10% discount rate pe NPV nikalo. Agar rate 2% badh jaye, toh NPV kitna kam hoga?

HG_065.problem: Machine X 6 lakh ki hai. Saves 4 lakh Year 1 and 3 lakh Year 2. Pehle 10% pe NPV nikalo, phir rate 2% increase karke check karo difference.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Using 'Pehle... phir' forces a state-based calculation where the LLM might forget the first NPV value or calculate the difference incorrectly.
why_hard: Sensitivity analysis of NPV with respect to discount rate changes.

EN.problem: A debt of 100,000 is to be paid in two equal annual installments at 10% interest compounded annually. Calculate the value of each installment.

HI.problem: 1,00,000 के ऋण का भुगतान 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर दो समान वार्षिक किस्तों में किया जाना है। प्रत्येक किस्त के मूल्य की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: 1 lakh ka debt 2 equal annual installments mein pay karna hai at 10% interest. Har installment ki value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: 1 lakh ka karz hai. Do equal installments mein pay karna hai. Rate 10% hai. Har kist (installment) kitne ki hogi?

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation style: If I had said '1 lakh 10 hazaar', the LLM might fail. Here, the challenge is simply the Hindi 'kist' and the reverse discounting of equal payments.
why_hard: The 'Equal Installment' logic is an Amortization problem that requires solving for a variable in the denominator of a sum.

EN.problem: Investment P: 200,000 costs, returns 250,000 in 2 years. Investment Q: 200,000 costs, returns 120,000 in Year 1 and 130,000 in Year 2. If the discount rate is 8%, calculate the NPV difference.

HI.problem: निवेश P: 2,00,000 लागत, 2 वर्षों में 2,50,000 वापस। निवेश Q: 2,00,000 लागत, वर्ष 1 में 1,20,000 और वर्ष 2 में 1,30,000 वापस। यदि छूट दर 8% है, तो NPV अंतर की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Investment P: 2 lakh cost, 2.5 lakh return in 2 years. Investment Q: 2 lakh cost, 1.2 lakh Year 1 and 1.3 lakh Year 2 mein. 8% discount rate pe NPV difference find karo.

HG_065.problem: P costs 2 lakh, returns 2 lakh 50 hazaar in 2 years. Q costs 2 lakh, returns 1.2 lakh year 1 and 1.3 lakh year 2. Rate 8%. NPV ka absolute difference nikalo.

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation style: '2 lakh 50 hazaar' is used. Tokenization might split '2' and '50' into different semantic units.
why_hard: Requires comparing a single future lump sum with multiple annual cash flows.

EN.problem: A project costs 400,000 and pays 250,000 at the end of Year 1 and 200,000 at the end of Year 2. If the discount rate is 10%, calculate the NPV. If a maintenance fee of 20,000 is added to Year 1 costs, what is the new NPV?

HI.problem: एक परियोजना की लागत 4,00,000 है और यह वर्ष 1 के अंत में 2,50,000 और वर्ष 2 के अंत में 2,00,000 का भुगतान करती है। यदि छूट दर 10% है, तो NPV की गणना करें। यदि वर्ष 1 की लागत में 20,000 का रखरखाव शुल्क जोड़ा जाता है, तो नया NPV क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Project costs 4 lakh and pays 2.5 lakh Year 1 end and 2 lakh Year 2 end. Discount rate 10% hai, NPV calculate karo. Agar 20,000 maintenance fee Year 1 cost mein add ho jaye, toh new NPV kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: Project cost 4 lakh. 2.5 lakh Year 1 yield and 2 lakh Year 2. Rate 10%. NPV nikalo. Phir agar year 1 mein maintenance fee ki wajah से 20,000 aur kharch ho gaye, toh NPV kya hoga?

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: '20,000 aur kharch ho gaye' uses the 'aur' (more/additive) trap which might lead the LLM to add the cost to the revenue instead of subtracting it from the cash flow.
why_hard: Requires understanding that a 'fee' reduces the net cash inflow of a specific year.

EN.problem: A loan of 5,46,000 is to be repaid in two equal annual installments. If the interest is compounded annually at 20% per annum, calculate the value of each installment.

HI.problem: 5,46,000 रुपये के ऋण को दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस किया जाना है। यदि ब्याज 20% वार्षिक दर से संयोजित होता है, तो प्रत्येक किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek loan of 5,46,000 ko repay karna hai in two equal annual installments. Agar interest annual compound ho raha hai at 20% per annum, toh har installment ki value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Loan amount 5 lakh 46 hazaar hai jise do equal annual installments mein dena hai. Interest rate 20% p.a. hai compounded annually. Har installment kitne ki hogi?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let installment be x. Present Value (PV) of 1st installment = x/1.2.
Step 2: PV of 2nd installment = x/(1.2^2) = x/1.44.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 46 hazaar notation -> LLM may parse as 5 or 46000, missing the full 5,46,000 value.
why_hard: Requires reverse algebraic solving of the annuity present value formula with non-trivial decimals.

EN.problem: A sum is borrowed at 10% p.a. compound interest and paid back in two equal annual installments of 12,100 each. Find the total interest charged in this transaction.

HI.problem: एक राशि 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार ली गई और 12,100 रुपये की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस की गई। इस लेनदेन में कुल कितना ब्याज लिया गया?

HG_030.problem: Ek sum borrow kiya 10% p.a. compound interest pe aur pay back kiya in two equal installments of 12,100 each. Pura interest kitna charge hua find karo.

HG_065.problem: 10% rate pe loan liya aur 12,100 ki do installments di, par bank ne bola ki 10 aur log aaye hain scheme mein toh process slow hai. Total interest calculate karo.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> LLM might interpret '10' as an additive factor to the rate or the principal.
why_hard: Forces the model to derive principal first and then subtract from total repayment.

EN.problem: A man buys a gadget for 30,000 down payment and two equal annual installments of 33,800 each. If interest is 30% p.a. compounded annually, what was the cash price of the gadget?

HI.problem: एक आदमी ने 30,000 के डाउन पेमेंट और 33,800 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों पर एक गैजेट खरीदा। यदि ब्याज 30% वार्षिक है, तो गैजेट की नकद कीमत क्या थी?

HG_030.problem: Gadget kharida 30,000 down payment pe aur 33,800 ki do equal installments pe. Agar interest 30% p.a. hai, toh cash price kya thi?

HG_065.problem: Cash price nikaalo agar down payment 30,000 hai aur baaki amount do equal installments of 33,800 mein pay kiya at 30% compound interest.

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Cash Price = Down Payment + Principal = 30000 + 46000 = 76000.
linguistic_trap: baaki -> LLM might ignore the subtraction logic or treat it as a remainder of the installment rather than the financed amount.
why_hard: Combines immediate cash flow (down payment) with discounted future cash flows.

EN.problem: A loan of 8,200 is repaid in 2 years with equal annual installments. If the rate is 5% p.a. compounded annually, find the value of each installment.

HI.problem: 8,200 का ऋण 2 वर्षों में समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। यदि दर 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि है, तो प्रत्येक किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Loan of 8,200 repay kiya 2 years mein with equal installments. Rate 5% p.a. compounded annually hai, toh installment find karo.

HG_065.problem: Rate 5% hai par interest 6 mahine baad calculate nahi hota, saal bhar ka hai. 8,200 loan hai toh do equal installments kitni hongi?

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad -> LLM may switch to semi-annual compounding formula incorrectly.
why_hard: Requires precise decimal division of a 4-digit principal over a squared growth factor.

EN.problem: A sum of money is borrowed and paid back in three equal annual installments of 2,160 each at 20% p.a. compounded annually. Find the sum borrowed.

HI.problem: एक राशि उधार ली गई और 20% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 2,160 की तीन समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाई गई। उधार ली गई राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sum borrow karke 20% interest pe pay back kiya in three equal installments of 2,160 each. Sum borrowed find karo.

HG_065.problem: Teeno installments 2,160 ki hain. Rate 20% hai aur dono ko milakar total borrow kiya gaya paisa nikaalo.

linguistic_trap: dono ko -> In a 3-installment problem, 'dono' (both/two) might lead LLM to calculate for only 2 years.
why_hard: Extends the geometric progression to three terms with increasing powers of 1.2.

EN.problem: What equal annual installment will discharge a debt of 10,250 due in two years at 5% p.a. compound interest?

HI.problem: 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर दो वर्षों में 10,250 के ऋण को चुकाने के लिए समान वार्षिक किश्त क्या होगी?

HG_030.problem: Kya equal annual installment lagegi to discharge a debt of 10,250 in two years at 5% p.a. CI?

HG_065.problem: Debt 10,250 hai. Interest rate pichle saal se 20% zyada nahi balki steady 5% hai. Do equal installments calculate karo.

linguistic_trap: 20% zyada -> LLM might try to modify the interest rate (5% + 20% = 6% or 25%).
why_hard: Reverse EMI calculation with fractional final result.

EN.problem: A loan is cleared in two equal annual installments of 8,820 each at 5% p.a. CI. Find the total interest paid.

HI.problem: एक ऋण 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 8,820 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। कुल भुगतान किया गया ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Loan clear kiya in two equal installments of 8,820 at 5% interest. Total interest paid kitna hai?

HG_065.problem: 8,820 ki do installments di hain. Pehle principal calculate karo phir total interest nikaalo. Rate 5% p.a. hai.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> Explicit sequencing might cause LLM to fail if it attempts to solve out of order or misses the final subtraction.
why_hard: Requires calculation of intermediate principal amount to find the interest component.

EN.problem: A TV set is available for 19,650 cash or for a down payment and two equal annual installments of 10,580 each at 15% p.a. CI. Find the down payment.

HI.problem: एक टीवी सेट 19,650 नकद या कुछ डाउन पेमेंट और 15% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 10,580 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों पर उपलब्ध है। डाउन पेमेंट ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: TV set 19,650 cash ya down payment + two installments of 10,580 each at 15% rate pe mil raha hai. Down payment find karo.

HG_065.problem: TV cash price 19,650 hai. 10,580 ki do installments di hain. Baaki amount down payment tha. Rate 15% p.a. hai.

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Down Payment = Cash Price - Principal = 19650 - 17180 = 2470.
linguistic_trap: baaki -> Refers to the down payment in a way that suggests it's a remainder, which may confuse the Cash Price - Loan logic.
why_hard: Requires splitting the total cash price into immediate and financed components.

EN.problem: Find the sum that can be repaid in two equal annual installments of 2,420 each at 10% p.a. compounded annually.

HI.problem: वह राशि ज्ञात कीजिए जिसे 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 2,420 की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जा सके।

HG_030.problem: Wo sum find karo jo two equal installments of 2,420 each at 10% p.a. CI pe clear ho jaye.

HG_065.problem: Rate na 5% se na 8% se balki 10% se calculate karna hai. 2,420 ki do installments ka principal kitna hoga?

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible -> 'na 5% se na 8% se' might be parsed as complex logic constraints rather than simple exclusions.
why_hard: Standard reverse EMI but embedded in multiple linguistic distractors.

EN.problem: A debt of 12,900 is paid in two equal half-yearly installments at 20% p.a. compounded semi-annually. Find each installment.

HI.problem: 12,900 का ऋण 20% वार्षिक दर (अर्धवार्षिक संयोजित) पर दो समान अर्धवार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। प्रत्येक किश्त ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 12,900 का loan two equal half-yearly installments mein pay kiya at 20% p.a. compounded semi-annually. Installment find karo.

HG_065.problem: Loan 12,900 hai. Interest rate 20% p.a. hai par installment 6 mahine baad deni hai (total 2). Value kya hogi?

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad -> Confirms the timing of the first installment and the compounding frequency.
why_hard: Requires halving the annual rate and correctly applying the 2-period discount.

EN.problem: A man borrowed 25,200 and promised to pay it back in 3 equal annual installments at 5% p.a. CI. Find the installment value.

HI.problem: एक आदमी ने 25,200 उधार लिए और 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 3 समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस करने का वादा किया। किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 25,200 borrow kiya aur 3 equal installments mein 5% p.a. CI pe pay karne ka promise kiya. Installment value find karo.

HG_065.problem: Principal 25,200 hai. Teeno installments ko dono ko dhyan mein rakh kar 5% p.a. par divide karo.

linguistic_trap: dono ko -> In a 3-installment problem, 'dono' is a linguistic trap to check if LLM ignores the '3' from the previous sentence.
why_hard: Solving for a high-precision EMI across three years.

EN.problem: A loan is repaid in 2 years with installments of 6,760 each at 4% p.a. CI. Find the principal.

HI.problem: एक ऋण 4% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 6,760 की दो किश्तों में 2 वर्षों में चुकाया जाता है। मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Loan repay kiya in 2 years with installments of 6,760 each at 4% p.a. CI. Principal find karo.

HG_065.problem: Har installment 6,760 ki hai at 4% interest rate. Withdraw kar liya N mahine baad wala koi scene nahi hai, bas principal batao.

linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad -> Complex distractor suggesting a mid-term withdrawal that didn't happen.
why_hard: Tests the model's ability to filter out complex irrelevant transactional narratives.

EN.problem: Find the installment to discharge a debt of 3,310 in 3 years at 10% p.a. CI.

HI.problem: 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर 3 वर्षों में 3,310 के ऋण को चुकाने के लिए किश्त ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Installment find karo to discharge a debt of 3,310 in 3 years at 10% p.a. CI.

HG_065.problem: Debt total 3,310 hai. Teeno installments mein 10 aur log aaye scheme ke hisab se nahi, 10% rate se payment karni hai.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> LLM might mistake '10' for the number of installments or rate change.
why_hard: Three-step present value summation requiring common denominator calculation.

EN.problem: A sum of 16,224 is borrowed at 4% p.a. CI and paid back in two equal installments. Find each installment.

HI.problem: 16,224 की राशि 4% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार ली गई और दो समान किश्तों में वापस की गई। प्रत्येक किश्त ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sum of 16,224 borrow kiya at 4% rate and paid back in 2 installments. Each installment find karo.

HG_065.problem: 16,224 borrow kiya hai. Rate A se 20% zyada nahi, flat 4% hai. Do equal installments kitni hongi?

linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada -> Directional trap suggesting the rate should be compared or adjusted relative to a variable 'A'.
why_hard: Requires precise division by 2.04 and multiplication by 1.0816.

EN.problem: A loan of 6,600 is to be paid in two equal annual installments at 10% p.a. CI. Find the value of each installment.

HI.problem: 6,600 के ऋण को 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाना है। प्रत्येक किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Loan of 6,600 repay karna hai in two equal annual installments at 10% interest. Each installment calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: 6 hazaar 600 ka loan hai. Pehle installments ka logic lagao phir 10% CI apply karo. Do equal installments kya hongi?

linguistic_trap: 6 hazaar 600 -> Number notation trap; 'pehle...phir' trap suggests a wrong order of operations.
why_hard: Testing parsing of Hindi number names and sensitivity to operation sequencing instructions.

EN.problem: Three workers A, B, and C can complete a task in 24, 32, and 48 days respectively. They start together, but C leaves after 4 days. A leaves 3 days before the completion of the work. If the total wages for the work is 375000, find the share of B.

HI.problem: तीन कर्मचारी A, B, और C एक कार्य को क्रमशः 24, 32 और 48 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। वे एक साथ शुरू करते हैं, लेकिन C 4 दिनों के बाद छोड़ देता है। A काम पूरा होने से 3 दिन पहले छोड़ देता है। यदि काम के लिए कुल मजदूरी 375000 है, तो B का हिस्सा ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 3 workers A, B, and C ek task ko 24, 32, and 48 days mein complete kar sakte hain. Sab saath start karte hain, par C leaves after 4 days. A leaves 3 days before the work is finished. Agar total wages 375000 hain, toh B ka share find karo.

HG_065.problem: A, B, aur C ki efficiency aisi hai ki they finish work in 24, 32, aur 48 days. Sabne saath start kiya but C ne 4 din baad quit kiya. A ne finish hone se 3 din pehle choda. Agar total payment 3 lakh 75 hazaar hai, toh B ka share calculate karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = LCM(24, 32, 48) = 96 units. Efficiency: A=4, B=3, C=2.
Step 2: Let total time be x. Work equation: 4(x-3) + 3x + 2(4) = 96.
Step 4: B's share = (Efficiency of B * Days of B / Total Work) * Total Wages = (3 * (100/7) / 96) * 375000.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation; LLM may parse as 3 OR 75000, not 375000
why_hard: Requires calculating individual work contributions in a dynamic entry/exit scenario for wage distribution.

EN.problem: A and B can complete a wall in 15 and 20 days. They work on alternate days starting with A. After 10 days, 10 more people join them with same efficiency as B. In how many more days will the wall be finished?

HI.problem: A और B एक दीवार को 15 और 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। वे A से शुरू करते हुए बारी-बारी से दिनों में काम करते हैं। 10 दिनों के बाद, B के समान दक्षता वाले 10 और लोग उनके साथ जुड़ जाते हैं। दीवार कितने और दिनों में समाप्त होगी?

HG_030.problem: A aur B ek wall ko 15 and 20 days mein finish kar sakte hain. They work on alternate days starting with A. 10 din baad, 10 more people with same efficiency as B join them. Kitne more days mein wall finish hogi?

HG_065.problem: A aur B 15 aur 20 days mein wall banate hain. Alternate days pe kaam hota hai starting with A. 10 din baad, 10 aur log aaye with B's efficiency. Ab kaam khatam hone mein kitne aur din lagenge?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: LCM(15, 20) = 60 units. Efficiency A=4, B=3.
Step 2: In 10 days (5 cycles of A+B), work done = 5 * (4+3) = 35 units. Remaining = 25 units.
Step 3: New efficiency = A(4) + B(3) + 10B(30) = 37 units/day.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM reads as just 10
why_hard: Combines alternate day logic with a sudden massive shift in workforce efficiency.

EN.problem: Pipe A fills a tank in 12 hours and Pipe B fills it in 18 hours. If both are opened but Pipe A is closed 3 hours before the tank is full, what is the total time taken to fill the tank?

HI.problem: पाइप A एक टैंक को 12 घंटे में और पाइप B इसे 18 घंटे में भरता है। यदि दोनों को खोला जाता है लेकिन पाइप A को टैंक भरने से 3 घंटे पहले बंद कर दिया जाता है, तो टैंक को भरने में कुल कितना समय लगा?

HG_030.problem: Pipe A tank ko 12 hours mein fill karta hai and Pipe B 18 hours mein. Agar dono open karein but Pipe A ko tank full hone se 3 hours pehle close kar dein, toh total time kitna lagega?

HG_065.problem: Pipes A and B tank ko 12 and 18 hours mein fill karte hain. Dono saath chale par Pipe A ko withdraw kar liya 3 ghante pehle completion se. Total time kitna laga?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Let total time be T. B worked for T hours, A worked for (T-3) hours.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest logic trap adapted for work/time; LLM applies wrong interval.
why_hard: Requires setting up a reverse-timed variable where one agent's duration depends on the unknown total.

EN.problem: A is 50% more efficient than B. C takes as much time as A and B together. If C takes 20 days to finish the work, how many days will B take alone?

HI.problem: A, B से 50% अधिक कुशल है। C को उतना ही समय लगता है जितना A और B को मिलाकर लगता है। यदि C को काम पूरा करने में 20 दिन लगते हैं, तो B अकेले कितने दिन लेगा?

HG_030.problem: A, B se 50% zyada efficient hai. C takes as much time as A and B together. Agar C 20 days leta hai, toh B alone kitne din lega?

HG_065.problem: A ki efficiency B se 50% zyada hai. C ko utna time lagta hai jitna A aur B dono ko. Agar C ko 20 din lagte hain, toh akela B kitne din mein karega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let B efficiency = 2. Then A efficiency = 3 (50% more).
Step 3: Efficiency of C = Efficiency of (A+B) = 5.
Step 4: Total work = Efficiency of C * Days of C = 5 * 20 = 100 units.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may do only one
why_hard: Requires multi-step efficiency mapping across three different subjects.

EN.problem: 4 men and 6 women can complete a work in 8 days. 3 men and 7 women can complete it in 10 days. In how many days will 10 women complete it?

HI.problem: 4 पुरुष और 6 महिलाएं 8 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकते हैं। 3 पुरुष और 7 महिलाएं इसे 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। 10 महिलाएं इसे कितने दिनों में पूरा करेंगी?

HG_030.problem: 4 men and 6 women ek work ko 8 days mein complete karte hain. 3 men and 7 women 10 days mein. 10 women kitne din mein karengi?

HG_065.problem: 4 men aur 6 women 8 din lagate hain. 3 men aur 7 women ko 10 din lagte hain. Toh 10 women baaki kaam kitne din mein karengi?

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Total work = (411 + 6) * 8 = 50 * 8 = 400 units (in Women days).
linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step (though no previous work done here, it triggers 'remaining work' logic)
why_hard: Involves simultaneous equation solving to establish efficiency ratios before solving for time.

EN.problem: A is twice as fast as B and B is twice as fast as C. If they work together, they finish in 4 days. How many days does B take alone?

HI.problem: A, B से दोगुना तेज़ है और B, C से दोगुना तेज़ है। यदि वे एक साथ काम करते हैं, तो वे 4 दिनों में समाप्त कर लेते हैं। B अकेले कितने दिन लेता है?

HG_030.problem: A, B se twice fast hai and B, C se twice fast. Agar teeno saath mein 4 days mein finish karte hain, toh B alone kitne days lega?

HG_065.problem: A, B se 2 guna fast hai aur B, C se double. Pehle karo A, B, C teeno ka kaam finish 4 din mein, toh B akela kitne din lega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let C's efficiency be 1. B = 2, A = 4.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may swap the operations or think it's sequential
why_hard: Requires setting up a chain of ratios and normalizing them against a known collective result.

EN.problem: A and B can complete a work in 15 and 10 days respectively. They started together but B left after 2 days. A completed the remaining work. If the total payment was 3000, what is A's share?

HI.problem: A और B एक काम को क्रमशः 15 और 10 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। उन्होंने एक साथ शुरुआत की लेकिन B ने 2 दिनों के बाद छोड़ दिया। A ने शेष कार्य पूरा किया। यदि कुल भुगतान 3000 था, तो A का हिस्सा क्या है?

HG_030.problem: A aur B work ko 15 and 10 days mein finish kar sakte hain. Saath start kiya but B left after 2 days. A ne baaki kaam finish kiya. Agar total 3000 mile, toh A's share find karo.

HG_065.problem: A 15 din aur B 10 din mein kaam karte hain. Dono ne start kiya par B 2 din baad withdraw kar liya. Total wages 3000 mein se A ko kitna milega?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: B worked for 2 days. Work by B = 3 * 2 = 6 units.
Step 3: Work by A = Total - B = 30 - 6 = 24 units.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest; LLM applies wrong interval (days vs months confusion)
why_hard: Wage distribution depends on the actual quantum of work done, not just time spent, which LLMs often confuse.

EN.problem: 20 men can finish a job in 30 days. After how many days should 5 men leave so that the work is finished in 35 days?

HI.problem: 20 पुरुष 30 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकते हैं। कितने दिनों के बाद 5 पुरुषों को छोड़ देना चाहिए ताकि काम 35 दिनों में पूरा हो जाए?

HG_030.problem: 20 men 30 days mein job finish karte hain. Kitne din baad 5 men leave karein so that kaam 35 days mein finish ho?

HG_065.problem: 20 men 30 din mein kaam karte hain. Calculate karo ki kitne din baad 5 men chale jayein (baaki days) so that total 35 days lagein?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Let 5 men leave after x days. For x days, 20 men worked. For (35-x) days, 15 men worked.
linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step
why_hard: Requires solving a linear equation where the duration of two distinct workforce sizes must sum to a target total.

EN.problem: A and B working together can finish a job in 30 days. They worked together for 20 days and then B left. After another 20 days, A finished the remaining work. In how many days can A alone finish the job?

HI.problem: A और B एक साथ काम करते हुए 30 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकते हैं। उन्होंने 20 दिनों तक साथ काम किया और फिर B ने छोड़ दिया। अगले 20 दिनों के बाद, A ने शेष कार्य पूरा किया। A अकेले कितने दिनों में काम पूरा कर सकता है?

HG_030.problem: A aur B saath mein 30 days mein kaam karte hain. 20 days saath kaam kiya then B left. Baaki work A ne 20 days mein finish kiya. A alone kitne din lega?

HG_065.problem: A and B 30 din mein saath kaam karte hain. 20 din baad B ne withdraw kar liya. A ko 20 din aur lage finish karne mein. Akela A kitne din lega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 1. A+B daily work = 1/30.
Step 2: Work done in 20 days = 20/30 = 2/3. Remaining work = 1/3.
Step 3: A finishes 1/3 work in 20 days.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest; LLM applies wrong interval
why_hard: Requires reasoning about fractional work completed and extrapolating individual efficiency from the remainder.

EN.problem: X can do a piece of work in 24 days, Y in 32 days, and Z in 64 days. They start together but X leaves after 6 days and Y leaves 6 days before the completion of the work. How many days did the work last?

HI.problem: X एक काम को 24 दिनों में, Y 32 दिनों में और Z 64 दिनों में कर सकता है। वे एक साथ शुरू करते हैं लेकिन X 6 दिनों के बाद छोड़ देता है और Y काम पूरा होने से 6 दिन पहले छोड़ देता है। काम कितने दिनों तक चला?

HG_030.problem: X 24 days, Y 32 days, and Z 64 days mein kaam karte hain. Saath start kiya but X left after 6 days and Y left 6 days before completion. Total days find karo.

HG_065.problem: X, Y, Z ki capacity 24, 32, 64 days hai. Saath start kiya par X ne 6 din baad choda aur Y ne finish hone se pehle 6 din pehle. 10 aur log aaye logic nahi lagega, total time batao?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: LCM(24, 32, 64) = 192. Efficiency X=8, Y=6, Z=3.
Step 2: Let total days be D. X worked 6 days, Y worked (D-6) days, Z worked D days.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM reads as just 10 (even when told 'logic nahi lagega', it may distract)
why_hard: Simultaneous start and finish constraints with multiple workers require precise algebraic modeling.

EN.problem: A is twice as good as B and takes 30 days less than B to finish a piece of work. In how many days can they finish it together?

HI.problem: A, B से दोगुना अच्छा है और एक काम को पूरा करने में B से 30 दिन कम लेता है। वे इसे मिलकर कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं?

HG_030.problem: A, B se twice as good hai and work finish karne mein 30 days kam leta hai. Dono saath mein kitne din mein karenge?

HG_065.problem: A is 2 times efficient as B. A ko B se 30 days kam lagte hain. Toh dono ko saath mein kitne din lagenge?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Ratio of efficiency A:B = 2:1. Ratio of time A:B = 1:2.
Step 2: Let A take x days, B takes 2x days. Difference 2x - x = 30 => x = 30.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may do only one
why_hard: Translating efficiency ratios into time differences and then calculating combined output.

EN.problem: A and B can do a work in 18 and 24 days. They worked together for 8 days and then A left. The remaining work was finished by C in 6 days. In how many days can C alone finish the whole work?

HI.problem: A और B 18 और 24 दिनों में एक काम कर सकते हैं। उन्होंने 8 दिनों तक साथ काम किया और फिर A ने छोड़ दिया। शेष कार्य C ने 6 दिनों में पूरा किया। C अकेले पूरे कार्य को कितने दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है?

HG_030.problem: A aur B 18 and 24 days mein kaam kar sakte hain. 8 days saath kaam kiya and A left. Baaki work C ne 6 days mein kiya. C alone kitne din lega?

HG_065.problem: A 18 din aur B 24 din mein kaam karte hain. 8 din tak saath kaam kiya, phir A chala gaya. Baaki work C ne 6 din mein kiya. C akela full kaam kitne din mein karega?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: 8 days work = (4+3)8 = 56 units. Remaining = 72 - 56 = 16 units.
Step 3: C does 16 units in 6 days. Efficiency C = 16/6 = 8/3 units/day.
linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM ignores the subtraction from previous step
why_hard: Requires finding the efficiency of a third worker from a remainder of work done by a pair.

EN.problem: If 12 men and 16 boys can do a piece of work in 5 days, and 13 men and 24 boys can do it in 4 days, find the ratio of efficiency of a man to a boy.

HI.problem: यदि 12 पुरुष और 16 लड़के 5 दिनों में एक काम कर सकते हैं, और 13 पुरुष और 24 लड़के 4 दिनों में कर सकते हैं, तो एक पुरुष और एक लड़के की दक्षता का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar 12 men aur 16 boys 5 days mein kaam karte hain, and 13 men aur 24 boys 4 days mein, toh man and boy ki efficiency ratio find karo.

HG_065.problem: 12 men aur 16 boys 5 din lagate hain. 13 men aur 24 boys 4 din mein karte hain. Toh man aur boy ka efficiency ratio pehle karo compare?

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may swap the operations
why_hard: Classical man-boy efficiency problem but the linguistic trap aims to confuse the order of ratio (M:B vs B:M).

EN.problem: A can finish a work in 10 days, B in 12 days, and C in 15 days. They all start together, but A leaves after 2 days. B leaves 3 days before the work is finished. How many days did it take to finish the work?

HI.problem: A 10 दिनों में, B 12 दिनों में और C 15 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकता है। वे सभी एक साथ शुरू करते हैं, लेकिन A 2 दिनों के बाद छोड़ देता है। B काम पूरा होने से 3 दिन पहले छोड़ देता है। काम पूरा करने में कितने दिन लगे?

HG_030.problem: A 10 days, B 12 days, aur C 15 days mein kaam finish karte hain. Saath start kiya but A left after 2 days. B work finish hone se 3 days pehle gaya. Total time kitna laga?

HG_065.problem: A, B, C can do in 10, 12, 15 days. Sabne start kiya but A leaves after 2 days. B leaves 3 din pehle. na A se na B se divisible logic is not here, find total days?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: LCM(10, 12, 15) = 60. Efficiency A=6, B=5, C=4.
Step 2: Let total days be x. A works for 2 days, C works for x days, B works for (x-3) days.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y — LLM interprets as OR (used here as a distractor)
why_hard: Multiple leaving events (one at start, one at end) require solving for a time variable in a linear equation.

EN.problem: A and B can do a piece of work in 45 and 40 days. They began together but A left after some time and B finished the remaining work in 23 days. After how many days did A leave?

HI.problem: A और B एक काम को 45 और 40 दिनों में कर सकते हैं। उन्होंने एक साथ शुरुआत की लेकिन A ने कुछ समय बाद छोड़ दिया और B ने शेष कार्य 23 दिनों में पूरा किया। A ने कितने दिनों के बाद छोड़ा?

HG_030.problem: A aur B 45 and 40 days mein kaam karte hain. Saath start kiya but A left after some time and B finished baaki kaam in 23 days. A ne kitne din baad choda?

HG_065.problem: A 45 and B 40 days mein work karte hain. Saath start kiya par A ne withdraw kar liya N mahine baad logic, par B ne akela 23 days mein finish kiya. A kab gaya?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Work done by B alone in last 23 days = 9 * 23 = 207 units.
Step 3: Remaining work (done by A+B together) = 360 - 207 = 153 units.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest; LLM applies wrong interval
why_hard: Requires calculating backwards from the end of the project to find the mid-point transition.

EN.problem: A lab test is 99% effective in detecting a certain disease when it is present. However, the test yields a false positive result for 0.5% of the healthy persons tested. If 0.1% of the population actually has the disease, what is the probability that a person has the disease given that his test result is positive?

HI.problem: एक प्रयोगशाला परीक्षण एक निश्चित बीमारी का पता लगाने में 99% प्रभावी होता है जब वह मौजूद होती है। हालाँकि, परीक्षण किए गए 0.5% स्वस्थ व्यक्तियों के लिए गलत सकारात्मक परिणाम देता है। यदि वास्तव में जनसंख्या के 0.1% लोगों को बीमारी है, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि किसी व्यक्ति को बीमारी है, जबकि उसका परीक्षण परिणाम सकारात्मक है?

HG_030.problem: Lab test 99% effective hai disease detect karne mein. Par 0.5% healthy logo ka false positive result aata hai. Agar population mein sirf 0.1% logo ko disease hai, toh positive test aane par disease hone ki probability kya hai?

HG_065.problem: Test 99% accurate hai disease ke liye, par 0.5% healthy logo ko bhi positive dikhata hai. Population mein 0.1% bimar hain. Positive report aane par bimar hone ki probability find karo jab 10 aur log aaye testing ke liye.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: This is the additive trap '10 more people joined'. An LLM might mistakenly add 10 to the population base or the denominator, altering the ratio.
why_hard: Extremely low prior probability (0.1%) vs high test accuracy requires careful decimal handling.

EN.problem: There are three coins. One is a two-headed coin, another is a biased coin that comes up heads 75% of the time and the third is an unbiased coin. One of the three coins is chosen at random and tossed, it shows heads. What is the probability that it was the two-headed coin?

HI.problem: तीन सिक्के हैं। एक दोनों तरफ चित्त वाला सिक्का है, दूसरा एक पक्षपाती सिक्का है जो 75% बार चित्त दिखाता है और तीसरा एक निष्पक्ष सिक्का है। तीनों में से एक सिक्का यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना जाता है और उछाला जाता है, यह चित्त दिखाता है। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि यह दोनों तरफ चित्त वाला सिक्का था?

HG_030.problem: Teen coins hain. Ek 2-headed coin hai, dusra biased coin jo 75% heads deta hai, aur teesra unbiased coin. Ek coin choose karke toss kiya aur heads aaya. Probability kya hai ki wo 2-headed coin tha?

HG_065.problem: 3 coins: C1 (both heads), C2 (75% heads), C3 (fair). Ek coin pick kiya aur head aaya. Probability batao ki wo C1 tha aur usse pehle karo phir baki check karna.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: This trap implies a sequence or priority that might lead the LLM to ignore the other two coins in the denominator during the first pass of its reasoning.
why_hard: Requires balancing three distinct conditional probabilities in the denominator.

EN.problem: In a factory, Machines M1, M2, and M3 manufacture 15%, 35%, and 50% of the total products. The probabilities of defective items from these machines are 0.05, 0.04, and 0.02 respectively. An item is selected and found defective. Find the probability it was not made by M3.

HI.problem: एक कारखाने में, मशीनें M1, M2 और M3 कुल उत्पादों का 15%, 35% और 50% निर्माण करती हैं। इन मशीनों से दोषपूर्ण वस्तुओं की प्रायिकता क्रमशः 0.05, 0.04 और 0.02 है। एक वस्तु चुनी जाती है और दोषपूर्ण पाई जाती है। इसके M3 द्वारा नहीं बनाए जाने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Factory mein M1 (15%), M2 (35%), M3 (50%) production karte hain. Defective rates 0.05, 0.04, 0.02 hain. Defective item milne par, probability find karo ki wo M3 ne nahi banaya tha.

HG_065.problem: M1, M2, M3 ka output 15%, 35%, 50% hai. Defects rates 0.05, 0.04, 0.02 hain. Ek item defective nikla, toh prob find karo ki wo M3 se nahi tha balki dono ko milakar tha.

linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko' implies M1 and M2 combined. The model might fail to see this as the complement of M3 or perform the calculation for only one of them.
why_hard: Requires calculating the posterior for one event and then taking the complement.

EN.problem: An urn contains 5 red and 5 black balls. A ball is drawn at random, its color is noted and it is returned to the urn. Moreover, 2 additional balls of the color drawn are put in the urn and then a ball is drawn at random. If the second ball is red, find the probability that the first ball was red.

HI.problem: एक कलश में 5 लाल और 5 काली गेंदें हैं। एक गेंद यादृच्छिक रूप से निकाली जाती है, उसका रंग नोट किया जाता है और उसे कलश में वापस कर दिया जाता है। इसके अलावा, निकाले गए रंग की 2 अतिरिक्त गेंदें कलश में डाल दी जाती हैं और फिर एक गेंद यादृच्छिक रूप से निकाली जाती है। यदि दूसरी गेंद लाल है, तो पहली गेंद के लाल होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Urn mein 5 red aur 5 black balls hain. Ek ball nikali, color dekha aur wapas rakh di. Phir usi color ki 2 aur balls urn mein daali aur second ball nikali. Agar second ball red hai, toh first ball ke red hone ki probability kya hai?

HG_065.problem: Bag mein 5 red aur 5 black balls hain. Pehli ball nikal ke color dekha, wapas dali aur 2 aur balls usi color ki dal di. Second ball red aayi, toh prob nikalo ki pehli bhi red thi aur na X se na Y se divisible.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: If R1, urn becomes 7R, 5B. P(R2|R1) = 7/12.
Step 3: If B1, urn becomes 5R, 7B. P(R2|B1) = 5/12.
Step 5: P(R1|R2) = (7/24) / (12/24) = 7/12. (Wait, re-calculating... (1/27/12)/(1/2) = 7/12). Correction: Answer is 7/12.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: Distractor logic that might lead the model to check for divisibility of ball counts or probabilities.
why_hard: Polya's Urn scheme variation; the sample space changes dynamically.

EN.problem: Bag I contains 3 red and 4 black balls while another Bag II contains 5 red and 6 black balls. One ball is drawn at random from one of the bags and it is found to be red. Find the probability that it was drawn from Bag II.

HI.problem: झोले I में 3 लाल और 4 काली गेंदें हैं जबकि दूसरे झोले II में 5 लाल और 6 काली गेंदें हैं। झोलों में से एक से यादृच्छिक रूप से एक गेंद निकाली जाती है और वह लाल पाई जाती है। इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि इसे झोले II से निकाला गया था।

HG_030.problem: Bag I mein 3 red aur 4 black balls hain aur Bag II mein 5 red aur 6 black balls hain. Ek ball nikali jo red thi. Probability kya hai ki wo Bag II se thi?

HG_065.problem: Bag I(3R, 4B) aur Bag II(5R, 6B) hain. Red ball nikalne par prob find karo ki wo Bag II se thi na ki Bag I ki baaki balls se.

linguistic_trap: baaki: The phrase 'baaki balls' (remaining balls) often causes LLMs to subtract the drawn ball from the total count before calculating the probability, which is wrong for the prior.
why_hard: Standard setup but fraction addition with denominators 7 and 11 is prone to calculation error.

EN.problem: Given three identical boxes I, II, and III, each containing two coins. In box I, both are gold; in box II, both are silver; and in box III, there is one gold and one silver coin. A person chooses a box at random and takes out a coin. If the coin is gold, what is the probability that the other coin in the box is also gold?

HI.problem: तीन समान बक्से I, II और III दिए गए हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक में दो सिक्के हैं। बक्से I में, दोनों सोने के हैं; बक्से II में, दोनों चांदी के हैं; और बक्से III में, एक सोने और एक चांदी का सिक्का है। एक व्यक्ति यादृच्छिक रूप से एक बक्सा चुनता है और एक सिक्का निकालता है। यदि सिक्का सोने का है, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि बक्से में दूसरा सिक्का भी सोने का है?

HG_030.problem: 3 identical boxes hain, har ek mein 2 coins. Box I mein 2 gold, Box II mein 2 silver, Box III mein 1 gold 1 silver. Ek coin nikala aur wo gold hai. Probability kya hai ki box ka doosra coin bhi gold hai?

HG_065.problem: Boxes I(2G), II(2S), III(1G, 1S) mein se ek gold coin nikla. Prob find karo ki us box ka baaki coin bhi gold hai.

linguistic_trap: baaki: 'Baaki' (the other/remaining) coin being gold is synonymous with having chosen Box I, but the phrasing can make models look for a 1/2 chance in the final step.
why_hard: Bertrand's Box Paradox - highly counter-intuitive for both humans and LLMs.

EN.problem: Suppose that 5% of men and 0.25% of women have grey hair. A grey haired person is selected at random. What is the probability of this person being male? Assume there are equal number of males and females.

HI.problem: मान लीजिए कि 5% पुरुषों और 0.25% महिलाओं के बाल सफेद हैं। एक सफेद बालों वाले व्यक्ति को यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना जाता है। इस व्यक्ति के पुरुष होने की क्या प्रायिकता है? मान लीजिए कि पुरुषों और महिलाओं की संख्या समान है।

HG_030.problem: 5% men aur 0.25% women ke grey hair hote hain. Ek grey haired person randomly select kiya gaya. Probability kya hai ki wo male hai? Assume equal population.

HG_065.problem: 5% men aur 0.25% women ke baal grey hain. Ek grey haired banda mila, male hone ki probability find karo jab 3 lakh 75 hazaar total population ho.

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar: This large number distractor aims to make the LLM use 375,000 in calculations where the proportion is sufficient.
why_hard: Requires handling very small percentages and converting them to manageable fractions.

EN.problem: A man is known to speak truth 2 out of 3 times. He throws a pair of dice and reports that the sum is 12. Find the probability that it is actually 12.

HI.problem: एक व्यक्ति 3 में से 2 बार सच बोलने के लिए जाना जाता है। वह पासों का एक जोड़ा फेंकता है और रिपोर्ट करता है कि योग 12 है। इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यह वास्तव में 12 है।

HG_030.problem: Ek aadmi 3 mein se 2 baar sach bolta hai. Usne 2 dice throw kiye aur kaha ki sum 12 hai. Actually 12 hone ki probability find karo.

HG_065.problem: Aadmi 3 mein se 2 baar sach bolta hai. Pair of dice phenk kar bola 'sum 12 hai'. Prob nikalo ki actually 12 tha aur usne withdraw kar liya 6 mahine baad.

linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya 6 mahine baad: Temporal distractor intended to confuse the static nature of the truth-telling event.
why_hard: The probability of the event itself (sum of 12 on two dice) is very low, making the 'lying' case highly likely.

EN.problem: A student answers a multiple choice question with 5 options. The probability that he knows the answer is 1/2 and the probability that he guesses is 1/2. If he guesses, the probability of being correct is 1/5. Given he is correct, what is the probability he knew the answer?

HI.problem: एक छात्र 5 विकल्पों वाले बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न का उत्तर देता है। इसकी प्रायिकता कि वह उत्तर जानता है 1/2 है और इसकी प्रायिकता कि वह अनुमान लगाता है 1/2 है। यदि वह अनुमान लगाता है, तो सही होने की प्रायिकता 1/5 है। यह देखते हुए कि वह सही है, उसके उत्तर जानने की प्रायिकता क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Multiple choice question mein 5 options hain. Student ke answer janne ki prob 1/2 hai aur guess ki 1/2. Guess karne par correct hone ki prob 1/5 hai. Agar wo correct hai, toh probability kya hai ki use pata tha?

HG_065.problem: 5 options wala MCQ hai. Answer janne ka chance 1/2 aur guess ka 1/2. Correct hone par probability find karo ki use pehle se answer pata tha dono ko check karke.

linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko' (both) here refers to the two states (knowing and guessing) but can mislead the model to sum something twice or divide by 2.
why_hard: Simple Bayes but requires assuming the probability of being correct when knowing is 1.

EN.problem: Two urns contain: Urn A (4 White, 3 Black), Urn B (3 White, 7 Black). One urn is chosen at random and a ball is drawn. It is white. If the ball is replaced and another ball is drawn from the same urn and is also white, find the probability that the chosen urn was Urn A.

HI.problem: दो कलशों में शामिल हैं: कलश A (4 सफेद, 3 काले), कलश B (3 सफेद, 7 काले)। एक कलश को यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना जाता है और एक गेंद निकाली जाती है। यह सफेद है। यदि गेंद को बदल दिया जाता है और उसी कलश से दूसरी गेंद निकाली जाती है और वह भी सफेद है, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि चुना गया कलश कलश A था?

HG_030.problem: 2 urns hain: Urn A (4W, 3B), Urn B (3W, 7B). Ek urn choose kiya aur white ball nikli. Ball replace karke phir usi urn se white ball nikli. Probability kya hai ki urn A tha?

HG_065.problem: Urn A(4W, 3B) aur B(3W, 7B) mein se random urn pick kiya. Pehli ball white nikli, uske baad 6 mahine baad second ball bhi white nikli. Urn A hone ki probability nikalo.

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad: The time gap is irrelevant since replacement occurred and the urn didn't change, but it tests if the LLM thinks the probability decays.
why_hard: Successive events from the same chosen source change the posterior more significantly.

EN.problem: A box contains 3 blue and 2 red marbles. Another box contains 2 blue and 5 red marbles. A marble is drawn at random from one of the boxes and it is blue. What is the probability that it was drawn from the first box?

HI.problem: एक बक्से में 3 नीले और 2 लाल कंचे हैं। दूसरे बक्से में 2 नीले और 5 लाल कंचे हैं। बक्सों में से एक से यादृच्छिक रूप से एक कंचा निकाला जाता है और वह नीला है। इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि इसे पहले बक्से से निकाला गया था?

HG_030.problem: Ek box mein 3 blue aur 2 red marbles hain. Dusre mein 2 blue aur 5 red. Ek random marble blue nikla. Probability kya hai ki wo pehle box se tha?

HG_065.problem: Box 1(3B, 2R) aur Box 2(2B, 5R) hain. Blue marble milne par, probability find karo ki wo pehle box se tha na ki doosre se 20% zyada.

linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: Comparison trap '20% zyada' makes the model look for a 1.2x multiplier between the two boxes' selection probabilities.
why_hard: The linguistic trap directly attacks the prior probabilities (equal vs biased selection).

EN.problem: Three machines A, B, and C produce 40%, 30%, and 30% of total items. The defect rates are 1%, 2%, and 3%. If a randomly selected item is not defective, find the probability it was from machine A.

HI.problem: तीन मशीनें A, B और C कुल वस्तुओं का 40%, 30% और 30% उत्पादन करती हैं। दोष दर 1%, 2% और 3% है। यदि यादृच्छिक रूप से चुनी गई वस्तु दोषपूर्ण नहीं है, तो इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यह मशीन A से थी।

HG_030.problem: Teen machines A, B, C 40%, 30%, 30% production karti hain. Defect rates 1%, 2%, aur 3% hain. Agar non-defective item mila, toh Machine A ki probability kya hai?

HG_065.problem: A(40%), B(30%), C(30%) machines hain. Defect percentages 1, 2, aur 3 hain. Item non-defective nikla, toh prob batao ki wo A ka tha aur 10 aur log safe hain.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: '10 aur log safe hain' is a distractor used to tempt the model into adjusting the success count.
why_hard: Calculating the non-defective posterior is slightly harder than the defective one as numbers are larger.

EN.problem: An urn contains 6 red and 4 black balls. Two balls are drawn without replacement. If the second ball is red, find the probability that the first ball was also red.

HI.problem: एक कलश में 6 लाल और 4 काली गेंदें हैं। बिना बदले दो गेंदें निकाली जाती हैं। यदि दूसरी गेंद लाल है, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि पहली गेंद भी लाल थी?

HG_030.problem: Urn mein 6 red aur 4 black balls hain. 2 balls bina replacement ke nikali gayi. Agar second ball red hai, toh probability kya hai ki pehli ball bhi red thi?

HG_065.problem: Urn mein 6 red aur 4 black balls hain. 2 balls without replacement nikalne par second ball red aayi. Prob nikalo ki pehli bhi red thi aur na X se na Y se divisible.

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: The LLM might try to apply divisibility rules to the ball counts (6, 4, 10) instead of solving the probability.
why_hard: Requires considering all possible first-draw outcomes to find the total probability of the second-draw outcome.

EN.problem: A bag contains 5 red and 3 white balls. Three balls are drawn one by one without replacement. If the first two balls are red, find the probability that the third ball is white.

HI.problem: एक झोले में 5 लाल और 3 सफेद गेंदें हैं। बिना प्रतिस्थापन के एक-एक करके तीन गेंदें निकाली जाती हैं। यदि पहली दो गेंदें लाल हैं, तो तीसरी गेंद के सफेद होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Bag mein 5 red aur 3 white balls hain. 3 balls bina replacement ke nikali gayi. Agar pehli 2 balls red hain, toh probability kya hai ki teesri white hai?

HG_065.problem: Bag(5R, 3W) se 3 balls bina badle nikali. Pehli 2 red hone par, probability batao ki teesri white thi aur pehle karo phir baaki.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Initial state: 5 Red, 3 White. Total = 8.
Step 2: After 2 Red are removed: 3 Red, 3 White remain. Total = 6.
Step 3: Probability third ball is white = 3/6 = 1/2.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Encourages sequential thinking which is correct, but can mislead if the LLM thinks it needs to apply Bayes' formula to a simple conditional case.
why_hard: While simple, LLMs often over-complicate 'without replacement' problems by using the wrong denominator.

EN.problem: In a town, 80% of people speak Hindi, 30% speak English and 10% speak neither. If a person who speaks Hindi is selected, what is the probability that he also speaks English?

HI.problem: एक शहर में, 80% लोग हिंदी बोलते हैं, 30% अंग्रेजी बोलते हैं और 10% कोई नहीं बोलते। यदि हिंदी बोलने वाले व्यक्ति को चुना जाता है, तो इसकी क्या प्रायिकता है कि वह अंग्रेजी भी बोलता है?

HG_030.problem: Town mein 80% log Hindi bolte hain, 30% English aur 10% dono mein se koi nahi. Agar koi Hindi bolne wala banda choose kiya, toh probability kya hai ki wo English bhi bolta hai?

HG_065.problem: 80% Hindi bolte hain, 30% English. Na Hindi na English bolne wale 10% hain. Hindi bolne wala person select kiya, toh prob nikalo ki wo English bhi bolta hai.

linguistic_trap: na X na Y: 'Na Hindi na English' (Neither Hindi nor English) is the linguistic trap. LLMs often interpret 'neither' as 'either' or fail to subtract from 100%.
why_hard: Requires applying set theory properties before applying the conditional probability formula.

EN.problem: Find the smallest positive integer n such that n has exactly 12 divisors and the sum of its prime factors is 10. For this n, calculate the sum of all its divisors.

HI.problem: वह सबसे छोटी धनात्मक पूर्णांक n ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके ठीक 12 विभाजक हों और इसके अभाज्य गुणनखंडों का योग 10 हो। इस n के लिए, इसके सभी विभाजकों के योग की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Smallest positive integer n find karo jiske exactly 12 divisors hain aur uske prime factors ka sum 10 hai. Is n ke liye, saare divisors ka sum calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Ek smallest positive integer n dhundho jiske fixed 12 divisors ho. Prime factors ka sum dekho toh 3 aur 7 aata hai. Pehle n ki value nikalo phir uske saare divisors ka sum total karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Identify prime factors p_i such that sum is 10. Possible sets: {3, 7} or {2, 3, 5}.
Step 3: Case {2, 3, 5}: n = 2^a * 3^b * 5^c. Divisors (a+1)(b+1)(c+1)=12. Possible sets for exponents: {2, 1, 1}. To minimize n, assign largest exponent to smallest prime: 2^2 * 3^1 * 5^1 = 60.

Step 4: n = 60. Sum of divisors sigma(60) = (2^3-1)/(2-1) * (3^2-1)/(3-1) * (5^2-1)/(5-1) = 7 * 4 * 6 = 168. Wait, problem says sum of prime factors is 10. 3+7=10 and 2+3+5=10. Compare 60 and 1323. Smallest is 60.

Step 5: Re-calculate sigma(60): 1+2+3+4+5+6+10+12+15+20+30+60 = 168. (Wait, let's re-verify 444 in prompt context. 444 = 2^2 * 3 * 37, sum factors 42. Incorrect. Let's use n=147? No. Let's use n=2^2 * 3^2 * 3. No. Let's re-run 2^5 * 3^1 = 323=96 (sum factors 2+3=5). Let's use n=2^2 * 3^3 = 427=108. (2+3=5). Let's use p=3, q=7. n=3^5 * 7^1 = 1701. n=3^2 * 7^3 = 3087. Let's use p=2, q=3, r=5. n=2^2 * 3 * 5 = 60. Sum = 168.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: The sequence 'Pehle n ki value nikalo phir sum total karo' is simple, but in more complex flows, it tests if the LLM retains the state of n before performing the sigma function.
why_hard: Requires comparing multiple prime factor sets that satisfy a sum-of-primes condition and partition theory for the number of divisors.

EN.problem: Determine the number of trailing zeros in (375,000)! divided by (374,990)!. Provide the exact sum of the counts of prime factor 2 and prime factor 5 in the resulting product.

HI.problem: (375,000)! को (374,990)! से विभाजित करने पर प्राप्त संख्या के अंत में शून्य की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए। प्राप्त गुणनफल में अभाज्य गुणनखंड 2 और अभाज्य गुणनखंड 5 की गणनाओं का सटीक योग प्रदान करें।

HG_030.problem: (375,000)! divided by (374,990)! ke product mein kitne trailing zeros honge? Resulting product mein prime factor 2 and 5 ke counts ka exact sum provide karo.

HG_065.problem: 3 lakh 75 hazaar factorial divided by 374990 factorial ke result mein trailing zeros kitne hain? Is product mein 2 aur 5 ki total powers ka sum calculate karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Count 5s: 375,000 has six 5s. 374,995 has one 5. Total 5s = 7.

Step 6: Total 2s and 5s count: 5s = 7, 2s = 5 (from 375k) + something? Let's re-sum: 2^3 (375k), 2^1 (374998), 2^2 (374996), 2^1 (374994), 2^4 (374992). Total 2s = 11. Total 5s = 7. Sum = 18. Trailing zeros = min(11, 7) = 7. Question asks for sum of counts of 2 and 5: 11 + 7 = 18.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: LLM may interpret '3 lakh 75 hazaar' as 3,075,000 or just 75,000, leading to a completely different factorial range.
why_hard: Requires Legendre's formula logic but applied to a specific range (a product of 10 terms) rather than a single factorial.

EN.problem: Consider the number N = 2^4 * 3^2 * 5^1. A new number M is formed by multiplying N by 10 more primes, specifically the first 2 primes that are not factors of N. Find the number of divisors of M that are not divisible by 6.

HI.problem: संख्या N = 2^4 * 3^2 * 5^1 पर विचार करें। N को 10 और अभाज्य संख्याओं से गुणा करके एक नई संख्या M बनाई जाती है, विशेष रूप से वे पहले 2 अभाज्य जो N के गुणनखंड नहीं हैं। M के उन विभाजकों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जो 6 से विभाज्य नहीं हैं।

HG_030.problem: Number N = 2^4 * 3^2 * 5^1 consider karo. Ek naya number M banaya gaya N ko 10 more primes se multiply karke, actually first 2 primes jo N ke factors nahi hain. M के divisors find karo jo 6 se divisible nahi hain.

HG_065.problem: N = 2^4 * 3^2 * 5^1 hai. M banane ke liye N mein 10 aur log aaye... mera matlab 10 and the next few primes use hue, basically first 2 primes jo N ke factors nahi hain unhe multiply kiya. M ke aise kitne divisors hain jo 6 se divisible nahi hain?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Primes not in N {2, 3, 5} are {7, 11, ...}. First two are 7 and 11.
Step 3: A divisor is not divisible by 6 if it is not divisible by (2^1 * 3^1).
Step 5: Divisors divisible by 6 must have at least one 2 and at least one 3. Form: 2^a * 3^b * 5^c * 7^d * 11^e where a in {1,2,3,4} and b in {1,2}.
Step 6: Number of such divisors = (4 choices for a) * (2 choices for b) * 2 * 2 * 2 = 4 * 2 * 8 = 64.
Step 7: Divisors not divisible by 6 = 120 - 64 = 56. Wait, let's re-calculate. Not divisible by 6 means: (Power of 2 is 0) OR (Power of 3 is 0).
Step 8: Set A (power of 2 is 0): 1 * 3 * 2 * 2 * 2 = 24. Set B (power of 3 is 0): 5 * 1 * 2 * 2 * 2 = 40. Intersection (power of 2 and 3 are 0): 1 * 1 * 2 * 2 * 2 = 8.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: Used to mislead the LLM into adding 10 to a value or thinking 10 new primes were added, whereas the text clarifies only the first 2 non-factor primes are used.
why_hard: Involves the inclusion-exclusion principle applied to divisor properties based on prime power constraints.

EN.problem: Find the smallest number x such that x is neither divisible by 4 nor by 9, but has exactly 6 divisors and is greater than 50. What is this value of x?

HI.problem: सबसे छोटी संख्या x ज्ञात कीजिए जो न तो 4 से और न ही 9 से विभाज्य है, लेकिन उसके ठीक 6 विभाजक हैं और वह 50 से बड़ी है। x का यह मान क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Smallest number x find karo jo na 4 se na 9 se divisible hai, but uske exactly 6 divisors hain and x > 50. x ki value kya hai?

HG_065.problem: Aisa smallest x batao jo na 4 se na 9 se divisible ho, but divisors 6 hone chahiye aur 50 se bada ho. x ki value calculate karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Number of divisors d(x) = 6. Possible prime forms: p^5 or p^2 * q^1.
Step 2: Form p^5: 2^5 = 32 (too small), 3^5 = 243. 2^5 is divisible by 4 (not allowed).
Step 3: Form p^2 * q: Test primes. If p=2, x=4q (divisible by 4, rejected). If p=3, x=9q (divisible by 9, rejected).
Step 4: So p must be >= 5. If p=5, x = 25 * q. If q=2, x=50 (not > 50). If q=3, x=75. If q=7, x=175.
Step 5: If p=7, x = 49 * q. If q=2, x=98. If q=3, x=147.
Step 6: Check x=75: Divisors are 1, 3, 5, 15, 25, 75 (Exactly 6). Is it divisible by 4? No. By 9? No. x > 50? Yes.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: The trap 'na 4 se na 9 se divisible' tests if the LLM correctly interprets the conjunction as 'not 4 AND not 9' rather than 'not (4 or 9)'.
why_hard: Requires iterating through prime power configurations while respecting multiple negative constraints and an inequality.

EN.problem: Let A = 2^10 * 5^3. Let B be the number obtained by increasing the power of 2 in A by 20%. How many divisors of B are perfect squares?

HI.problem: माना A = 2^10 * 5^3। माना B वह संख्या है जो A में 2 की घात को 20% बढ़ाकर प्राप्त की जाती है। B के कितने विभाजक पूर्ण वर्ग हैं?

HG_030.problem: Assume A = 2^10 * 5^3. B ek number hai jo A mein 2 ki power ko 20% badha kar milta hai. B ke kitne divisors perfect squares hain?

HG_065.problem: A ki value 2^10 * 5^3 hai. B calculate karne ke liye 2 ki power ko A se 20% zyada kar do. B ke kitne divisors perfect squares honge?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Original power of 2 is 10. Increase by 20%: 10 * 1.20 = 12.
Step 3: A divisor d = 2^x * 5^y is a perfect square if x is even and y is even.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: Directional trap. The LLM might apply the 20% increase to the entire number A or to the exponent of 5 instead of 2, or miscalculate 10 + 20% as 30.
why_hard: Combines percentage manipulation of exponents with the combinatorial rule for finding perfect square divisors.

EN.problem: A number N is the product of the first 4 primes. A mathematician decides to double the power of the smallest prime. Calculate the count of divisors of this new number that are baaki (remainders) when divided by 4 giving 2.

HI.problem: एक संख्या N पहले 4 अभाज्य संख्याओं का गुणनफल है। एक गणितज्ञ सबसे छोटी अभाज्य संख्या की घात को दोगुना करने का निर्णय लेता है। इस नई संख्या के उन विभाजकों की संख्या की गणना करें जो 4 से विभाजित करने पर 2 शेष (baaki) देते हैं।

HG_030.problem: N is the product of first 4 primes. Ek mathematician smallest prime ki power ko double kar deta hai. New number ke aise divisors count karo jo 4 se divide karne par 2 remainder dete hain.

HG_065.problem: N start ke 4 primes ka product hai. Smallest prime ki power double kar di. Is naye number ke divisors mein se kitne aise hain jo 4 se divide karne par baaki 2 dete hain?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Smallest prime is 2. Double its power: 2^2 * 3 * 5 * 7.
Step 3: A divisor d is 2 mod 4 if d is divisible by 2 but not by 4.
Step 4: Divisor form: 2^a * 3^b * 5^c * 7^d. For d = 2 mod 4, a must be exactly 1.
Step 5: Choices for other exponents: b in {0,1}, c in {0,1}, d in {0,1}.
Step 6: Total = 1 * 2 * 2 * 2 = 8. (Wait, let's re-read: product of first 4 primes is 2,3,5,7. Power was 1, double of 1 is 2).
Step 7: The condition is d % 4 == 2. This means d = 2 * (odd number).
Step 8: Our number is 2^2 * 3 * 5 * 7. Divisors are of form 2^a * 3^b * 5^c * 7^d. For d to be 2(odd), a must be 1.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The word 'baaki' is used as a synonym for 'remainder' in this context. LLMs often mistake 'baaki' for 'the rest of' or a subtraction operation.
why_hard: Requires translating a modular arithmetic condition into specific prime power constraints for divisors.

EN.problem: N = 2^3 * 3^2 * 5^2. How many divisors of N^2 are not divisible by 125 but are divisible by 4?

HG_030.problem: N = 2^3 * 3^2 * 5^2. N^2 के kitne divisors 125 se divisible nahi hain but 4 se divisible hain?

HG_065.problem: N = 2^3 * 3^2 * 5^2 hai. N ka square karo, phir uske divisors check karo. Aise divisors find karo jo dono ko... mera matlab 125 se divisible na ho aur 4 se divisible ho.

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Condition 1: Divisible by 4 => a >= 2. Possible values for a: {2, 3, 4, 5, 6} (5 values).
Step 4: Condition 2: Not divisible by 125 (5^3) => c < 3. Possible values for c: {0, 1, 2} (3 values).
Step 5: No condition on b: b in {0, 1, 2, 3, 4} (5 values).
linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko' usually means 'both'. Here it's placed to confuse the LLM into thinking it needs a different logical conjunction or to apply the divisibility to both N and N^2.
why_hard: Requires applying power-of-a-power rules followed by restricted divisor counting using prime exponent ranges.

EN.problem: Find the largest factor of 375,000 that is a perfect cube. Divide this factor by 1000 and provide the result.

HI.problem: 3,75,000 का सबसे बड़ा गुणनखंड ज्ञात कीजिए जो एक पूर्ण घन है। इस गुणनखंड को 1000 से विभाजित करें और परिणाम प्रदान करें।

HG_030.problem: 375,000 ka largest factor find karo jo perfect cube ho. Is factor ko 1000 se divide karke result batao.

HG_065.problem: 3 lakh 75 hazaar ka sabse bada perfect cube factor nikalo. Phir us factor ko 1000 se divide karke final answer do.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: For a factor to be a perfect cube, all exponents must be multiples of 3.
Step 3: Largest such factor uses exponents: 2^3 (since 3 is multiple of 3) and 5^6 (since 6 is multiple of 3). 3^0 is used because 1 is not a multiple of 3.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: LLM might treat the number as 3.75 or 375,000 but fail to factorize the 'lakh' part correctly into 10^5.
why_hard: Requires prime factorization of large numbers and applying the exponent-multiple rule for perfect powers.

EN.problem: Let n = 2^5 * 3^4. A process is defined: pehle divide n by its smallest prime factor, phir multiply the result by its largest prime factor. If you repeat this process 3 times, what is the final value of n?

HI.problem: माना n = 2^5 * 3^4। एक प्रक्रिया परिभाषित है: पहले n को उसके सबसे छोटे अभाज्य गुणनखंड से विभाजित करें, फिर परिणाम को उसके सबसे बड़े अभाज्य गुणनखंड से गुणा करें। यदि आप इस प्रक्रिया को 3 बार दोहराते हैं, तो n का अंतिम मान क्या है?

HG_030.problem: n = 2^5 * 3^4 assume karo. Ek process hai: pehle divide n by its smallest prime factor, phir multiply by its largest prime factor. Agar 3 times repeat karein, final value kya hogi?

HG_065.problem: n की value 2^5 * 3^4 hai. Ek process follow karo: pehle karo smallest prime se divide phir result ko largest prime se multiply. Yeh loop 3 baar chalane ke baad n kya banega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Iteration 1: Smallest prime = 2, Largest = 3. n = (2^5 * 3^4 / 2) * 3 = 2^4 * 3^5.
Step 2: Iteration 2: Smallest prime = 2, Largest = 3. n = (2^4 * 3^5 / 2) * 3 = 2^3 * 3^6.
Step 3: Iteration 3: Smallest prime = 2, Largest = 3. n = (2^3 * 3^6 / 2) * 3 = 2^2 * 3^7.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Sequence trap. LLMs may multiply before dividing or misinterpret 'result' as the original n.
why_hard: Iterative process where the prime factorization (and thus the factors themselves) could theoretically change, requiring re-evaluation at each step.

EN.problem: Compute the sum of exponents in the prime factorization of the LCM of (2^4 * 3^2), (3^3 * 5^1), and 60.

HI.problem: (2^4 * 3^2), (3^3 * 5^1), और 60 के LCM के अभाज्य गुणनखंडन में घातों के योग की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: (2^4 * 3^2), (3^3 * 5^1), aur 60 ke LCM ke prime factorization mein exponents ka sum compute karo.

HG_065.problem: (2^4 * 3^2), (3^3 * 5^1), aur 60 ka LCM nikalo. Phir us LCM ko prime factors mein tod kar saari powers ko dono ko... mera matlab hai simple sum karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Factorize all numbers: A = 2^4 * 3^2, B = 3^3 * 5^1, C = 60 = 2^2 * 3^1 * 5^1.
Step 2: LCM is found by taking the maximum exponent for each prime factor.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: Used to distract the LLM into thinking it should only sum exponents for two of the three numbers or perform a pairwise operation.
why_hard: Requires simultaneous prime factorization of multiple terms and understanding of the LCM exponent rule.

EN.problem: Determine the number of integers between 100 and 200 (inclusive) that have exactly 3 divisors. For the sum of these integers, find its largest prime factor.

HI.problem: 100 और 200 (समावेशी) के बीच उन पूर्णांकों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके ठीक 3 विभाजक हैं। इन पूर्णांकों के योग के लिए, इसका सबसे बड़ा अभाज्य गुणनखंड ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 100 aur 200 ke beech aise integers count karo jiske exactly 3 divisors hain. In integers ke sum ka largest prime factor find karo.

HG_065.problem: 100 aur 200 ke beech fixed 3 divisors wale numbers dhundho. Un numbers ka sum karo, phir us sum ka largest prime factor kya hai, 6 mahine baad... mera matlab hai dhyan se calculate karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: A number has exactly 3 divisors if it is the square of a prime (p^2).
Step 2: Find primes p such that 100 <= p^2 <= 200.
Step 6: Prime factorization of 290 = 2 * 5 * 29. Wait, 121+169=290. Primes are 2, 5, 29. Largest is 29.
Step 7: Let me re-check 100. 100 <= p^2. If 100 is p^2, p=10 (not prime). So only 121 and 169. Sum 290.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad: Temporal trap. It is nonsensical here but acts as a distractor to see if the LLM tries to divide the result by 6 or apply a semi-annual rate logic to the sum.
why_hard: Requires knowledge of the specific properties of numbers with an odd number of divisors (perfect squares) and specifically 3 divisors (prime squares).

EN.problem: How many divisors of 1,260 are divisible by 6? After finding this count, add 10 more to it and find the final result.

HI.problem: 1,260 के कितने विभाजक 6 से विभाज्य हैं? यह संख्या ज्ञात करने के बाद, इसमें 10 और जोड़ें और अंतिम परिणाम ज्ञात करें।

HG_030.problem: 1,260 ke kitne divisors 6 se divisible hain? Ye count milne ke baad, 10 more add karo and final result batao.
