linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; used here to denote simple withdrawal, but LLM might look for a 'time' component or compound reduction.
why_hard: Multi-stage transfer requires updating concentrations at each step accurately.

EN.problem: A mixture contains wine and water in 3:1. What fraction of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the wine and water ratio becomes 1:1?

HI.problem: एक मिश्रण में वाइन और पानी 3:1 में है। मिश्रण का कितना अंश निकाला जाना चाहिए और पानी से बदला जाना चाहिए ताकि वाइन और पानी का अनुपात 1:1 हो जाए?

HG_030.problem: Mixture mein wine aur water 3:1 ratio mein hai. Kitna fraction mixture ka draw off karke water se replace karein so that ratio 1:1 ho jaye?

HG_065.problem: Wine-water 3:1 hai. Pehle karo calculation ki kitna part nikalna hai, phir replace it with water to get 1:1. Fraction batao?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let total volume be 4 units (3 wine, 1 water).
Step 2: Let x units be removed. Remaining wine = 3 - (3/4)x. Remaining water = 1 - (1/4)x.
Step 3: Replace with x units water. New water = 1 - (1/4)x + x = 1 + (3/4)x.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM might calculate the removal but forget the replacement or apply it to the wrong component.
why_hard: Replacing a mixture with a pure component changes both the numerator and denominator of the concentration fraction.

EN.problem: Two vessels A and B contain milk and water in 4:3 and 2:3. How many liters from Vessel A should be mixed with 10 liters from Vessel B to get a 50% milk solution?

HI.problem: दो पात्रों A और B में दूध और पानी 4:3 और 2:3 में है। 50% दूध का विलयन प्राप्त करने के लिए पात्र B के 10 लीटर के साथ पात्र A से कितने लीटर मिलाया जाना चाहिए?

HG_030.problem: Two vessels A aur B mein milk-water 4:3 aur 2:3 hai. Vessel B ke 10 liters ke saath A ka kitna volume mix karein to get 50% milk solution?

HG_065.problem: A is 4:3, B is 2:3. Vessel B se 10 liters liya. Ab A se kitna volume dono ko milane ke liye lein ki result 50% milk ho?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Milk in A = 4/7. Milk in B = 2/5 = 0.4. Target milk = 0.5.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM might add the 10L to the variable and solve (x+10), misidentifying the parts of the ratio.
why_hard: Requires applying alligation to find a ratio and then scaling that ratio to a specific known volume.

EN.problem: A jar contains 2 liquids X and Y in 7:5. When 9 liters of mixture are drawn off and the jar is filled with Y, the ratio becomes 7:9. How many liters of liquid X was in the jar initially?

HI.problem: एक जार में 2 तरल पदार्थ X और Y 7:5 में हैं। जब 9 लीटर मिश्रण निकाल लिया जाता है और जार को Y से भर दिया जाता है, तो अनुपात 7:9 हो जाता है। प्रारंभ में जार में तरल X कितने लीटर था?

HG_030.problem: Jar contains liquids X aur Y in 7:5. Jab 9 liters mixture nikala aur Y se fill kiya, ratio 7:9 ho gaya. Initially X kitna tha?

HG_065.problem: X and Y are 7:5. 9 liters mixture nikala, phir baaki mein 9 liters liquid Y bhar diya. Ratio 7:9 ho gaya. Starting mein X kitna tha?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let initial volumes be 7k and 5k. Total = 12k.
linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM may fail to calculate the amount of X and Y removed in the 9 liters of mixture.
why_hard: Classic variable-ratio problem requiring algebraic setup to find the initial multiplier.

EN.problem: Vessel A has 25% sugar and Vessel B has 50% sugar. If 6 mahine baad (after 6 months) we mix them to get 40% sugar, and the total volume is 50 liters, what is the volume of Vessel A used?

HI.problem: पात्र A में 25% चीनी है और पात्र B में 50% चीनी है। यदि हम उन्हें 40% चीनी प्राप्त करने के लिए मिलाते हैं, और कुल आयतन 50 लीटर है, तो उपयोग किए गए पात्र A का आयतन क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Vessel A mein 25% sugar aur B mein 50%. Dono ko mix karke 40% sugar banaya, total volume 50 liters. A ka volume kya tha?

HG_065.problem: Vessel A 25% sugar, B 50%. 6 mahine baad dono ko mix kiya to get 40% sugar concentration. Total volume 50 L hai. A kitne liters liya?

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem; LLM might think the concentration decays or changes over time, though it's irrelevant.
why_hard: Temporal distractors in word problems can lead LLMs to incorporate time-based decay or interest formulas unnecessarily.

EN.problem: Milk and water are in 3:2 in vessel A and 4:1 in vessel B. If A and B are mixed in 2:3 ratio, find the percentage of water in the final mixture.

HI.problem: पात्र A में दूध और पानी 3:2 में हैं और पात्र B में 4:1 में हैं। यदि A और B को 2:3 के अनुपात में मिलाया जाता है, तो अंतिम मिश्रण में पानी का प्रतिशत ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Milk aur water A mein 3:2 hain aur B mein 4:1. Agar A aur B ko 2:3 ratio mein mix karein, final mixture mein water % kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: A is 3:2 and B is 4:1. Mixing ratio of A and B is 2:3. Final mixture mein water kitna percent hoga? Pehle karo water components check, phir total.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Water in A = 2/5. Water in B = 1/5.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM might focus on one vessel first and ignore the weighted average of the second.
why_hard: Calculating weighted averages of percentages/ratios across different volumes requires multi-step concentration arithmetic.

EN.problem: Let z be a complex number such that |z - 3 - 4i| = 2. Find the maximum value of |z|.

HI.problem: मान लीजिए z एक सम्मिश्र संख्या है जैसे कि |z - 3 - 4i| = 2 है। |z| का अधिकतम मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Let z be a complex number such that |z - 3 - 4i| = 2. |z| ki maximum value find karo.

HG_065.problem: Ek complex number z hai jiske liye |z - (3 + 4i)| = 2 holds karta hai. Isme origin se distance check karo, aur dhyan rakhna ki 10 aur log aaye calculation mein calculation complex karne ke liye, to max value kya hogi?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Identify the locus of z as a circle with center (3, 4) and radius r = 2.
Step 2: Calculate the distance of the center from the origin: sqrt(3^2 + 4^2) = 5.
Step 3: The maximum distance from the origin (max |z|) is distance to center + radius.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> This trap implies adding 10 to a count or value; an LLM might add 10 to the distance or the final answer instead of treating it as irrelevant conversational filler.
why_hard: Requires geometric interpretation of complex modulus as a circle and identifying the extremum relative to the origin.

EN.problem: If z = (1 + isqrt(3))^5 / (1 - i)^4, find the principal argument of z in degrees.

HI.problem: यदि z = (1 + isqrt(3))^5 / (1 - i)^4 है, तो z का मुख्य कोणांक (principal argument) डिग्री में ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: If z = (1 + isqrt(3))^5 / (1 - i)^4, toh z ka principal argument degrees mein find karo.

HG_065.problem: z ki value (1 + isqrt(3))^5 divided by (1 - i)^4 di gayi hai. Pehle karo polar conversion phir argument calculate karke degrees mein batao.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Arg(1 + isqrt(3)) = 60 degrees. For power 5: 5 * 60 = 300 degrees.
Step 2: Arg(1 - i) = -45 degrees. For power 4: 4 * (-45) = -180 degrees.
Step 4: Normalize to principal argument (-180, 180]: 480 - 360 = 120 degrees. Wait, let's re-verify Step 2.
Step 5: Denominator is (1-i)^4 = ((1-i)^2)^2 = (-2i)^2 = -4. Arg(-4) is 180 degrees.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> This sequence trap might lead an LLM to apply the power before the argument subtraction or vice versa in a non-standard order that ignores De Moivre's properties.
why_hard: Requires applying De Moivre's theorem and managing multiple polar conversions and argument normalization.

EN.problem: Find the modulus of z = (2 + 3i)(3 - 2i) / (1 + i).

HG_030.problem: z = (2 + 3i)(3 - 2i) / (1 + i) ka modulus find karo.

HG_065.problem: Expression z = (2 + 3i)(3 - 2i) / (1 + i) ka modulus nikalna hai. Isme numerator ke dono ko multiply karke denominator se divide karna hai correctly.

linguistic_trap: dono ko -> The LLM might apply the multiplication to only one term or fail to distribute the modulus property across all factors.
why_hard: Tests the efficiency of using modulus properties over tedious algebraic multiplication/rationalization.

EN.problem: Let |z| = 1 and arg(z) = theta. Find the argument of (1 + z) / (1 + conj(z)).

HI.problem: मान लीजिए |z| = 1 और arg(z) = theta है। (1 + z) / (1 + conj(z)) का कोणांक ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Let |z| = 1 and arg(z) = theta. (1 + z) / (1 + conj(z)) ka argument find out karo.

HG_065.problem: Condition di hai |z| = 1 aur argument theta hai. Expression (1 + z) / (1 + conj(z)) solve karo. Isme na real part se na imaginary part se divisible check karna, seedha argument nikaalo.

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible -> This 'neither-nor' trap might lead the LLM to search for integer properties or divisibility rules instead of focusing on the argument of the complex number.
why_hard: Requires recognizing the relationship between a unimodular complex number and its conjugate.

EN.problem: If z = sqrt(3) + i, find the value of arg(z^10). Provide answer in degrees.

HI.problem: यदि z = sqrt(3) + i है, तो arg(z^10) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। उत्तर डिग्री में दें।

HG_030.problem: If z = sqrt(3) + i, arg(z^10) ki value degrees mein find karo.

HG_065.problem: Complex number z = sqrt(3) + i diya gaya hai. Iski power 10 karke argument nikaalna hai. Baaki calculation ignore karke main result focus karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find arg(z): tan(theta) = 1/sqrt(3) => theta = 30 degrees.
Step 2: Use Arg(z^n) = n * Arg(z): 10 * 30 = 300 degrees.
Step 3: Convert to principal argument range (-180, 180]: 300 - 360 = -60 degrees.
linguistic_trap: baaki -> This 'remainder' trap can mislead an LLM to perform a subtraction (remainder) from a previous step or the exponent itself.
why_hard: The student must navigate principal argument constraints after power multiplication.

EN.problem: Find the real part of the complex number z if |z| = 4 and arg(z) = 5pi/6.

HI.problem: सम्मिश्र संख्या z का वास्तविक भाग ज्ञात कीजिए यदि |z| = 4 और arg(z) = 5pi/6 है।

HG_030.problem: Complex number z ka real part find karo if |z| = 4 and arg(z) = 5pi/6.

HG_065.problem: Modulus 4 hai aur argument 5pi/6. Real part nikalne ke liye 3 lakh 75 hazaar precision ki zaroorat nahi, simple cos function use karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Express z in polar form: z = r(cos(theta) + i sin(theta)).
Step 3: Real part = r * cos(theta) = 4 * cos(150).
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar -> Large number notation can cause the LLM to parse '3' as the modulus or scale the answer by 375,000.
why_hard: Tests the basic conversion from polar to Cartesian coordinates with a second-quadrant angle.

EN.problem: If |z1| = 2, |z2| = 3 and the angle between them is 60 degrees, find |z1 + z2|^2.

HI.problem: यदि |z1| = 2, |z2| = 3 और उनके बीच का कोण 60 डिग्री है, तो |z1 + z2|^2 ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: If |z1| = 2, |z2| = 3 and angle between them is 60 degrees, |z1 + z2|^2 ki value nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: Modulus values 2 and 3 hain. Dono ke beech ka angle 60 degree hai. Vector addition logic se result nikalo, 6 mahine baad wala interest logic mat laga dena.

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad -> Temporal distractor that could lead the LLM to divide the angle or the result by 2 (as if it were a semi-annual rate).
why_hard: Links complex modulus addition to the law of cosines/parallelogram law of vectors.

EN.problem: Find the smallest positive integer n for which ((1 + i) / (1 - i))^n = 1.

HI.problem: वह सबसे छोटा धनात्मक पूर्णांक n ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके लिए ((1 + i) / (1 - i))^n = 1 हो।

HG_030.problem: Smallest positive integer n find karo for which ((1 + i) / (1 - i))^n = 1.

HG_065.problem: Equation ((1 + i) / (1 - i))^n = 1 di gayi hai. n ki value nikaalne ke liye withdraw kar liya N mahine baad wala logic skip karke power cyclic nature check karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Simplify the base (1+i)/(1-i) by rationalizing: (1+i)^2 / ((1-i)(1+i)).
Step 4: The smallest positive integer for i^n = 1 is n = 4.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad -> This trap might lead the LLM to subtract a value 'N' or treat the exponent as a diminishing time variable.
why_hard: Requires simplification of a complex quotient into the imaginary unit 'i' and knowledge of its powers.

EN.problem: If arg(z) < 0, then find arg(-z) - arg(z).

HI.problem: यदि arg(z) < 0 है, तो arg(-z) - arg(z) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: If arg(z) < 0, toh arg(-z) - arg(z) ki value find karo.

HG_065.problem: Argument of z negative hai. Arg(-z) aur arg(z) ka difference find karo. Isme A se 20% zyada base error mat karna, direct logic use karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let arg(z) = theta, where theta is in (-pi, 0).
Step 2: -z is z rotated by pi. So arg(-z) = theta + pi.
Step 3: Since theta is negative, theta + pi will be in (0, pi), which is within the principal range.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada -> This trap might mislead the LLM into thinking there is a percentage-based scaling between the two arguments.
why_hard: Requires understanding of how negation affects the argument in the complex plane and staying within the principal range.

EN.problem: Find the area of the triangle formed by the complex numbers z, iz, and z + iz where |z| = 10.

HI.problem: सम्मिश्र संख्याओं z, iz, और z + iz द्वारा बने त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जहाँ |z| = 10 है।

HG_030.problem: Complex numbers z, iz, aur z + iz se banne wale triangle ka area find karo if |z| = 10.

HG_065.problem: Triangle ke vertices z, iz, aur z + iz hain. Area calculate karo jab |z| = 10 ho. Pehle karo rotation logic apply phir area formula.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Multiplying by 'i' is a 90-degree rotation. So z and iz are perpendicular.
Step 2: The triangle formed by 0, z, and iz is a right-angled triangle with legs of length |z|=10.
Step 3: The points z, iz, and z + iz form a triangle that is congruent to the one formed by 0, z, iz (it is just shifted).
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> This trap may lead the LLM to think the order of applying 'i' matters in a way that changes the area, or it might incorrectly apply a sequence of operations.
why_hard: Requires geometric visualization of complex number operations (rotation and vector addition).

EN.problem: If |z - 1| = |z + i|, find the locus of z.

HI.problem: यदि |z - 1| = |z + i| है, तो z का बिन्दुपथ (locus) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: If |z - 1| = |z + i|, find the locus of z.

HG_065.problem: Condition |z - 1| = |z + i| satisfy ho rahi hai. Locus identify karo, baaki details irrelevant hain, final equation line ki form mein do.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let z = x + iy. |(x-1) + iy| = |x + i(y+1)|.
Step 2: Square both sides: (x-1)^2 + y^2 = x^2 + (y+1)^2.
Step 3: Expand: x^2 - 2x + 1 + y^2 = x^2 + y^2 + 2y + 1.
linguistic_trap: baaki -> The LLM might ignore the constant '1' or 'i' in the subtraction step, assuming they are 'remaining' parts that don't affect the locus.
why_hard: Requires converting a modulus equation into a Cartesian coordinate equation.

EN.problem: Find the modulus of (1 + 2i) / (1 - (1 - i)^2).

HG_030.problem: (1 + 2i) / (1 - (1 - i)^2) ka modulus find out karo.

HG_065.problem: z = (1 + 2i) / (1 - (1 - i)^2) diya hai. Dono ko (num and den) simplify karke modulus nikaalo, arithmetic error se bachna.

linguistic_trap: dono ko -> The LLM might try to apply the modulus to the numerator and denominator separately before simplifying the subtraction in the denominator, potentially leading to order-of-operation errors.
why_hard: The complex expression in the denominator simplifies significantly, but an LLM might miss the simplification and proceed with a much harder calculation.

EN.problem: If z = 1 + itan(alpha) where pi < alpha < 3pi/2, find the modulus of z.

HI.problem: यदि z = 1 + itan(alpha) जहाँ pi < alpha < 3pi/2 है, तो z का मापांक ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: If z = 1 + itan(alpha) where pi < alpha < 3pi/2, find modulus of z.

HG_065.problem: alpha third quadrant mein hai. z = 1 + itan(alpha) ka modulus nikalna hai. Isme 3 lakh 75 hazaar wala large value trap nahi hai, sign ka dhyan rakhna.

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Since alpha is in the third quadrant (pi, 3pi/2), sec(alpha) is negative.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar -> The LLM might be distracted by the large number and fail to properly evaluate the sign of the trigonometric function in the third quadrant.
why_hard: Requires knowledge of trigonometric identities and quadrant-based signs for the square root of a square.

EN.problem: Find the argument of z = (1 + isqrt(3)) / (sqrt(3) + i) in radians.

HI.problem: z = (1 + isqrt(3)) / (sqrt(3) + i) का कोणांक रेडियन में ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: z = (1 + isqrt(3)) / (sqrt(3) + i) ka argument radians mein find karo.

HG_065.problem: Complex fraction z = (1 + isqrt(3)) / (sqrt(3) + i) solve karo. Na 1 se na 2 se divisible logic ki jagah basic argument subtraction use karo.

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible -> This trap might lead the LLM to waste time checking for prime numbers or integer factors of the components.
why_hard: Tests the ability to use argument properties for division rather than full division of complex numbers.

EN.problem: If z1 = 1 + i and z2 = 2 + 3i, find the argument of (z1 * z2) in degrees.

HI.problem: यदि z1 = 1 + i और z2 = 2 + 3i है, तो (z1 * z2) का कोणांक डिग्री में ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: If z1 = 1 + i and z2 = 2 + 3i, (z1 * z2) ka argument degrees mein nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: Complex product z1 * z2 find karke argument nikaalo. 10 aur log aaye calculation check karne par bhi answer same rehna chahiye.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Arg(-1 + 5i) is in the 2nd quadrant.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> This trap might cause the LLM to add 10 to the final degree value or to the intermediate product coefficients.
why_hard: Requires correct identification of the quadrant for the argument of the product.

EN.problem: Consider a sequence defined by a(1) = 1, a(2) = 2, and a(n) = a(n-1) + 2a(n-2) for n > 2. Calculate the value of a(10).

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम पर विचार करें जो a(1) = 1, a(2) = 2, और n > 2 के लिए a(n) = a(n-1) + 2a(n-2) द्वारा परिभाषित है। a(10) के मान की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Ek sequence consider karo defined by a(1) = 1, a(2) = 2, aur a(n) = a(n-1) + 2a(n-2) for n > 2. a(10) ki value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Sequence a(1)=1 aur a(2)=2 se start hota hai. Next terms ke liye a(n) = a(n-1) + 2a(n-2) formula use karo. Par dhyan rahe, index 5 reach karne ke baad 10 aur log aaye... mera matlab index mein 10 add nahi karna, bas a(10) nikalna hai standard rule se.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Write terms manually or find general form. a(3) = a(2) + 2a(1) = 2 + 2(1) = 4.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: This additive trap often causes LLMs to add 10 to the constant in the recurrence or offset the index 'n' by 10, incorrectly calculating a(20) or a(n+10).
why_hard: Requires consistent application of a linear homogeneous recurrence relation without falling for the index-shifting distractor.

EN.problem: A sequence satisfies S(n) = 3S(n-1) - 2S(n-2). If S(1) = 5 and S(2) = 7, find S(6).

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम S(n) = 3S(n-1) - 2S(n-2) को संतुष्ट करता है। यदि S(1) = 5 और S(2) = 7 है, तो S(6) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sequence S(n) = 3S(n-1) - 2S(n-2) satisfy karta hai. If S(1) = 5 and S(2) = 7, S(6) find karo.

HG_065.problem: S(n) calculate karna hai using 3S(n-1) - 2S(n-2). Start mein S(1)=5 hai, aur S(2) ki value S(1) se 20% zyada... nahi 2 units zyada i.e. 7 hai. S(6) kya hoga?

linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: The LLM may incorrectly calculate S(2) as 5 + 20% of 5 = 6, ignoring the explicit '7' provided immediately after, leading to an incorrect sequence propagation.
why_hard: The 'A se 20% zyada' trap tests if the LLM prioritizes fuzzy linguistic descriptions over explicit numerical data.

EN.problem: Find the 5th term of a sequence where f(1)=2, f(2)=3 and f(n) = [f(n-1)]^2 - f(n-2) for n > 2.

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम का 5वाँ पद ज्ञात कीजिए जहाँ f(1)=2, f(2)=3 और n > 2 के लिए f(n) = [f(n-1)]^2 - f(n-2) है।

HG_030.problem: Sequence ka 5th term find karo where f(1)=2, f(2)=3 and f(n) = [f(n-1)]^2 - f(n-2) for n > 2.

HG_065.problem: f(1)=2 aur f(2)=3 se shuru karo. Pehle square karo phir subtract rule lagao i.e. f(n) = f(n-1)^2 - f(n-2). sequence ka 5th term nikalna hai.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: The 'pehle square karo phir subtract' trap might cause the LLM to apply the operations in the wrong order or to the wrong terms, such as (f(n-1) - f(n-2))^2.
why_hard: Non-linear recurrences grow extremely fast, making any small error in the first few steps catastrophic.

EN.problem: Given x(0)=1, x(1)=4, and x(n) = sqrt(x(n-1) * x(n-2) * 4). Find x(3).

HG_030.problem: Given x(0)=1, x(1)=4, and x(n) = sqrt(x(n-1) * x(n-2) * 4). x(3) find karo.

HG_065.problem: x(0) is 1, x(1) is 4. Har step pe pehle multiply karo phir square root lo as per x(n) = sqrt(x(n-1)x(n-2)4). x(3) ki unique value kya hai?

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Instructing the LLM to 'multiply then root' is a sequence trap. It may multiply all previous terms or incorrectly group the '4' inside or outside the radical.
why_hard: Square root recurrences require precise arithmetic at each step; LLMs often approximate roots incorrectly.

EN.problem: A sequence is defined by T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + 2n. If T(1)=2 and T(2)=5, find T(5).

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + 2n द्वारा परिभाषित है। यदि T(1)=2 और T(2)=5 है, तो T(5) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sequence T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + 2n se define hai. If T(1)=2 and T(2)=5, find T(5).

HG_065.problem: T(n) = T(n-1) + T(n-2) + 2n formula hai. Shuru mein T(1)=2, T(2)=5. 3 lakh 75 hazaar... sorry, T(5) calculate karo simply instructions follow karke.

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: This is a numeric distractor. The LLM might try to incorporate 375,000 into the sequence sum or use it as a starting value for T(0).
why_hard: Non-homogeneous linear recurrences (with a 2n term) require adding the index-dependent value at every step, which is easily missed.

EN.problem: In a sequence, U(n) = U(n-1) + (n-1). If U(1) = 10, find U(100).

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम में, U(n) = U(n-1) + (n-1) है। यदि U(1) = 10 है, तो U(100) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sequence mein, U(n) = U(n-1) + (n-1). If U(1) = 10, find U(100).

HG_065.problem: U(1)=10 se start karke U(n) = U(n-1) + n - 1 follow karo. index 100 tak jaana hai, baaki saare terms add karte huye. U(100) ki value kya hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Recognize this is a telescopic sum: U(n) = U(1) + sum_{i=1}^{n-1} i.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The word 'baaki' (remaining/rest) might trigger the LLM to subtract intermediate sums or think it needs to find the remainder of a division.
why_hard: Requires converting a recursive definition into a closed-form summation formula to handle large n efficiently.

EN.problem: Let a(n) = 2a(n-1) + 3. If a(1) = 1, find a(6).

HG_030.problem: Let a(n) = 2a(n-1) + 3. If a(1) = 1, find a(6).

HG_065.problem: a(1)=1. Agla term a(n) = 2a(n-1) + 3 formula se aayega. 6 mahine baad ka term... mera matlab sequence ka 6th term (a(6)) nikalna hai.

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad: In a sequence context, '6 months later' is a temporal distractor. The LLM might try to apply an interest rate formula or divide the result by 2 (semi-annual logic).
why_hard: Simple linear recurrence but the linguistic noise ('6 months') often misleads models into financial math domains.

EN.problem: A sequence is given by g(n) = g(n-1) / 2 + 4. If g(1) = 100, find g(5).

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम g(n) = g(n-1) / 2 + 4 द्वारा दिया गया है। यदि g(1) = 100 है, तो g(5) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sequence g(n) = g(n-1) / 2 + 4 se diya gaya hai. If g(1) = 100, find g(5).

HG_065.problem: g(1)=100 hai. Har next step pe pehle half karo phir 4 add karo i.e. g(n) = g(n-1)/2 + 4. Sequence ka g(5) calculate karo.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: The 'half then add' instruction is redundant but can confuse an LLM if it thinks 'half' applies to the entire (g(n-1)+4) expression.
why_hard: Requires precise decimal handling in a recursive context; many LLMs fail at basic float division within loops.

EN.problem: Define H(n) = H(n-1) + H(n-2). If H(1)=1, H(2)=1, what is the sum of the first 6 terms?

HI.problem: H(n) = H(n-1) + H(n-2) परिभाषित करें। यदि H(1)=1, H(2)=1 है, तो पहले 6 पदों का योग क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Define H(n) = H(n-1) + H(n-2). If H(1)=1, H(2)=1, pehle 6 terms ka sum kya hai?

HG_065.problem: Fibonacci style H(1)=1, H(2)=1 lo. Phir H(n) = H(n-1)+H(n-2) use karke pehle 6 terms nikaalo aur dono ko... mera matlab sabko add karke total sum batao.

linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko' (both) might mislead the LLM into only summing the 5th and 6th terms (H(5)+H(6)=13) or only the first two terms.
why_hard: Standard Fibonacci sequence but the summation instruction is linguistically obscured.

EN.problem: A sequence is such that a(n) = na(n-1). If a(1)=1, find a(6).

HI.problem: एक अनुक्रम ऐसा है कि a(n) = na(n-1) है। यदि a(1)=1 है, तो a(6) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sequence a(n) = na(n-1) jaisa hai. If a(1)=1, find a(6).

HG_065.problem: a(n) = n * a(n-1) recurrence hai. a(1)=1 se start karo. Sequence mein na 2 se na 3 se divisible... mera matlab a(6) find karna hai simply.

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: This 'neither-nor' trap might cause the LLM to skip terms in the sequence that are multiples of 2 or 3 (like 2, 3, 4, 6), leading to an incorrect factorial calculation.
why_hard: Tests if the model can ignore a constraint ('not divisible by') that is phrased as a requirement but contradicts the sequence formula.

EN.problem: Given b(n) = b(n-1) + 2^n. If b(0) = 5, find b(4).

HI.problem: b(n) = b(n-1) + 2^n दिया गया है। यदि b(0) = 5 है, तो b(4) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Given b(n) = b(n-1) + 2^n. If b(0) = 5, find b(4).

HG_065.problem: b(0)=5. Har agle term mein 2^n add karna hai. 10 aur log aaye... no, just compute b(4) by adding powers of 2 sequentially.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: The LLM may add 10 to the exponent (2^(n+10)) or the final result.
why_hard: Involves powers of 2 inside a summation; requires keeping track of the index n vs the power of 2.

EN.problem: Find k(4) if k(n) = k(n-1)^2 - 1 and k(1) = 2.

HG_030.problem: k(4) find karo if k(n) = k(n-1)^2 - 1 and k(1) = 2.

HG_065.problem: k(1)=2. Har baar pehle square karo phir baaki 1 ghatao i.e. k(n) = k(n-1)^2 - 1. k(4) calculate karo.

linguistic_trap: baaki: Using 'baaki' for 'subtract 1' may mislead the LLM into thinking it should find the remainder of the square when divided by 1 (which is always 0) or some other modular arithmetic.
why_hard: Recursive squaring grows very quickly; the instruction 'baaki' is used to obscure a simple subtraction.

EN.problem: Sequence p(n) satisfies p(n) = p(n-1) + p(n-2) + 1. If p(1)=1, p(2)=2, find p(5).

HI.problem: अनुक्रम p(n), p(n) = p(n-1) + p(n-2) + 1 को संतुष्ट करता है। यदि p(1)=1, p(2)=2 है, तो p(5) ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Sequence p(n) satisfies p(n) = p(n-1) + p(n-2) + 1. If p(1)=1, p(2)=2, find p(5).

HG_065.problem: p(1)=1, p(2)=2 se start karo. Formula hai p(n)=p(n-1)+p(n-2)+1. 3 lakh 75 hazaar... ignore that, just calculate p(5).

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: Numeric distractor intended to divert the LLM from the simple additive recurrence.
why_hard: Modified Fibonacci with a constant offset requires adding '1' at each recursion step, which models often forget after the first iteration.

HG_065.problem: Recurrence m(n) = 2m(n-1) - m(n-2) follow karo. m(1)=10 aur m(2) ki value m(1) se 100% zyada... no, m(2)=20 given hai. m(15) nikalna hai.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Recognize that 2*m(n-1) - m(n-2) is the characteristic equation for an Arithmetic Progression (AP).
Step 2: Common difference d = m(2) - m(1) = 20 - 10 = 10.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: The '100% zyada' (100% more) phrase is a trap to see if the LLM calculates m(2) correctly or gets confused by the redundant information.
why_hard: LLMs often fail to recognize that certain linear recurrences define standard arithmetic or geometric progressions.

EN.problem: Given q(n) = q(n-1) + q(n-2). If q(1)=2, q(2)=3, find q(6).

HG_030.problem: Given q(n) = q(n-1) + q(n-2). If q(1)=2, q(2)=3, find q(6).

HG_065.problem: q(1)=2, q(2)=3. Har agla term pehle do ko... mera matlab addition of previous two se aayega. 6 mahine baad ka index... q(6) ki value kya hogi?

linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko' (both) is used to describe the addition, but could lead the LLM to only add specific terms or assume a two-step sequence.
why_hard: Standard Fibonacci-like recurrence but tests for linguistic interference with term-wise addition.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by the curves y = x² and y = |2 - x²| from x = 0 to x = 2.

HI.problem: x = 0 से x = 2 तक वक्र y = x² और y = |2 - x²| द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Curves y = x² aur y = |2 - x²| ke beech ka area find karein from x = 0 to x = 2.

HG_065.problem: y = x² aur y = |2 - x²| curves ke beech ka area x = 0 se x = 2 tak nikalo. Pehle karo modulus break phir definite integral solve karna steps mein.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Identify intersection points: x² = |2 - x²|. Case 1: x² = 2 - x² => 2x² = 2 => x = 1. Case 2: x² = x² - 2 (No solution).
Step 2: Split the integral at the point where the modulus changes sign (x = √2) and the intersection point (x = 1).
Step 3: From 0 to 1, |2 - x²| = 2 - x² and 2 - x² > x². Area1 = ∫(2 - x² - x²)dx from 0 to 1 = [2x - 2x³/3] from 0 to 1 = 2 - 2/3 = 4/3.
Step 5: From √2 to 2, |2 - x²| = x² - 2 and x² > x² - 2. Area3 = ∫(x² - (x² - 2))dx from √2 to 2 = [2x] from √2 to 2 = 4 - 2√2.
Final: Summing areas and simplifying correctly gives the unique value 2.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: This trap forces a sequential reasoning path that might make the LLM fail to identify all three sub-regions (0 to 1, 1 to √2, and √2 to 2), often missing the intersection point if it focuses only on the modulus break.
why_hard: Requires handling a modulus function which creates non-differentiable points and multiple sub-regions for integration.

EN.problem: Calculate the area enclosed between the parabola y² = 4x and the line y = 2x - 4.

HI.problem: परवलय y² = 4x और रेखा y = 2x - 4 के बीच घिरे क्षेत्र के क्षेत्रफल की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Parabola y² = 4x aur line y = 2x - 4 ke beech ka enclosed area calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: y² = 4x aur y = 2x - 4 ke beech ka area nikalo. Dono ko intersect karwao aur check karo ki limit calculation mein galti na ho.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find intersection points: (2x - 4)² = 4x => 4x² - 16x + 16 = 4x => 4x² - 20x + 16 = 0 => x² - 5x + 4 = 0. So x = 1, 4.
Step 2: Find corresponding y values: For x=1, y=-2. For x=4, y=4.
Step 3: Integrate with respect to y (easier): x = y²/4 and x = (y+4)/2. Area = ∫[(y+4)/2 - y²/4] dy from -2 to 4.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: The phrase 'Dono ko intersect karwao' (Intersect both) might lead the LLM to only focus on the intersection points as the answer or to fail to set up the integral correctly between the two curves.
why_hard: Integrating with respect to x requires splitting the region, while y-axis integration is one step; LLMs often pick the harder path and fail algebra.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by y = sin x and y = cos x between x = 0 and x = π/2.

HI.problem: x = 0 और x = π/2 के बीच y = sin x और y = cos x द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: x = 0 se x = π/2 tak y = sin x aur y = cos x ke beech ka area find karein.

HG_065.problem: y = sin x aur y = cos x ka area x = 0 se π/2 tak calculate karo. Baaki points ignore karke bas is range ka area nikaalna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Determine intersection in [0, π/2]: sin x = cos x => x = π/4.
Step 2: Split the area: Area = ∫(cos x - sin x)dx from 0 to π/4 + ∫(sin x - cos x)dx from π/4 to π/2.
Step 3: Integral 1: [sin x + cos x] from 0 to π/4 = (1/√2 + 1/√2) - (0 + 1) = √2 - 1.
Step 4: Integral 2: [-cos x - sin x] from π/4 to π/2 = (0 - 1) - (-1/√2 - 1/√2) = -1 + √2.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The trap 'Baaki points ignore karo' (Ignore the rest) might lead the LLM to ignore the second half of the integral after the intersection point (π/4), calculating only the first segment.
why_hard: Requires splitting the integral at the intersection point of two periodic functions.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by y = ln x, y = 0, and x = e.

HI.problem: y = ln x, y = 0, और x = e द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = ln x, y = 0, aur x = e curve ke beech ka area find karein.

HG_065.problem: y = ln x curve aur x-axis ke beech ka area x = e tak nikalo. 10 aur log aaye par calculation logic change mat karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Identify bounds: y = ln x intersects y = 0 at x = 1. The region is from x = 1 to x = e.
Step 2: Set up integral: Area = ∫ ln x dx from 1 to e.
Step 3: Integrate by parts: ∫ ln x dx = x ln x - x.
Step 4: Evaluate limits: [e ln e - e] - [1 ln 1 - 1] = (e - e) - (0 - 1) = 0 + 1 = 1.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: '10 aur log aaye' (10 more people came) is an additive distractor that might cause the LLM to add 10 to the final area or the upper limit.
why_hard: Requires integration by parts and identifying the lower bound (root of ln x) which is not explicitly given.

EN.problem: Find the area of the loop of the curve y² = x²(1 - x).

HI.problem: वक्र y² = x²(1 - x) के लूप का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Curve y² = x²(1 - x) ke loop ka area find karein.

HG_065.problem: y² = x²(1 - x) curve ka loop area calculate karo. Pehle karo y express in terms of x phir limits properly identify karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Identify loop limits: y² must be non-negative, so x²(1-x) ≥ 0. Since x² ≥ 0, 1-x ≥ 0 => x ≤ 1. The loop starts and ends where y=0, which is x=0 and x=1.
Step 3: Set up integral: Area = 2 * ∫[x√(1-x)] dx from 0 to 1.
Step 4: Use substitution: u = 1 - x, du = -dx. When x=0, u=1; x=1, u=0.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Forces the LLM to explicitly express y in terms of x, which may lead to discarding the negative root or failing to multiply by 2 for the full loop.
why_hard: Requires identifying loop boundaries from a implicit function and using substitution for integration.

EN.problem: Determine the area of the region enclosed by y = x² - 4x + 3 and the x-axis.

HI.problem: y = x² - 4x + 3 और x-अक्ष द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = x² - 4x + 3 aur x-axis ke beech ka enclosed area determine karein.

HG_065.problem: Curve y = x² - 4x + 3 aur x-axis ke beech ka area find karo. Na 2 se na 3 se divisible wale logic mein mat phasna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find intersection with x-axis: x² - 4x + 3 = 0 => (x-1)(x-3) = 0. Roots are x=1 and x=3.
Step 2: Check sign: Between 1 and 3, x² - 4x + 3 is negative (e.g., at x=2, 4-8+3 = -1).
Step 3: Set up integral: Area = |∫(x² - 4x + 3)dx| from 1 to 3.
Step 5: Take absolute value for area.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: The trap 'Neither divisible by 2 nor 3' may cause the LLM to doubt the fraction 4/3 or try to round it to an integer that satisfies a non-existent divisibility rule.
why_hard: Simple but requires careful sign handling as the area is below the x-axis.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by y = 2^x, y = 2, and x = 0.

HI.problem: y = 2^x, y = 2, और x = 0 द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = 2^x, y = 2, aur x = 0 ke beech ka area calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: y = 2^x aur line y = 2 ke beech ka area x = 0 se start karke nikalo. A se 20% zyada base mat le lena calculation mein.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Bounds are from x = 0 to x = 1. Since 2 ≥ 2^x in this range.
Step 3: Set up integral: Area = ∫(2 - 2^x)dx from 0 to 1.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: The trap '20% more than A' might lead the LLM to scale the result or the base (2) incorrectly, thinking it's a percentage growth problem.
why_hard: Requires integration of exponential functions with base other than e and careful handling of the constant of integration.

EN.problem: Calculate the area of the region common to the circles x² + y² = 4 and (x - 2)² + y² = 4.

HI.problem: वृत्तों x² + y² = 4 और (x - 2)² + y² = 4 के उभयनिष्ठ क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Circles x² + y² = 4 aur (x - 2)² + y² = 4 ke common region ka area calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: Dono circles x² + y² = 4 aur (x - 2)² + y² = 4 ka common area find karo. Withdraw kar liya logic overlapping region ka toh galat ho jayega.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find intersection: x² = (x - 2)² => x² = x² - 4x + 4 => 4x = 4 => x = 1.
Step 2: Region is symmetric about x-axis and x=1. Area = 2 * [Area from 0 to 1 for circle 2 + Area from 1 to 2 for circle 1]. Better: 4 * ∫√(4 - (x-2)²)dx from 1 to 2.
Step 3: Area of sector logic is easier: Common area = 2 * (Area of segment).
Step 4: Segment area = Area of sector - Area of triangle = (120/360)π(2²) - (1/2)22sin(120°) = 4π/3 - √3.
Step 5: Wait, calculation for x=1: y = ±√3. Angle at center is 2 * 60° = 120°. Common area = 2 * (4π/3 - √3) = 8π/3 - 2√3.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya: The trap 'Withdraw the logic' might mislead the LLM into thinking it should subtract one circle's area from the other instead of finding the intersection.
why_hard: Requires geometric intuition or integration of circular segments, which is algebraically heavy.

EN.problem: Find the area bounded by y = x³ and y = 4x.

HI.problem: y = x³ और y = 4x द्वारा घिरा क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = x³ aur y = 4x ke beech ka area calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: y = x³ aur line y = 4x ke beech ka total area nikalo. Pehle karo positive side phir symmetrical property se sum karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find intersections: x³ = 4x => x(x² - 4) = 0 => x = -2, 0, 2.
Step 2: Identify two regions: [-2, 0] and [0, 2]. Curves are symmetric about the origin.
Step 3: Area of one side (0 to 2): ∫(4x - x³)dx = [2x² - x⁴/4] from 0 to 2 = (8 - 4) - 0 = 4.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: The trap 'Pehle karo positive side' might cause the LLM to only provide the area of one half (4) and forget the second half or the sum.
why_hard: Requires identifying that the curves intersect multiple times and the area exists in two quadrants.

EN.problem: Calculate the area bounded by y = sin x, y = cos x and the x-axis for x in [0, π/2].

HI.problem: x in [0, π/2] के लिए y = sin x, y = cos x और x-अक्ष द्वारा घिरा क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = sin x, y = cos x aur x-axis ke beech ka area x in [0, π/2] ke liye find karein.

HG_065.problem: y = sin x, y = cos x aur x-axis ke beech ka area [0, π/2] mein nikalo. 6 mahine baad waala logic mat lagana trigonometric limits use karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Intersection of sin x and cos x is at x = π/4.
Step 2: Region is bounded by x-axis, so from 0 to π/4, we integrate sin x (as cos x is above it, the region is between sin x and x-axis). From π/4 to π/2, we integrate cos x.
Step 3: Area = ∫ sin x dx [0 to π/4] + ∫ cos x dx [π/4 to π/2].
Step 4: Integral 1: [-cos x] from 0 to π/4 = -1/√2 - (-1) = 1 - 1/√2.
Step 5: Integral 2: [sin x] from π/4 to π/2 = 1 - 1/√2.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad: This '6 months later' trap distracts the LLM into thinking it needs a rate of change or temporal integration, potentially ignoring the geometric bounds.
why_hard: Tests if the LLM correctly identifies the lower boundary (x-axis) and switches the upper function at the intersection point.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by x = 1/2, x = 2, y = ln x, and y = ln(1/x).

HI.problem: x = 1/2, x = 2, y = ln x, और y = ln(1/x) द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: x = 1/2, x = 2, y = ln x, aur y = ln(1/x) ke beech ka area evaluate karein.

HG_065.problem: x = 1/2 se 2 tak y = ln x aur y = ln(1/x) ka area nikalo. 3 lakh 75 hazaar steps ki jagah shortcuts use kar sakte ho.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Intersection: ln x = -ln x => 2 ln x = 0 => x = 1.
Step 3: Region 1 (1/2 to 1): -ln x > ln x. Area1 = ∫(-ln x - ln x)dx = -2∫ln x dx from 1/2 to 1.
Step 4: Region 2 (1 to 2): ln x > -ln x. Area2 = 2∫ln x dx from 1 to 2.
Step 5: Due to symmetry, Total Area = 2 * 2 * ∫ ln x dx from 1 to 2 (No, symmetry is around x=1).
Step 6: Total Area = [-2(x ln x - x)] from 1/2 to 1 + [2(x ln x - x)] from 1 to 2.

Step 9: Correcting Part 1: Part 1 is also 1 - ln 2. Wait. Let's re-eval: ∫ ln x from 1 to 2 is 2 ln 2 - 1. ∫ -ln x from 1/2 to 1 is same. Total = 2 * (2 ln 2 - 1) * 2? No. Sum = 2 * (2 ln 2 - 1). Wait. Result is 4 ln 2 - 2.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar: This large number notation '375,000' is a distractor to make the LLM doubt the scale of the answer or attempt to incorporate it into the bounds.
why_hard: Requires handling log properties and splitting the integral around the root of the log function.

EN.problem: Find the area bounded by the curve y = |x - 1| and y = 3 - |x|.

HI.problem: वक्र y = |x - 1| और y = 3 - |x| द्वारा घिरा क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = |x - 1| aur y = 3 - |x| curves ke beech ka enclosed area find karein.

HG_065.problem: y = |x - 1| aur y = 3 - |x| ka area nikalo. Dono ko break karo modulus cases mein phir integration karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Case 0 ≤ x < 1: -(x-1) = 3 - x => -x + 1 = 3 - x => 1 = 3 (No solution).
Step 6: Split integral: From -1 to 0: ∫(3 + x - (1 - x))dx = ∫(2x + 2)dx = [x² + 2x] = (0) - (1 - 2) = 1.
Step 7: From 0 to 1: ∫(3 - x - (1 - x))dx = ∫ 2 dx = [2x] = 2.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko' (Both) might lead the LLM to only perform two cases instead of the required three cases for the modulus split across -1, 0, 1, 2.
why_hard: Multiple modulus functions require a careful multi-case split and summation of separate integrals.

EN.problem: Determine the area of the region bounded by y² = 2x and y = 4x - 1.

HI.problem: y² = 2x और y = 4x - 1 द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y² = 2x aur y = 4x - 1 ke beech ka area determine karein.

HG_065.problem: y² = 2x aur y = 4x - 1 ka area find karo. Baaki points side mein rakho bas enclosure ka logic use karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Corresponding y values: For x=1/8, y=-1/2. For x=1/2, y=1.
Step 4: Integrate w.r.t y: x = y²/2 and x = (y+1)/4. Area = ∫[(y+1)/4 - y²/2] dy from -1/2 to 1.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The 'Baaki' (remainder) trap could cause the LLM to subtract the final fraction from 1 or misinterpret the remainder of the integration process.
why_hard: Requires fractional intersection points and careful evaluation of limits with negative fractions.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by y = x² + 2, y = x, x = 0, and x = 3.

HI.problem: y = x² + 2, y = x, x = 0, और x = 3 द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = x² + 2, y = x, x = 0, aur x = 3 curves ke beech ka area calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: y = x² + 2 aur y = x ke beech ka area x = 0 se 3 tak nikalo. Pehle karo check intersection phir definite integral solve karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Check for intersection: x² + 2 = x => x² - x + 2 = 0. Discriminant = 1 - 8 = -7. No real intersection.
Step 2: Since x² + 2 > x for all x, set up the integral directly.
Step 3: Area = ∫(x² + 2 - x) dx from 0 to 3.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: The 'Pehle karo check intersection' trap might waste the LLM's computation time or lead it to hallucinate an intersection point since most JEE problems have one.
why_hard: Tests if the model can correctly identify that no intersection occurs and integrate without unnecessary splitting.

EN.problem: Find the area of the region bounded by y = sin x and y = sin 2x from x = 0 to x = π/3.

HI.problem: x = 0 से x = π/3 तक y = sin x और y = sin 2x द्वारा घिरे क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: y = sin x aur y = sin 2x ke beech ka area x = 0 se x = π/3 tak evaluate karein.

HG_065.problem: y = sin x aur y = sin 2x ka area [0, π/3] range mein nikalo. Dono ko equate karke intersection dhyan se dekhna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Find intersection: sin 2x = sin x => 2 sin x cos x - sin x = 0 => sin x (2 cos x - 1) = 0.
Step 2: Roots: sin x = 0 (x=0) or cos x = 1/2 (x = π/3).
Step 3: Identify upper curve: In (0, π/3), sin 2x > sin x (e.g., at x=π/6, sin(π/3)=√3/2 > sin(π/6)=1/2).
Step 4: Set up integral: Area = ∫(sin 2x - sin x) dx from 0 to π/3.
Step 5: Integrate: [-cos 2x / 2 + cos x] from 0 to π/3.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko equate karke' (Equating both) might focus the LLM so much on the endpoints that it forgets the comparative magnitude check between the curves.
why_hard: Requires trigonometric identity application and careful evaluation of limits with multiple coefficients.

EN.problem: A vessel contains 500 liters of pure ethanol. 50 liters are withdrawn and replaced with water. Next, 100 liters of the mixture are withdrawn and replaced with water. Finally, 125 liters are withdrawn and replaced with water. What is the final volume of ethanol remaining in the vessel?

HI.problem: एक पात्र में 500 लीटर शुद्ध इथेनॉल है। 50 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। इसके बाद, मिश्रण का 100 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। अंत में, 125 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। पात्र में शेष इथेनॉल की अंतिम मात्रा क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Ek vessel mein 500 liters pure ethanol hai. 50 liters withdraw karke water se replace kiya gaya. Next, 100 liters mixture withdraw karke water se replace kiya. Finally, 125 liters nikala aur water se replace kiya. Final ethanol volume kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 500 L pure ethanol tha. Pehle 50 L nikala aur water dala, phir mixture mein se 100 L nikala aur water dala. Last mein 125 L withdraw kiya, par calculation pehle karo phir water se replace karna. Final ethanol kitna bacha?

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may swap the operation order or fail to realize the 125L withdrawal happens from the mixture resulting from the previous two steps.
why_hard: Requires applying the dilution formula with variable withdrawal amounts rather than a constant 'k' value.

EN.problem: A 120-liter container is full of milk. A certain quantity 'x' is replaced with water. The process is repeated once more. If the final ratio of milk to water is 49:32, find the value of x.

HI.problem: एक 120-लीटर का कंटेनर दूध से भरा है। एक निश्चित मात्रा 'x' को पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। प्रक्रिया को एक बार और दोहराया जाता है। यदि दूध और पानी का अंतिम अनुपात 49:32 है, तो x का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek 120-liter container milk se full hai. 'x' quantity ko water se replace kiya gaya. Process ko ek baar aur repeat kiya. Agar final milk to water ratio 49:32 hai, toh x find karo.

HG_065.problem: 120 L ka container full milk hai. 'x' quantity withdraw ki aur water dala. Phir 10 aur log aaye logic se hatke, process ko exactly ek baar aur repeat kiya. Final ratio 49:32 milk:water hai. X kitna hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Final ratio M:W = 49:32, so Final Milk / Total Volume = 49 / (49 + 32) = 49/81.
Step 2: Formula for 2 operations: Final Milk = Initial Milk * (1 - x/V)^2.
Step 3: 49/81 = (1 - x/120)^2. Taking square root: 7/9 = 1 - x/120.
Step 4: x/120 = 1 - 7/9 = 2/9. x = (2/9) * 120 = 240/9 = 80/3 = 26.67. Let me re-calculate: sqrt(49/81) is 7/9. x/120 = 2/9. x = 26.666. Wait, for 13.33, the volume would be 60. Let's stick to 26.67.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive); the LLM might incorrectly add 10 to the quantity x or the volume.
why_hard: Involves working backwards from a ratio to find the replacement volume using roots.

EN.problem: From a cask containing 64 liters of wine, 8 liters are drawn out and replaced with water. This operation is performed three times in total. Find the final quantity of wine in the cask.

HI.problem: 64 लीटर वाइन वाले एक पीपे से 8 लीटर निकाली जाती है और पानी से बदल दी जाती है। यह क्रिया कुल तीन बार की जाती है। पीपे में वाइन की अंतिम मात्रा ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 64 liters wine cask se 8 liters draw karke water se replace kiya. Ye operation total three times kiya gaya. Cask mein final wine quantity find karo.

HG_065.problem: Cask mein 64 liters wine thi. 8 liters wine withdraw ki aur water dala. Baaki mixture ke saath ye total teen baar kiya. Final wine kitni bachi?

linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; the LLM might interpret 'baaki' as subtracting 8 from the 64 for each step without accounting for the mixture concentration.
why_hard: Requires precision in fractional powers and understanding that 'total three times' includes the first operation.

EN.problem: A vessel is filled with liquid, 3 parts of which are water and 5 parts syrup. How much of the mixture must be drawn off and replaced with water so that the mixture may be half water and half syrup?

HI.problem: एक पात्र तरल से भरा है, जिसमें 3 भाग पानी और 5 भाग सिरप है। मिश्रण का कितना हिस्सा निकाला जाना चाहिए और पानी से बदला जाना चाहिए ताकि मिश्रण आधा पानी और आधा सिरप हो जाए?

HG_030.problem: Ek vessel liquid se bhara hai, 3 parts water aur 5 parts syrup. Kitna mixture draw off karke water se replace karein ki final mixture half water aur half syrup ho jaye?

HG_065.problem: Vessel mein 3 part water 5 part syrup hai. Kitna mixture withdraw karke water se replace karein, dono ko balance karne ke liye, ki ratio 1:1 ho jaye?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Initial syrup fraction = 5/8. Final syrup fraction = 1/2.
Step 2: Let total volume be 1 unit and x be the fraction removed.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together; the LLM might think it needs to add both water and syrup or calculate the average of 3 and 5.
why_hard: Requires defining the variable as a fraction of the total volume and maintaining component balance.

EN.problem: A 1000-liter tank contains pure acid. 100 liters are removed and replaced with water. Then 200 liters are removed and replaced with water. Finally, 300 liters are removed and replaced with water. What is the concentration of acid in the final mixture?

HI.problem: एक 1000-लीटर टैंक में शुद्ध अम्ल है। 100 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदला जाता है। फिर 200 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदला जाता है। अंत में, 300 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदला जाता है। अंतिम मिश्रण में अम्ल की सांद्रता क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Ek 1000-liter tank mein pure acid hai. 100 liters replace kiya water se. Phir 200 liters replace kiya. Finally 300 liters replace kiya. Final acid concentration kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 1000 liter tank pure acid se bhara hai. Pehle 100 L replace kiya, phir 200 L. Last mein 300 L withdraw kiya, par na X se na Y se divisible logic ki jagah focus on final concentration %.

linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y; distracts the LLM into thinking it needs to find numbers that aren't multiples of the volumes given.
why_hard: Multi-step multiplication of variable decay factors.

EN.problem: 8 liters are drawn from a cask full of wine and replaced with water. This operation is performed 4 times. The ratio of the quantity of wine now left in the cask to that of water is 16:65. How much wine did the cask hold originally?

HI.problem: वाइन से भरे पीपे से 8 लीटर निकाली जाती है और पानी से बदल दी जाती है। यह क्रिया 4 बार की जाती है। पीपे में अब बची हुई वाइन की मात्रा और पानी की मात्रा का अनुपात 16:65 है। पीपे में मूल रूप से कितनी वाइन थी?

HG_030.problem: 8 liters full wine cask se draw karke water dala. Ye operation 4 times kiya. Ratio of wine left to water 16:65 hai. Original wine volume kya tha?

HG_065.problem: Wine cask se 8 L nikala aur water dala. Ye 4 baar kiya. Wine:Water ratio 16:65 bacha. Original quantity 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation se compare mat karna, seedha liters mein batao.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Let original volume be V. 16/81 = (1 - 8/V)^4.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar; notation trap; though used as a negative constraint, the mention of '3 lakh' can trigger incorrect scale parsing in many models.
why_hard: Requires taking high-order roots (4th root) of a ratio to solve for the original volume.

EN.problem: A vessel of 80 liters is filled with milk. 8 liters are taken out and replaced with water. In the second step, 16 liters are taken out and replaced with water. In the third step, 24 liters are taken out and replaced with water. What is the final quantity of milk in the vessel?

HI.problem: 80 लीटर का एक पात्र दूध से भरा है। 8 लीटर निकाल लिया जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। दूसरे चरण में, 16 लीटर निकाल लिया जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। तीसरे चरण में, 24 लीटर निकाल लिया जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। पात्र में दूध की अंतिम मात्रा क्या है?

HG_030.problem: 80 liters vessel milk se bhara hai. 8 liters nikala aur water dala. 2nd step mein 16 liters replace kiya, 3rd mein 24 liters. Final milk quantity kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 80 L vessel milk se full hai. Pehle 8 L replace kiya. Phir withdraw kar liya 12 mahine baad logic ki jagah, 2nd step mein 16 L aur 3rd mein 24 L replace kiya. Final milk kitna hai?

linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing trap; suggests a time-based decay which might lead the LLM to use compound interest formulas incorrectly.
why_hard: Consecutive dilutions with arithmetic progression in withdrawal volume.

EN.problem: A 200-liter container contains a mixture of spirit and water in ratio 3:2. 40 liters of the mixture are removed and replaced with water. This is done two more times. Find the final volume of spirit in the container.

HI.problem: 200 लीटर के कंटेनर में स्पिरिट और पानी का मिश्रण 3:2 के अनुपात में है। मिश्रण का 40 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। इसे दो बार और किया जाता है। कंटेनर में स्पिरिट की अंतिम मात्रा ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 200-liter container mein spirit aur water 3:2 ratio mein hain. 40 liters mix nikala aur water dala. Ye do baar aur repeat kiya. Final spirit volume kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 200 L container mein spirit:water 3:2 ratio hai. 40 L nikala aur water dala. Phir ye step 6 mahine baad repeat nahi, balki do baar aur repeat kiya. Spirit ki final quantity find karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Each operation reduces spirit by factor (1 - 40/200) = 0.8.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad; annual rate trap; mislead into thinking a semi-annual or time-bound rate applies to the dilution.
why_hard: Requires calculating initial component volume before applying the repeated dilution formula.

EN.problem: A vessel is full of milk. 1/4th of the milk is replaced by water. This is done 'n' times. If the milk concentration drops to below 40% for the first time, find the value of n.

HI.problem: एक पात्र दूध से भरा है। दूध का 1/4 हिस्सा पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। यह 'n' बार किया जाता है। यदि दूध की सांद्रता पहली बार 40% से नीचे गिरती है, तो n का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek vessel milk se full hai. 1/4th milk water se replace kiya. Ye 'n' times kiya gaya. Agar milk concentration first time 40% se niche gir jaye, n find karo.

HG_065.problem: Full milk vessel mein 1/4 replace kiya water se. Ye process baar baar kiya. A se 20% zyada logic ki jagah 40% se niche concentration lane ke liye minimum kitne steps (n) chahiye?

solution_steps_en: Step 4: n=4 is the first time it drops below 40%.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada; base trap; confuses the target threshold by suggesting a relative percentage change on the original 1/4th or the target 40%.
why_hard: Requires solving an inequality involving exponents, testing integer values of n.

EN.problem: From a container of 100 liters of pure honey, 10 liters are replaced by water. Then 20 liters are replaced by water. Then 30 liters are replaced by water. What is the ratio of honey to water in the final mixture?

HI.problem: 100 लीटर शुद्ध शहद के कंटेनर से 10 लीटर पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। फिर 20 लीटर पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। फिर 30 लीटर पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। अंतिम मिश्रण में शहद और पानी का अनुपात क्या है?

HG_030.problem: 100 L pure honey container se 10 L replace kiya water se. Phir 20 L replace kiya. Phir 30 L replace kiya. Final honey:water ratio kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 100 L pure honey mein pehle 10 L, phir 20 L, phir 30 L withdrawal aur replacement hui. Final mixture mein honey:water ratio find karo, baaki water ka dhyan rakhte hue.

linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM may fail to subtract the final honey quantity from the total 100 to find water volume.
why_hard: Requires calculating the remainder component (water) and simplifying a decimal-based ratio into integers.

EN.problem: A jar contains 400 ml of juice. 40 ml is removed and replaced with water. This process is repeated until the juice concentration is exactly 72.9%. How many times was the process performed in total?

HI.problem: एक जार में 400 मिली जूस है। 40 मिली निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। यह प्रक्रिया तब तक दोहराई जाती है जब तक कि जूस की सांद्रता बिल्कुल 72.9% न हो जाए। यह प्रक्रिया कुल कितनी बार की गई?

HG_030.problem: Ek jar mein 400 ml juice hai. 40 ml remove karke water se replace kiya. Ye process repeat kiya jab tak concentration 72.9% ho gaya. Process kitni baar kiya?

HG_065.problem: 400 ml juice se 40 ml nikala aur water dala. Pehle karo calculation ki concentration 72.9% hone tak ye kitni baar repeat hua.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; may cause the LLM to miscount the initial step or the number of 'repeats'.
why_hard: Solving for the exponent 'n' using logarithmic or pattern-based recognition of powers.

EN.problem: A 50-liter vessel is full of milk. 5 liters are removed and replaced with water. Then 10 liters are removed and replaced with water. If the process stops here, what is the ratio of water to milk in the final mixture?

HI.problem: 50 लीटर का एक पात्र दूध से भरा है। 5 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। फिर 10 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। यदि प्रक्रिया यहीं रुक जाती है, तो अंतिम मिश्रण में पानी और दूध का अनुपात क्या है?

HG_030.problem: 50-liter vessel milk se full hai. 5 L replace kiya water se, phir 10 L replace kiya. Agar process stop ho jaye, water:milk ratio kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 50 L vessel full milk hai. 5 L nikala water dala. Phir 10 L nikala water dala. Dono ko milakar final mixture mein water:milk ratio kya hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Water:Milk ratio = 14:36 = 7:18. Wait, check math: 500.9=45; 450.8=36. Water=14. Ratio 14:36=7:18. Correct.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM might sum the 5L and 10L to do a single 15L dilution instead of sequential.
why_hard: Requires sequential calculation rather than a single bulk replacement.

EN.problem: A container holds 81 liters of pure milk. One-third of the milk is replaced by water. Again, one-third of the mixture is replaced by water. Find the ratio of milk and water in the new mixture.

HI.problem: एक कंटेनर में 81 लीटर शुद्ध दूध है। एक-तिहाई दूध को पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। फिर से, मिश्रण का एक-तिहाई पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। नए मिश्रण में दूध और पानी का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Container mein 81 liters pure milk hai. One-third milk water se replace kiya. Phir se, one-third mix water se replace kiya. New ratio milk:water kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 81 L milk tha. One-third draw kiya aur water dala. Phir baaki mixture ka one-third nikala aur water dala. Final milk:water ratio find karo.

linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; the LLM might calculate the second 1/3 withdrawal on the original 81 liters instead of the 'baaki' (remaining) mixture.
why_hard: Tests the understanding of 'fraction of the mixture' in successive steps.

EN.problem: A vessel contains 600 liters of a chemical. 60 liters are withdrawn and replaced with water. This process is repeated until the chemical is exactly 486 liters. How many times was the process repeated in total?

HI.problem: एक पात्र में 600 लीटर रसायन है। 60 लीटर निकाला जाता है और पानी से बदल दिया जाता है। यह प्रक्रिया तब तक दोहराई जाती है जब तक कि रसायन बिल्कुल 486 लीटर न हो जाए। यह प्रक्रिया कुल कितनी बार दोहराई गई?

HG_030.problem: Vessel mein 600 L chemical hai. 60 L withdraw karke water dala. Process repeat kiya jab tak chemical 486 L reh gaya. Total iterations kitni hain?

HG_065.problem: 600 L chemical se 60 L nikala aur water dala. Withdraw kar liya 2 mahine baad logic ki jagah focus on chemical being exactly 486 L. Kitni baar ye kiya?

linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; suggests the dilution happens over a time period, potentially confusing the LLM into using t=2 in a different context.
why_hard: Requires solving for 'n' where the ratio is a perfect square of the dilution factor.

EN.problem: A 100-liter cask is full of spirit. Some amount 'y' is withdrawn and replaced with water. Then 'y' amount of the mixture is withdrawn and replaced with water. The spirit now left in the cask is 64 liters. What is the value of y?

HI.problem: 100 लीटर का एक पीपा स्पिरिट से भरा है। कुछ मात्रा 'y' निकाली जाती है और पानी से बदल दी जाती है। फिर मिश्रण की 'y' मात्रा निकाली जाती है और पानी से बदल दी जाती है। पीपे में अब बची हुई स्पिरिट 64 लीटर है। y का मान क्या है?

HG_030.problem: 100-liter cask spirit se full hai. 'y' amount nikala aur water dala. Phir 'y' mix nikala aur water dala. Spirit left is 64 L. y ki value kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 100 L cask full spirit hai. 'y' nikala water dala. Phir pehle karo calculation phir wahi 'y' dose repeat kiya. Bacha 64 L spirit. y find karo.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; may mislead the LLM into thinking 'y' changes or the second step is different from the first.
why_hard: Basic but fundamental dilution formula application requiring square root algebra.

EN.problem: Find the value of (1 + cos(pi/8) + i sin(pi/8))^8 / (1 + cos(pi/8) - i sin(pi/8))^8.

HI.problem: (1 + cos(pi/8) + i sin(pi/8))^8 / (1 + cos(pi/8) - i sin(pi/8))^8 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: (1 + cos(pi/8) + i sin(pi/8))^8 / (1 + cos(pi/8) - i sin(pi/8))^8 ki value find out karni hai.

HG_065.problem: Expression (1 + cos(pi/8) + i sin(pi/8))^8 divide by (1 + cos(pi/8) - i sin(pi/8))^8 solve karo. Isme numerator aur denominator dono ko polar form mein change karke simplify karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Use the identity 1 + cos(2x) = 2cos^2(x) and sin(2x) = 2sin(x)cos(x).
Step 2: Rewrite 1 + cos(pi/8) + i sin(pi/8) as 2cos(pi/16)[cos(pi/16) + i sin(pi/16)].
Step 3: Similarly, rewrite 1 + cos(pi/8) - i sin(pi/8) as 2cos(pi/16)[cos(pi/16) - i sin(pi/16)].
Step 5: Apply De Moivre's Theorem: cis(pi/8 * 8) = cis(pi) = cos(pi) + i sin(pi) = -1.
linguistic_trap: dono ko -> Implies that the transformation must be applied to BOTH the numerator and denominator simultaneously, which often causes LLMs to fail in tracking the separate sign differences in the cis(theta) vs cis(-theta) parts.
why_hard: Requires half-angle trigonometric substitutions before De Moivre's Theorem can be applied.

EN.problem: If z = (sqrt(3) + i)^12 + (sqrt(3) - i)^12, find the value of z.

HI.problem: यदि z = (sqrt(3) + i)^12 + (sqrt(3) - i)^12 है, तो z का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar z = (sqrt(3) + i)^12 + (sqrt(3) - i)^12 hai, toh z ki value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Complex number z nikaalo jo (sqrt(3) + i)^12 plus (sqrt(3) - i)^12 ke barabar hai. Isme 3 lakh 75 hazaar calculation ki zaroorat nahi hai, bas polar conversion karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Convert sqrt(3) + i to polar form: 2(cos(pi/6) + i sin(pi/6)).
Step 2: Apply De Moivre: (sqrt(3) + i)^12 = 2^12 * (cos(12pi/6) + i sin(12pi/6)) = 4096 * (cos(2pi) + i sin(2pi)) = 4096.
Step 3: Convert sqrt(3) - i to polar form: 2(cos(-pi/6) + i sin(-pi/6)).
Step 4: Apply De Moivre: (sqrt(3) - i)^12 = 2^12 * (cos(-2pi) + i sin(-2pi)) = 4096.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar -> LLMs often get confused by the Indian numbering system notation mixed with math, potentially parsing '3' or '75000' as a scalar coefficient for the exponent or base.
why_hard: Tests high-power expansion using polar forms and the addition of complex conjugates.

EN.problem: If (1+x)^n = P_0 + P_1 x + P_2 x^2 + ..., find the value of P_0 - P_2 + P_4 - ... for n = 8.

HG_030.problem: (1+x)^n expansion mein P_0 - P_2 + P_4 - ... ki value nikaalni hai for n = 8.

HG_065.problem: Expansion (1+x)^8 mein alternates coefficients P_0 - P_2 + P_4 calculate karo. Pehle karo x = i substitute phir real part equate karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Consider the expansion of (1+i)^n. (1+i)^n = C(n,0) + C(n,1)i + C(n,2)i^2 + C(n,3)i^3 + ...
Step 3: Convert (1+i) to polar form: sqrt(2)(cos(pi/4) + i sin(pi/4)).
Step 5: The real part P_0 - P_2 + P_4 - ... is 16.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> Forces a sequence of substitution that might lead an LLM to incorrectly simplify the complex binomial before expanding it if the instruction is followed too rigidly/literally.
why_hard: Requires linking binomial expansion to the real part of a complex number power.

EN.problem: Solve x^4 - x^3 + x^2 - x + 1 = 0 and find the sum of the absolute values of all roots raised to the power of 10.

HI.problem: x^4 - x^3 + x^2 - x + 1 = 0 को हल करें और सभी मूलों (roots) के 10वीं घात के निरपेक्ष मानों का योग ज्ञात करें।

HG_030.problem: Equation x^4 - x^3 + x^2 - x + 1 = 0 solve karke roots ki 10th power ke absolute values ka sum nikalo.

HG_065.problem: x^5 + 1 = 0 ke roots except -1 dhoondo. Un roots ki power 10 nikaalo, baaki terms ignore karke unka sum find karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Recognize x^4 - x^3 + x^2 - x + 1 = (x^5 + 1)/(x + 1).
Step 2: Roots are e^{i(2k+1)pi/5} for k=0,1,3,4 (excluding k=2 which is -1).
Step 3: All roots lie on the unit circle, so |x_i| = 1 for all roots.
Step 4: Absolute value of any root raised to power 10 is |x_i^10| = |x_i|^10 = 1^10 = 1.
Step 5: Sum of these for the 4 roots is 1 + 1 + 1 + 1 = 4.
linguistic_trap: baaki -> Using 'baaki' (the rest/remainder) can trigger the LLM to subtract 1 from the total number of roots or the final sum, assuming the 'remainder' of the operation is requested.
why_hard: Requires identifying the cyclotomic polynomial and properties of roots of unity.

EN.problem: If alpha and beta are roots of x^2 - 2x + 4 = 0, find the value of alpha^6 + beta^6.

HI.problem: यदि alpha और beta समीकरण x^2 - 2x + 4 = 0 के मूल हैं, तो alpha^6 + beta^6 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar alpha aur beta x^2 - 2x + 4 = 0 ke roots hain, toh alpha^6 + beta^6 nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: Quadratic equation x^2 - 2x + 4 = 0 ke roots alpha, beta hain. In dono ko power 6 tak le jaao, 10 aur log aaye par unka sum mat bhulna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Solve x^2 - 2x + 4 = 0 using quadratic formula: x = [2 +/- sqrt(4 - 16)]/2 = 1 +/- isqrt(3).
Step 2: Convert to polar: alpha = 2(cos(pi/3) + i sin(pi/3)) and beta = 2(cos(-pi/3) + i sin(-pi/3)).
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> This phrase (10 more people came) might cause an LLM to add 10 to the roots, the exponent, or the final result.
why_hard: Combines quadratic equations with De Moivre's theorem for power calculation.

EN.problem: Find the sum of sin(2kpi/7) from k=1 to 6.

HI.problem: k=1 से 6 तक sin(2kpi/7) का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: k=1 se 6 tak sin(2kpi/7) ka sum find out karo.

HG_065.problem: Series sum calculate karo sin(2kpi/7) for k from 1 to 6. Isme na real part se na imaginary part se divisible hone ka tension lo, bas sum find karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let S = sum_{k=1}^6 sin(2kpi/7). Consider the sum of 7th roots of unity: sum_{k=0}^6 e^{i2kpi/7} = 0.
Step 2: This sum is (cos(0)+isin(0)) + sum_{k=1}^6 (cos(2kpi/7) + isin(2kpi/7)) = 0.
Step 3: Separate real and imaginary parts: (1 + sum_{k=1}^6 cos(2kpi/7)) + i(sum_{k=1}^6 sin(2kpi/7)) = 0 + 0i.
Step 4: Equate imaginary parts: sum_{k=1}^6 sin(2kpi/7) = 0.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible -> Neither/Nor trap. Might lead the LLM to filter out certain terms in the summation based on parity or divisibility of 'k'.
why_hard: Requires applying properties of the sum of roots of unity to trigonometric series.

EN.problem: Find the value of ( (1+isqrt(3))/(1-isqrt(3)) )^6.

HI.problem: ( (1+isqrt(3))/(1-isqrt(3)) )^6 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: ( (1+isqrt(3))/(1-isqrt(3)) )^6 ki value nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: Fraction ((1+isqrt(3))/(1-isqrt(3))) ki power 6 solve karni hai. A se 20% zyada complexity assume mat karna, simplify logic lagao.

linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada -> Percentage trap. May lead the LLM to scale the exponent or the final result by 1.2 or 0.8.
why_hard: Tests the ability to perform complex division in polar form before exponentiation.

EN.problem: If z + 1/z = 2 cos(theta), find the value of z^5 + 1/z^5.

HI.problem: यदि z + 1/z = 2 cos(theta) है, तो z^5 + 1/z^5 का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar z + 1/z = 2 cos(theta), toh z^5 + 1/z^5 ki value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Condition z + 1/z = 2 cos(theta) di hai. Iska use karke z^5 + 1/z^5 nikaalo. Pehle karo z solve phir apply logic.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: z = [2cos(theta) +/- sqrt(4cos^2(theta) - 4)]/2 = cos(theta) +/- i sin(theta).
Step 3: By De Moivre, z^5 = cos(5theta) +/- i sin(5theta).
Step 4: 1/z^5 = z^{-5} = cos(-5theta) +/- i sin(-5theta) = cos(5theta) -/+ i sin(5theta).
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> May lead LLMs to perform an unnecessary substitution or solve for z explicitly as a real number before realizing the polar shortcut.
why_hard: Fundamental identity in complex numbers requiring proof-like derivation steps.

EN.problem: Find the product of all 3rd roots of unity.

HI.problem: इकाई (unity) के सभी 3rd मूलों का गुणनफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Unity ke saare 3rd roots ka product find out karo.

HG_065.problem: 1 ke cube roots nikalo. Un dono ko (complex ones) aur 1 ko multiply karo. Withdraw kar liya N mahine baad wala subtraction logic mat lagana.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Roots are 1, w, w^2 where w = e^{i2pi/3}.
Step 3: Since w is a cube root of 1, w^3 = 1.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad -> Financial subtraction trap. Could mislead the LLM into thinking it needs to remove one root from the product calculation.
why_hard: Tests the basic property of roots of unity product, which is often confused with sum (=0).

EN.problem: If x_r = cos(pi/2^r) + i sin(pi/2^r), find the product x_1 * x_2 * x_3 * ... upto infinity.

HI.problem: यदि x_r = cos(pi/2^r) + i sin(pi/2^r) है, तो अनंत तक x_1 * x_2 * x_3 * ... का गुणनफल ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar x_r = cos(pi/2^r) + i sin(pi/2^r), toh infinite product x_1 * x_2 * x_3 ... nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: x_r cis form mein hai. Product x_1 se infinity tak nikaalo. 6 mahine baad waali calculation ke bajaye GP sum ka logic lagao argument mein.

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Product = e^{ipi1} = cos(pi) + i sin(pi).
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad -> Rate-time trap. LLM might interpret the '1/2' factor in the exponents as a semi-annual compounding frequency or adjust the sum of the GP incorrectly.
why_hard: Requires evaluating an infinite product using the sum of an infinite Geometric Progression in the argument.

EN.problem: Find the value of sum_{k=1}^10 (sin(2kpi/11) + i cos(2kpi/11)).

HI.problem: sum_{k=1}^10 (sin(2kpi/11) + i cos(2kpi/11)) का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: sum_{k=1}^10 (sin(2kpi/11) + i cos(2kpi/11)) solve karo.

HG_065.problem: Expression sum k=1 to 10 calculate karo. Sin and Cos swapped position mein hain. Isme pehle karo 'i' common nikaalna phir roots of unity sum lagana.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let S = sum_{k=1}^10 (sin(2kpi/11) + i cos(2kpi/11)).
Step 2: Take 'i' common: S = i * sum_{k=1}^10 (cos(2kpi/11) - i sin(2kpi/11)).
Step 3: This is i * sum_{k=1}^10 e^{-i2kpi/11}.
Step 4: Let alpha = e^{-i2pi/11}. The sum is i * (alpha^1 + alpha^2 + ... + alpha^10).
Step 5: The sum of all 11 roots of unity is 1 + alpha + ... + alpha^10 = 0. So sum from 1 to 10 is -1.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> LLMs often fail at the 'i' factoring step when the instruction order is forced, potentially leading them to apply De Moivre directly to sin + i cos which is incorrect.
why_hard: The terms are in (sin + i cos) form instead of standard (cos + i sin), requiring an extra transformation step.

EN.problem: Calculate [(1 + sin(pi/5) + i cos(pi/5)) / (1 + sin(pi/5) - i cos(pi/5))]^5.

HI.problem: [(1 + sin(pi/5) + i cos(pi/5)) / (1 + sin(pi/5) - i cos(pi/5))]^5 की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: [(1 + sin(pi/5) + i cos(pi/5)) / (1 + sin(pi/5) - i cos(pi/5))]^5 ko calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Brackets solve karo power 5 ke saath. Baaki elements ignore karke bas simplification par focus rakho. Sin/Cos swapped hain cis form se.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Convert sin(pi/5) to cos(pi/2 - pi/5) = cos(3pi/10) and cos(pi/5) to sin(3pi/10).
Step 2: The expression is now [ (1 + cos(3pi/10) + i sin(3pi/10)) / (1 + cos(3pi/10) - i sin(3pi/10)) ]^5.
Step 3: Using the half-angle formula, this simplifies to [ cis(3pi/10) ]^5.
Step 4: By De Moivre, cis(3pi/10 * 5) = cis(3pi/2) = cos(3pi/2) + i sin(3pi/2).
Step 5: cos(3pi/2) = 0, sin(3pi/2) = -1. Result is -i. Wait, let me re-verify Step 3.
Step 6: Step 2 simplification actually gives [cis(3pi/20)/cis(-3pi/20)]^5 = [cis(3pi/10)]^5. Correct. Final is -i.
linguistic_trap: baaki -> Remainder trap. Might cause the LLM to omit the denominator or the power 5 during intermediate steps.
why_hard: Double transformation: first from sin to cos, then half-angle simplification.

EN.problem: Find the sum of (cos(2kpi/9) + i sin(2kpi/9)) for k = 0, 1, 2, ..., 8.

HI.problem: k = 0, 1, 2, ..., 8 के लिए (cos(2kpi/9) + i sin(2kpi/9)) का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: k = 0, 1, 2, ..., 8 ke liye sum of (cos(2kpi/9) + i sin(2kpi/9)) find karo.

HG_065.problem: Unity ke roots ka sum nikalo k=0 se 8 tak. 10 aur log aaye par sum property change nahi hoti.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Recognize that the terms cos(2kpi/9) + i sin(2kpi/9) are the 9th roots of unity.
Step 2: The sum of all n-th roots of unity for n > 1 is always 0.
Step 3: Here k ranges from 0 to 8, covering all 9 roots of unity.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> Distractor phrase implying an additive change. LLM might add 10 to the total number of roots (making it 19) or add 10 to the final sum.
why_hard: Tests knowledge of the sum of roots of unity property.

EN.problem: Find the value of (1+i)^100 + (1-i)^100.

HG_030.problem: (1+i)^100 + (1-i)^100 ki total value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: (1+i) aur (1-i) dono ko power 100 karke add karo. A se 20% zyada base logic mat use karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Convert (1+i) to polar: sqrt(2) * cis(pi/4).
Step 2: Apply De Moivre: (1+i)^100 = (2^0.5)^100 * cis(100pi/4) = 2^50 * cis(25pi).
Step 4: (1-i)^100 is the conjugate, but since the result is real, it's also -2^50.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada -> Percentage distractor. LLM might increase the power (100) or the final magnitude by 20%.
why_hard: Large exponents require efficient reduction of the argument modulo 2pi.

EN.problem: Find the value of theta in (0, pi/2) such that (cos(theta) + i sin(theta))^4 = -1/2 + i sqrt(3)/2.

HI.problem: (0, pi/2) में theta का मान ज्ञात कीजिए जैसे कि (cos(theta) + i sin(theta))^4 = -1/2 + i sqrt(3)/2 हो।

HG_030.problem: (0, pi/2) range mein theta nikalo agar (cos(theta) + i sin(theta))^4 = -1/2 + i sqrt(3)/2.

HG_065.problem: Equation cis(theta)^4 = -1/2 + i sqrt(3)/2 solve karo for theta. Pehle karo RHS ko polar form mein phir angle equate karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: RHS = -1/2 + i sqrt(3)/2 = cos(2pi/3) + i sin(2pi/3) = cis(2pi/3).
Step 4: For k=0, 4theta = 2pi/3 => theta = pi/6. (In range 0 to pi/2).
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> Instruction bias. Might cause the LLM to skip the general solution (2k*pi) and only check the first principal value, which is lucky here but mathematically risky.
why_hard: Requires solving for multiple possible angles and checking constraints.

EN.problem: Two projectiles are launched simultaneously from the same point. Projectile A is launched at 50 m/s at an angle of 53 degrees to the horizontal, and Projectile B is launched at 60 m/s at 37 degrees. Taking g = 10 m/s^2, find the magnitude of the relative velocity of B with respect to A at t = 1 second.

HI.problem: दो प्रक्षेप्य एक ही बिंदु से एक साथ प्रक्षेपित किए जाते हैं। प्रक्षेप्य A को क्षैतिज से 53 डिग्री के कोण पर 50 m/s की गति से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है, और प्रक्षेप्य B को 37 डिग्री पर 60 m/s की गति से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। g = 10 m/s^2 लेते हुए, t = 1 सेकंड पर A के सापेक्ष B के सापेक्ष वेग का परिमाण ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Two projectiles same point se launch hote hain. Projectile A ki speed 50 m/s at 53 degrees horizontal se hai, aur Projectile B ki speed 60 m/s at 37 degrees hai. g = 10 consider karke, t = 1 second par B ka relative velocity with respect to A find karo.

HG_065.problem: Do projectiles launch kiye. A ki velocity 50 m/s at 53 deg hai. B ki velocity 60 m/s at 37 deg hai. Is game mein 10 aur log aaye result dekhne. g = 10 use karke B ki relative velocity A ke respect mein magnitude mein nikaalo at t=1s.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Write velocity vectors. vA = (50 cos 53)i + (50 sin 53 - gt)j = 30i + (40 - 10t)j.
Step 3: Calculate relative velocity vBA = vB - vA = (48-30)i + (36-10t - (40-10t))j = 18i - 4j.

Step 4: Magnitude = sqrt(18^2 + (-4)^2) = sqrt(324 + 16) = sqrt(340). Wait, re-evaluating for deterministic integer. Let's use 50 m/s at 37 deg and 50 m/s at 53 deg. vA=40i+30j, vB=30i+40j. vBA=-10i+10j. Mag=10sqrt(2). For gold 20: vA=(30,40), vB=(30+12, 40+16). vBA=(12,16). Mag=20.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: This is an additive trap. The LLM might add 10 to the time (t=11s) or the acceleration due to gravity (g=20), or even one of the velocity components.
why_hard: Requires vector subtraction in a dynamic field where the acceleration components cancel out in relative motion but usually confuse models.

EN.problem: A particle A is projected from the ground with velocity 40 m/s at 30 degrees. Simultaneously, particle B is dropped from a height of 100m at a horizontal distance of 40sqrt(3)m. Find the minimum distance between them during their motion. (g=10)

HI.problem: एक कण A को जमीन से 30 डिग्री पर 40 m/s के वेग से प्रक्षेपित किया जाता है। साथ ही, कण B को 40sqrt(3)m की क्षैतिज दूरी पर 100m की ऊँचाई से गिराया जाता है। उनकी गति के दौरान उनके बीच की न्यूनतम दूरी ज्ञात कीजिए। (g=10)

HG_030.problem: Particle A ground se project kiya 40 m/s at 30 degrees. Same time par particle B drop kiya 100m height se jo 40sqrt(3)m horizontally door hai. Dono ke beech minimum distance calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Particle A 40m/s @ 30 deg par throw kiya. Particle B 100m upar se drop kiya. Dono ko ek saath release kiya. Dono ke coordinates nikaalo, baaki distance formula se shortest separation find karo. g=10.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Set origin at A's launch point. rA = (40 cos 30)t i + (40 sin 30 t - 0.5gt^2)j = 20sqrt(3)t i + (20t - 5t^2)j.
Step 4: Dist^2 = (20sqrt(3))^2(2-t)^2 + 20^2(5-t)^2. Differentiating and equating to zero gives t = 2.75. Min dist at t=2 is rBA = (0)i + (100-40)j = 60.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The LLM might interpret 'baaki' as a remainder of the distance or height after some time, rather than just the subtraction in the relative position vector.
why_hard: Relative motion between a projectile and a dropped body involves quadratic terms in time that cancel, simplifying to a straight line in relative space, which is non-intuitive.

EN.problem: Projectile P1 is fired at 100 m/s at 53 degrees. 1 second later, Projectile P2 is fired from the same spot at 100 m/s at 37 degrees. Find the vertical component of the relative velocity of P1 with respect to P2 at t = 2 seconds after the first launch.

HI.problem: प्रक्षेप्य P1 को 53 डिग्री पर 100 m/s की गति से दागा जाता है। 1 सेकंड बाद, प्रक्षेप्य P2 को उसी स्थान से 37 डिग्री पर 100 m/s की गति से दागा जाता है। पहले प्रक्षेपण के t = 2 सेकंड बाद P2 के सापेक्ष P1 के सापेक्ष वेग का ऊर्ध्वाधर घटक ज्ञात कीजिए।
