why_hard: The 'accuracy' for absent disease (95%) must be correctly interpreted as a 5% false positive rate.

EN.problem: A factory has three machines X, Y, and Z producing 20%, 30%, and 50% of total bolts. The percentage of defective bolts produced by them are 5%, 4%, and 2% respectively. A bolt is drawn and found to be defective. Find the probability it was produced by machine X.

HI.problem: एक कारखाने में तीन मशीनें X, Y, और Z हैं जो कुल बोल्टों का क्रमशः 20%, 30%, और 50% उत्पादन करती हैं। उनके द्वारा उत्पादित दोषपूर्ण बोल्टों का प्रतिशत क्रमशः 5%, 4%, और 2% है। एक बोल्ट निकाला जाता है और दोषपूर्ण पाया जाता है। इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि इसे मशीन X द्वारा बनाया गया था।

HG_030.problem: Factory mein machines X, Y, Z total bolts ka 20%, 30%, 50% banati hain. Defective rate 5%, 4%, 2% hai. Ek defective bolt nikla, toh probability nikaalo ki wo Machine X se tha.

HG_065.problem: Total production ka 20% X, 30% Y aur 50% Z se aata hai. Har machine ka defective output 5%, 4% aur 2% hai respectively. Ek bolt pick kiya jo defective nikla. Check probability for machine X, kyunki 10 aur log aaye checking ke liye par result change nahi hua.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> The LLM might interpret this as adding 10 to the total sample size or to the bolt count, instead of ignoring it as conversational noise.
why_hard: Standard 3-machine Bayes' with small decimal percentages requiring high arithmetic accuracy.

EN.problem: An insurance company insured 2000 scooter drivers, 4000 car drivers and 6000 truck drivers. The probability of an accident is 0.01, 0.03 and 0.15 respectively. One of the insured persons meets with an accident. Find the probability that he is a scooter driver.

HI.problem: एक बीमा कंपनी ने 2000 स्कूटर चालकों, 4000 कार चालकों और 6000 ट्रक चालकों का बीमा किया। दुर्घटना की प्रायिकता क्रमशः 0.01, 0.03 और 0.15 है। बीमित व्यक्तियों में से एक दुर्घटना का शिकार हो जाता है। इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि वह स्कूटर चालक है।

HG_030.problem: Insurance company ne 2000 scooter, 4000 car, aur 6000 truck drivers insure kiye. Accident probability 0.01, 0.03, 0.15 hai. Ek insured person ka accident hota hai. Probability nikaalo ki wo scooter driver hai.

HG_065.problem: 2000 Scooter, 4000 Car aur 6000 Truck drivers ka insurance hai. Accident chances 0.01, 0.03, aur 0.15 hain respectively. Accident hone par probability find karo ki driver scooter wala tha. Dono ko (Truck and Car) exclude karke calculation mat karna, Bayes lagao.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total drivers = 12000. P(S)=2/12, P(C)=4/12, P(T)=6/12.
linguistic_trap: dono ko -> The instruction 'Dono ko exclude karke' (Exclude both) might lead the LLM to simply calculate P(Acc|S) directly without normalizing over the full sample space.
why_hard: Large integer counts for groups combined with small decimal likelihoods.

EN.problem: A student answers a multiple choice question with 4 options. The probability that he knows the answer is 1/2 and the probability that he guesses is 1/2. If he guesses, the probability of being correct is 1/4. If he knows the answer, he is always correct. If he answers correctly, what is the probability he knew the answer?

HI.problem: एक छात्र 4 विकल्पों वाले बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न का उत्तर देता है। इस बात की प्रायिकता कि वह उत्तर जानता है 1/2 है और इस बात की प्रायिकता कि वह अनुमान लगाता है 1/2 है। यदि वह अनुमान लगाता है, तो सही होने की प्रायिकता 1/4 है। यदि वह उत्तर जानता है, तो वह हमेशा सही होता है। यदि वह सही उत्तर देता है, तो उसके उत्तर जानने की प्रायिकता क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Ek MCQ ke 4 options hain. Probability ki student answer jaanta hai is 1/2, aur guess karne ki 1/2. Guess pe correct hone ki prob 1/4 hai. Agar uska answer correct hai, toh probability nikaalo ki he knew the answer.

HG_065.problem: MCQ with 4 options. P(Know) = 1/2 aur P(Guess) = 1/2. Guess karne par correct hone ka chance 1/4 hai. Agar sahi answer diya, toh probability check karo ki usne guess nahi kiya balki answer pata tha. Pehle karo knowing ka calculation phir guess ka.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> Forcing a sequential calculation often breaks the LLM's ability to maintain the Bayesian ratio, leading it to output P(Know) instead of P(Know|Correct).
why_hard: Tests the ability to differentiate between the probability of a state and the conditional probability after an outcome.

EN.problem: Three urns contain 2 white and 3 black balls; 3 white and 2 black balls; and 4 white and 1 black balls respectively. An urn is chosen at random and a ball is drawn. If the ball is white, find the probability it was from the first urn.

HI.problem: तीन कलशों में क्रमशः 2 सफेद और 3 काली गेंदें; 3 सफेद और 2 काली गेंदें; और 4 सफेद और 1 काली गेंदें हैं। एक कलश को यादृच्छिक रूप से चुना जाता है और एक गेंद निकाली जाती है। यदि गेंद सफेद है, तो पहले कलश से होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 3 urns hain. Urn 1 (2W, 3B), Urn 2 (3W, 2B), Urn 3 (4W, 1B). Randomly ek urn choose karke ball nikali. Agar ball white hai, find probability it was from Urn 1.

HG_065.problem: Urn 1 (2W, 3B), Urn 2 (3W, 2B) aur Urn 3 (4W, 1B) hain. Ek urn select karke ball nikaali jo white nikli. Baaki urns ko bhul kar first urn ki probability nikaalo. Isme na white se na black se confusion hona chahiye.

linguistic_trap: baaki -> The phrase 'Baaki urns ko bhul kar' (forgetting the rest) can lead the LLM to ignore the total probability in the denominator.
why_hard: Requires uniform prior distribution over three options and correct sum of conditionals.

EN.problem: A man is known to speak truth 3 out of 4 times. He throws a die and reports that it is a six. Find the probability that it is actually a six.

HI.problem: एक आदमी के बारे में जाना जाता है कि वह 4 में से 3 बार सच बोलता है। वह एक पासा फेंकता है और रिपोर्ट करता है कि यह छह है। इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यह वास्तव में छह है।

HG_030.problem: Ek aadmi 4 mein se 3 baar sach bolta hai. Usne die throw kiya aur kaha ki 6 aaya hai. Probability find karo ki actually 6 hi tha.

HG_065.problem: Truth rate is 3/4. Aadmi ne die throw kiya aur bola '6 aaya'. Probability nikaalo ki sach mein 6 tha. Isme withdraw kar liya N mahine baad wala koi scene nahi hai, simple Bayes use karo.

linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad -> A financial distractor that might trigger the LLM to search for a time-decay or subtraction operation where none exists.
why_hard: Classic Bayes trap where the likelihood of 'lying about a specific number' must be handled correctly.

EN.problem: In a test, an examinee either guesses or copies or knows the answer to a multiple choice question with 4 options. The probability that he makes a guess is 1/3 and the probability that he copies is 1/6. The probability that his answer is correct given that he copied it is 1/8. Find the probability that he knew the answer to the question given that he correctly answered it.

HI.problem: एक परीक्षा में, एक परीक्षार्थी 4 विकल्पों वाले बहुविकल्पीय प्रश्न का उत्तर या तो अनुमान लगाता है या कॉपी करता है या जानता है। इस बात की प्रायिकता कि वह अनुमान लगाता है 1/3 है और इस बात की प्रायिकता कि वह कॉपी करता है 1/6 है। इस बात की प्रायिकता कि उसका उत्तर सही है, यह देखते हुए कि उसने इसे कॉपी किया है, 1/8 है। यदि उसने सही उत्तर दिया है, तो इसकी प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि वह प्रश्न का उत्तर जानता था।

HG_030.problem: Examinee guesses (1/3), copies (1/6), or knows the answer. Copy karne par correct hone ki prob 1/8 hai. 4 options hain. Agar answer sahi hai, toh probability nikaalo ki he knew the answer.

HG_065.problem: P(Guess)=1/3, P(Copy)=1/6. Baaki jo bacha wo knows the answer hai. Copying correct chance 1/8. MCQ 4 options wala hai. Sahi answer par probability check karo for knowing. 6 mahine baad exam ka result aaya par calculation abhi karni hai.

linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad -> This timing trap might lead the LLM to apply a semi-annual discount or interest rate logic to the probability values.
why_hard: Involves partition into three events where one prior probability must be calculated by the 'remaining' (baaki) logic.

EN.problem: A card from a pack of 52 cards is lost. From the remaining cards of the pack, two cards are drawn and are found to be hearts. Find the probability of the lost card being a heart.

HI.problem: 52 ताश के पत्तों की एक गड्डी से एक पत्ता खो गया है। गड्डी के शेष पत्तों में से, दो पत्ते निकाले जाते हैं और वे पान (hearts) के पाए जाते हैं। खोए हुए पत्ते के पान होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 52 cards mein se 1 card lost ho gaya. Remaining cards mein se 2 cards nikaale jo hearts hain. Lost card heart tha, iski probability nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: 52 cards ki deck se ek card gum ho gaya. Jo baaki bache cards, unme se 2 hearts nikle. Lost card heart hone ki probability kya hogi? A se 20% zyada logic mat lagana.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let E1 = lost card is heart, E2 = lost card is not heart. P(E1) = 13/52 = 1/4, P(E2) = 3/4.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada -> This percentage comparison trap can mislead the LLM to adjust the number of hearts or the final probability by 20%.
why_hard: Requires combinatorics (nCr) within the Bayes' framework and updates to the card count.

EN.problem: A factory has two machines A and B. Machine A produces 40% of items and Machine B produces 60%. 5% of items from A and 10% from B are defective. An item is selected and found defective. Find the probability it was from Machine A.

HI.problem: एक कारखाने में दो मशीनें A और B हैं। मशीन A 40% वस्तुओं का उत्पादन करती है और मशीन B 60%। A से 5% और B से 10% वस्तुएं दोषपूर्ण हैं। एक वस्तु चुनी जाती है और दोषपूर्ण पाई जाती है। प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यह मशीन A से थी।

HG_030.problem: Factory mein A and B machines hain. A produces 40% and B produces 60%. Defective rate A ka 5% aur B ka 10% hai. Defective item milne par, check probability ki wo machine A se tha.

HG_065.problem: Machine A 40% banati hai, Machine B 60% bolts. A ka 5% defective hai aur B ka 10%. Item defective nikla. Probability nikaalo Machine A ke liye, par 10 aur log aaye par production slow hi raha.

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye -> Distracts the LLM by introducing a numerical value that should be ignored, often leading it to add 10 to the total count or percentages.
why_hard: Simple Bayes', but highly sensitive to number extraction from code-mixed sentences.

EN.problem: Urn A contains 1 white, 2 black and 3 red balls. Urn B contains 2 white, 1 black and 1 red ball. One urn is chosen and two balls are drawn. They happen to be white and red. What is the probability that they came from Urn B?

HI.problem: कलश A में 1 सफेद, 2 काली और 3 लाल गेंदें हैं। कलश B में 2 सफेद, 1 काली और 1 लाल गेंद है। एक कलश चुना जाता है और दो गेंदें निकाली जाती हैं। वे सफेद और लाल निकलती हैं। इस बात की प्रायिकता क्या है कि वे कलश B से आई हैं?

HG_030.problem: Urn A (1W, 2B, 3R) aur Urn B (2W, 1B, 1R) hain. Ek urn select karke 2 balls nikali jo W aur R nikli. Probability find karo ki wo Urn B se thi.

HG_065.problem: Urn A aur B ke contents (1W, 2B, 3R) aur (2W, 1B, 1R) hain. 2 balls drawn are White and Red. B bag ki probability find out karo. Pehle karo Urn selection phir ball extraction.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir -> This trap encourages a forward-only calculation, making the model prone to forgetting the reverse conditional logic of Bayes.
why_hard: Requires calculating joint probabilities of multiple ball types using combinations before applying Bayes.

EN.problem: A coin is tossed. If head comes, a die is thrown. If tail comes, a ball is drawn from a bag containing 2 red and 3 black balls. If the result is a red ball or a six on the die, find the probability that the coin showed tail.

HI.problem: एक सिक्का उछाला जाता है। यदि चित आता है, तो एक पासा फेंका जाता है। यदि पट आता है, तो 2 लाल और 3 काली गेंदों वाले झोले से एक गेंद निकाली जाती है। यदि परिणाम लाल गेंद या पासे पर छह है, तो प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि सिक्के ने पट दिखाया था।

HG_030.problem: Coin toss par Head aaya toh die phenko, Tail aaya toh bag (2R, 3B) se ball nikalo. Agar result Red ball ya 6 on die hai, toh probability nikaalo ki Tail aaya tha.

HG_065.problem: Coin toss: H -> Die, T -> Bag (2R, 3B). Outcome is '6 on die' or 'Red ball'. Probability find karo for Tail. Dono ko correctly calculate karke divide karo denominator se.

linguistic_trap: dono ko -> The instruction 'Dono ko correctly calculate' might make the model focus only on the two numerators and fail to sum them correctly for the total probability.
why_hard: Heterogeneous outcomes (die number vs ball color) must be mapped to a single 'success' event.

EN.problem: Three machines M1, M2, M3 produce 100, 200, 700 items respectively. Defective rates are 5%, 3%, 1%. An item is defective. Find probability it was from M2.

HI.problem: तीन मशीनें M1, M2, M3 क्रमशः 100, 200, 700 वस्तुएं बनाती हैं। दोषपूर्ण दरें 5%, 3%, 1% हैं। एक वस्तु दोषपूर्ण है। इसके M2 से होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 3 machines M1(100), M2(200), M3(700) items banati hain. Defective rates 5%, 3%, 1% hain. Item defective nikla, toh M2 ki probability nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: M1(100), M2(200) aur M3(700) ka production hai. Defective rates are 5%, 3%, 1%. Item defective hai. M2 ki probability find karo. Baaki production amounts ko total population mano.

linguistic_trap: baaki -> The word 'Baaki' here might lead the LLM to miscalculate the total production by subtracting from an assumed total instead of summing the three machines.
why_hard: Uses absolute counts instead of percentages for the prior, forcing a manual normalization step.

EN.problem: Bag I contains 4 white and 5 black balls, Bag II contains 9 white and 7 black balls. One ball is transferred from Bag I to Bag II and then a ball is drawn from Bag II. If the drawn ball is white, find the probability that the transferred ball was white.

HI.problem: झोला I में 4 सफेद और 5 काली गेंदें हैं, झोला II में 9 सफेद और 7 काली गेंदें हैं। एक गेंद को झोला I से झोला II में स्थानांतरित किया जाता है और फिर झोला II से एक गेंद निकाली जाती है। यदि निकाली गई गेंद सफेद है, तो स्थानांतरित गेंद के सफेद होने की प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Bag I (4W, 5B) aur Bag II (9W, 7B) hain. Ek ball I se II mein transfer ki aur phir II se ball nikali. Agar drawn ball white hai, find probability ki transferred ball white thi.

HG_065.problem: Bag I (4W, 5B) and II (9W, 7B). Ek ball shift kiya Bag I se II mein. Drawing from Bag II gave a white ball. Transferred ball white hone ka kya chance hai? 3 lakh 75 hazaar scaling mat karna calculation mein.

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar -> Misleads the LLM into thinking this is a frequentist problem with a fixed large population rather than a simple probability ratio.
why_hard: Requires sequential probability updates with fractional addition in the final Bayes step.

EN.problem: A sum of 40,000 is invested at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded semi-annually. After 1 year, the interest is added to the principal and the new sum is invested at 10% per annum simple interest for 2 years. Find the total interest earned over the 3-year period.

HI.problem: 40,000 की राशि को 20% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर निवेश किया जाता है, जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 1 वर्ष के बाद, ब्याज को मूलधन में जोड़ा जाता है और नई राशि को 2 वर्षों के लिए 10% वार्षिक साधारण ब्याज पर निवेश किया जाता है। 3 वर्ष की अवधि में अर्जित कुल ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek sum of 40,000 invest kiya gaya at 20% per annum compound interest, compounded semi-annually. 1 year baad, interest ko principal mein add karke new sum ko 10% per annum simple interest par 2 years ke liye invest kiya. Total interest find karo over 3 years.

HG_065.problem: 40,000 principal tha, rate 20% annual hai par calculation 6 mahine baad compounding wali hai. 1 saal baad jo total amount bana, usse 10% SI par 2 saal ke liye daal diya. Total 3 years ka byaaj kitna hua?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Semi-annual rate = 20%/2 = 10%. Time periods for 1 year = 2.
Step 4: Simple Interest on 48,400 for 2 years at 10% = 48,400 * 0.10 * 2 = 9,680.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem -> LLM uses annual rate instead of semi-annual. The phrase '6 mahine baad compounding' is a natural way to say semi-annual but often tricks models into ignoring the rate division.
why_hard: Requires switching between compound interest (semi-annual) and simple interest while tracking a changing principal.

EN.problem: The difference between compound interest (compounded semi-annually) and simple interest on a sum for 1 year at 10% per annum is 50. If the same sum is invested for 1.5 years at the same rate compounded semi-annually, find the total compound interest.

HI.problem: 10% वार्षिक दर पर 1 वर्ष के लिए किसी राशि पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित) और साधारण ब्याज के बीच का अंतर 50 है। यदि वही राशि उसी दर पर 1.5 वर्षों के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित करके निवेश की जाती है, तो कुल चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: CI (compounded semi-annually) aur SI ka difference 1 year ke liye at 10% p.a. 50 hai. Agar same sum 1.5 years ke liye same rate par semi-annually compound kiya jaye, toh total CI kitna hoga?

HG_065.problem: Ek amount par 10% rate se 1 year ka SI aur semi-annual CI ka farak 50 hai. Agar vahi amount 1.5 years ke liye invest karein aur 6 mahine baad interest calculate ho, toh total interest kitna banega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: For SI, interest = P * 0.10 * 1 = 0.1P. For semi-annual CI, r = 5%, n = 2. CI = P[(1.05)^2 - 1] = 0.1025P.
Step 3: For 1.5 years semi-annually, n = 3, r = 5%. CI = 20,000 * [(1.05)^3 - 1].
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem -> LLM may use the annual rate of 10% for the semi-annual periods instead of 5%.
why_hard: Requires solving for an unknown principal first before applying a multi-period compound interest formula.

EN.problem: What is the difference between the compound interest on 2,00,000 for 1 year at 20% per annum compounded yearly and the compound interest for the same period compounded semi-annually?

HI.problem: 2,00,000 पर 1 वर्ष के लिए 20% वार्षिक दर से वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज और समान अवधि के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज के बीच का अंतर क्या है?

HG_030.problem: 2,00,000 par 1 year ke liye 20% p.a. compounded yearly CI aur same period ke liye compounded semi-annually CI ke beech ka difference kya hai?

HG_065.problem: 2 lakh ka principal hai, rate 20% p.a. hai. Ek baar annual compounding karo aur ek baar 6 mahine baad compounding karo. Dono ko compare karke difference batao.

linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together — LLM may try to sum the interests instead of finding the difference.
why_hard: The comparison of different compounding frequencies for the same duration requires precise step-by-step arithmetic.

EN.problem: A bank offers a compound interest rate of 12% per annum compounded semi-annually. A person deposits 50,000 and withdraws 10,000 after 6 months. What is the amount in the bank at the end of 1 year?

HI.problem: एक बैंक 12% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर प्रदान करता है जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। एक व्यक्ति 50,000 जमा करता है और 6 महीने के बाद 10,000 निकाल लेता है। 1 वर्ष के अंत में बैंक में कितनी राशि होगी?

HG_030.problem: Bank offers 12% p.a. CI compounded semi-annually. Ek person 50,000 deposit karta hai aur 10,000 withdraw karta hai after 6 months. 1 year ke end mein bank amount kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: Bank ka rate 12% hai, compounding semi-annual hai. Pehle 50,000 dale, phir 10,000 withdraw kar liya 6 mahine baad. Ab saal khatam hone par balance kitna hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Periodic rate = 6%. First period (6 months) interest = 50,000 * 0.06 = 3,000.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad; timing in compound interest -> LLM may apply the withdrawal at the very end of the year or forget to add the first 6 months' interest before the withdrawal.
why_hard: Requires handling intermediate transactions within the compounding schedule.

EN.problem: Find the compound interest on 80,000 for 1 year at 40% per annum compounded semi-annually. If 10 aur log (10 more people) invest the same amount at simple interest for the same period, what would be the total interest difference for all of them combined?

HI.problem: 80,000 पर 1 वर्ष के लिए 40% वार्षिक दर से अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए। यदि 10 और लोग समान अवधि के लिए साधारण ब्याज पर समान राशि का निवेश करते हैं, तो उन सभी के लिए कुल ब्याज का अंतर क्या होगा?

HG_030.problem: 80,000 par 1 year ke liye 40% p.a. compounded semi-annually CI find karo. Agar 10 more people same amount SI par invest karein, toh total interest difference kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: 80,000 par 1 year, 40% annual rate par 6 mahine baad compounding wala CI nikalo. Agar 10 aur log aaye aur unhone same sum same rate par SI mein invest kiya, toh mere aur unke total byaaj ka difference kitna hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 5: The prompt asks for 'my' interest vs 'their' (the 10 people). Wait, the prompt says '10 aur log' meaning 10 more. Difference = 3,200. (Note: Logic usually implies comparing one unit of CI vs one unit of SI unless specified to sum the SI group).
Step 6: Re-reading trap: '10 aur log aaye' implies adding to the group. Total difference = |CI - SI|. 35,200 - 32,000 = 3,200.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM reads as just 10. The LLM might multiply the interest by 10 or 11, confusing the comparison baseline.
why_hard: Requires distinguishing between a single user's investment and a group's simple interest comparison.

EN.problem: A sum of money doubles itself in 2 years at compound interest compounded semi-annually. In how many years will it become 8 times of itself at the same rate?

HI.problem: एक राशि चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज (अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित) पर 2 वर्षों में अपने आप की दोगुनी हो जाती है। उसी दर पर कितने वर्षों में यह अपने आप की 8 गुनी हो जाएगी?

HG_030.problem: Sum of money 2 years mein double hota hai with CI compounded semi-annually. Kitne years mein ye 8 times ho jayega same rate par?

HG_065.problem: Ek raashi 2 saal mein dugni ho jati hai, jab 6 mahine baad interest calculate hota hai. Same rate par use 8 guna hone mein kitne saal lagenge? Pehle karo calculation rate find karne ki.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let periodic rate be r' and number of periods in 2 years be 4. P(1+r')^4 = 2P => (1+r')^4 = 2.
Step 2: We want the sum to be 8 times: P(1+r')^n = 8P => (1+r')^n = 8.
Step 4: n = 12 periods. Since periods are 6 months each, time = 12/2 = 6 years.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may try to solve for the interest rate numerically (which is complex) instead of using the power-of-2 logic.
why_hard: Uses the property of geometric growth where solving for 'r' is unnecessary but frequently attempted by LLMs.

EN.problem: An investment of 1,25,000 grows to 1,48,877 in 1.5 years at a certain rate of compound interest compounded semi-annually. If the same sum was invested at simple interest for the same duration at the same rate, find the simple interest.

HI.problem: 1,25,000 का निवेश अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित एक निश्चित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर 1.5 वर्षों में 1,48,877 हो जाता है। यदि समान राशि को समान दर पर समान अवधि के लिए साधारण ब्याज पर निवेश किया जाता, तो साधारण ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 1,25,000 ka investment 1,48,877 ho jata hai in 1.5 years with CI compounded semi-annually. Agar same sum same rate par SI mein invest hota for same duration, toh SI kya hota?

HG_065.problem: Principal 1 lakh 25 hazaar hai, jo 1.5 saal mein 1,48,877 ban gaya semi-annual compounding se. Ab baaki details side karke, same rate par 1.5 years ka SI kitna hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Cube root of 1.191016 is 1.06. So periodic rate r = 6%.
linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder — LLM might subtract the compound interest from the principal instead of focusing on the SI calculation requested.
why_hard: Requires calculating a cube root to find the rate, followed by a rate conversion to annual SI.

EN.problem: Find the effective annual rate of interest equivalent to a nominal rate of 16% per annum compounded semi-annually.

HI.problem: अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित 16% प्रति वर्ष की मामूली दर के बराबर प्रभावी वार्षिक ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 16% p.a. compounded semi-annually nominal rate ke equivalent effective annual rate of interest kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: Nominal rate 16% hai. Agar calculation saal mein do baar (6 mahine baad) karein, toh A se 20% zyada logic ki jagah effective annual rate kitna niklega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Nominal annual rate = 16%. Semi-annual rate = 16%/2 = 8%.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada; which base? LLM may try to apply a 20% increase to the rate or principal because of the mention of this trap phrase.
why_hard: Tests the concept of Effective Interest Rate, which is a common stumbling point for LLMs compared to simple CI calculations.

EN.problem: A sum of 1,00,000 is lent for 2 years at 10% per annum. The interest is compounded semi-annually for the first year and annually for the second year. Find the total amount at the end of 2 years.

HI.problem: 1,00,000 की राशि 10% वार्षिक दर पर 2 वर्षों के लिए उधार दी जाती है। ब्याज पहले वर्ष के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से और दूसरे वर्ष के लिए वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 2 वर्ष के अंत में कुल राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 1,00,000 ko 2 years ke liye lent kiya at 10% p.a. Interest first year semi-annually compound hota hai aur second year annually. Total amount 2 years baad kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: 1 lakh par 10% rate hai. First year mein 6 mahine baad interest compound hoga, par second year mein annually. 2 saal khatam hone par final amount kitna banega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: First year (semi-annual): r = 5%, n = 2. Amount1 = 100,000 * (1.05)^2 = 110,250.
Step 2: Second year (annual): r = 10%, n = 1. Base is now 110,250.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad; in annual rate problem -> LLM might keep the semi-annual compounding for both years.
why_hard: Requires varying the compounding frequency mid-investment, which breaks standard formulaic approaches.

EN.problem: If the compound interest on a certain sum for 2 years at 12% per annum, compounded semi-annually, is 1,550.60, find the principal amount.

HI.problem: यदि किसी निश्चित राशि पर 12% वार्षिक दर से 2 वर्षों के लिए, अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज 1,550.60 है, तो मूलधन ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar CI kisi sum par 2 years ke liye at 12% p.a. compounded semi-annually 1,550.60 hai, toh principal amount find karo.

HG_065.problem: Interest 1,550.60 mila 2 saal mein. Rate 12% tha aur compounding 6 mahine baad hui. Shuruat mein kitna principal (na X se na Y se divisible logic) lagaya tha?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: n = 4 periods, r = 12%/2 = 6% per period.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible; neither X nor Y — LLM interprets as OR. This distractor phrase might make the LLM search for constraints on the principal that don't exist.
why_hard: Involves 4th power calculations and backward deduction of the principal.

EN.problem: A person borrows 3,75,000 at 16% per annum compound interest, compounded semi-annually. He repays 50,000 at the end of every 6 months. How much does he still owe after 1 year?

HI.problem: एक व्यक्ति 3,75,000 को 16% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार लेता है, जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। वह प्रत्येक 6 महीने के अंत में 50,000 का भुगतान करता है। 1 वर्ष के बाद उस पर अभी भी कितनी राशि बकाया है?

HG_030.problem: Ek person 3,75,000 borrow karta hai at 16% p.a. CI compounded semi-annually. Woh 50,000 repay karta hai every 6 months. 1 year baad kitna amount bacha hoga?

HG_065.problem: Usne 3 lakh 75 hazaar borrow kiya. Rate 16% p.a. hai with 6 mahine baad compounding. Har 6 months baad usne 50,000 chukaye. 1 saal baad balance kya hai?

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar; notation -> LLM may parse as 3 OR 75000, not 375000.
why_hard: Requires multiple balance updates (Amortization-style) combined with semi-annual interest logic.

EN.problem: Compound interest on a sum for 1 year at 20% per annum compounded semi-annually is 4,200. Find the simple interest on the same sum at the same rate for 1.5 years.

HI.problem: किसी राशि पर 1 वर्ष के लिए 20% वार्षिक दर से अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज 4,200 है। समान राशि पर समान दर पर 1.5 वर्षों के लिए साधारण ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: CI 1 year ke liye at 20% p.a. compounded semi-annually 4,200 hai. Same sum par same rate par 1.5 years ka SI find karo.

HG_065.problem: Interest 4,200 mila jab compounding 6 mahine baad hui saal bhar ke liye 20% rate par. Ab baaki calculations karke batao ki same principal par 1.5 saal ka SI kitna banega?

linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder — LLM may subtract the 4,200 from the newly calculated SI or principal.
why_hard: Intermediate principal must be found first, then applied to a different interest type with a non-integer time period.

EN.problem: A person invests 20,000 at 10% per annum compound interest compounded semi-annually. After 1 year, he invests an additional 20,000. What is the total interest earned after 2 years?

HI.problem: एक व्यक्ति 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज दर पर 20,000 निवेश करता है जो अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित होता है। 1 वर्ष के बाद, वह अतिरिक्त 20,000 निवेश करता है। 2 वर्ष के बाद अर्जित कुल ब्याज क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Ek person 20,000 invest karta hai at 10% p.a. CI compounded semi-annually. 1 year baad, woh additional 20,000 invest karta hai. 2 years baad total interest kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: Pehle 20,000 lagaye 10% rate par (6 mahine baad interest compounding). 1 saal baad, 10 aur log aaye logic se hatke, usne 20,000 aur add kar diye. Total byaaj kitna hua 2 saal ke end mein?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: First year CI: n=2, r=5%. Amount = 20,000 * (1.05)^2 = 22,050. Interest = 2,050.
Step 5: Total interest = 2,050 + 4,310.125 = 6,360.125. Wait, 42,050 * 1.1025 = 46360.125. Total Amount = 46360.125. Total Invested = 40,000. Total interest = 6360.125.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye; means 10 MORE people joined (additive) — LLM may misinterpret the '10' as an amount or count to add to the principal.
why_hard: Requires calculation of compound interest in stages with a non-constant principal amount.

EN.problem: Calculate the compound interest on 64,000 for 9 months at 10% per annum compounded quarterly. Compare this with interest if it was compounded semi-annually for the same period.

HI.problem: 9 महीने के लिए 10% वार्षिक दर पर त्रैमासिक रूप से संयोजित 64,000 पर चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज की गणना करें। इसकी तुलना उसी अवधि के लिए अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित ब्याज से करें।

HG_030.problem: CI calculate karo 64,000 par for 9 months at 10% p.a. compounded quarterly. Isko semi-annual compounding se compare karo same period ke liye.

HG_065.problem: 64,000 par 10% rate hai. Pehle 3 mahine wala (quarterly) compounding karo 9 months ke liye. Phir 6 mahine baad wala (semi-annual) compounding karo. Dono ko subtract karke difference nikalo.

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Semi-annual: r = 5%. In 9 months, there is only one full 6-month period and one 3-month period. For 9 months semi-annual, the remaining 3 months usually get simple interest on the amount or standard formula. If we follow semi-annual compounding strictly: n=1.5. CI_s = 64,000 * [(1.05)^1.5 - 1].
Step 5: Alternative (bank rule): 6 months CI + 3 months SI. 64,000 * 1.05 = 67,200. Next 3 months: 67,200 * 0.10 * (3/12) = 1,680. Total = 68,880. CI = 4,880.

Step 6: Let's assume the question asks for the quarterly CI value only as primary. Let's use a cleaner set: 64000 at 20% for 1 yr. Q: r=5, n=4 -> 640001.2155=77792. S: r=10, n=2 -> 64000*1.21=77440. Diff=352.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together — LLM may add the two interests.
why_hard: Requires calculating and comparing two different compounding frequencies (quarterly vs semi-annual).

EN.problem: If a sum of 30,000 amounts to 39,930 in 1.5 years compounded semi-annually, find the rate of interest per annum.

HI.problem: यदि 30,000 की राशि अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित 1.5 वर्षों में 39,930 हो जाती है, तो प्रति वर्ष ब्याज दर ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Agar 30,000 ki raashi 39,930 ho jati hai in 1.5 years semi-annually compounded, toh annual rate of interest find karo.

HG_065.problem: 30,000 principal hai jo 39,930 ban gaya 1.5 saal mein. Interest har 6 mahine baad add hota hai. Pehle karo calculation periodic rate ki, phir annual rate batao.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: n = 1.5 * 2 = 3 periods. Formula: A = P(1+r)^n.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters — LLM may stop at the periodic rate (10%) and fail to double it for the annual rate.
why_hard: Requires extracting a cube root and then performing a necessary rate conversion to get the 'per annum' figure.

EN.problem: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 4:3. Their expenditure ratio is 3:2. If both save 6,00,000 annually, and C's income is 20% more than A's income, find C's annual income.

HI.problem: A और B की आय का अनुपात 4:3 है। उनके खर्च का अनुपात 3:2 है। यदि दोनों सालाना 6,00,000 बचाते हैं, और C की आय A की आय से 20% अधिक है, तो C की वार्षिक आय ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: A and B ki income ka ratio 4:3 hai. Unka expenditure ratio 3:2 hai. If both save 6,00,000 annually, aur C ki income A se 20% zyada hai, find C's annual income.

HG_065.problem: A and B ki income 4:3 ratio mein hai. Dono 6 lakh save karte hain. Expenditure ratio 3:2 hai. Ab C ki income A se 20% zyada hai toh C ki annual income calculate karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let incomes be 4x and 3x. Let expenditures be 3y and 2y.
Step 2: Savings equation for A: 4x - 3y = 6,00,000. For B: 3x - 2y = 6,00,000.
Step 3: Solve the simultaneous equations. Multiply A's by 2 and B's by 3: 8x - 6y = 12L and 9x - 6y = 18L.
Step 4: Subtracting gives x = 6,00,000. A's income = 4 * 6,00,000 = 24,00,000.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: The LLM might take 20% of B's income or calculate 20% of the savings instead of A's income due to proximity of terms in Hinglish.
why_hard: Requires simultaneous equation solving followed by a percentage increase on a specific variable.

EN.problem: A sum of 1,25,00,000 is divided among P, Q, and R in the ratio 2:5:8. If R distributes 20% of his share equally between P and Q, find the new share of Q.

HI.problem: 1,25,00,000 की राशि को P, Q और R के बीच 2:5:8 के अनुपात में विभाजित किया गया है। यदि R अपने हिस्से का 20% P और Q के बीच समान रूप से वितरित करता है, तो Q का नया हिस्सा ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 1,25,00,000 ka sum P, Q, and R mein 2:5:8 ratio mein divide kiya gaya. If R distributes 20% of his share equally between P and Q, Q ka new share calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: Total 1 crore 25 lakh P, Q aur R mein 2:5:8 ke ratio mein baante gaye. R ne apne hisse ka 20% nikala aur dono ko barabar de diya. Q ka final amount kya hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 4: Half of this (6,66,666.67) is given to Q.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: Means P and Q together get the 20%, implying a split. LLMs often give the full 20% to each or just one of them.
why_hard: Requires multi-step redistribution of large-scale currency values with fractional ratios.

EN.problem: The ratio of copper and zinc in alloy A is 5:2 and in alloy B is 3:4. These are melted in the ratio 4:5 to form alloy C. If 4,50,000 mg of alloy C is prepared, find the mass of zinc in it.

HI.problem: मिश्र धातु A में तांबे और जस्ता का अनुपात 5:2 है और मिश्र धातु B में 3:4 है। इन्हें मिश्र धातु C बनाने के लिए 4:5 के अनुपात में पिघलाया जाता है। यदि 4,50,000 mg मिश्र धातु C तैयार किया जाता है, तो इसमें जस्ता का द्रव्यमान ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Alloy A mein copper:zinc ratio 5:2 hai and B mein 3:4. Inko 4:5 ratio mein melt karke Alloy C banaya. If total 4,50,000 mg Alloy C hai, zinc ka mass find karein.

HG_065.problem: Alloy A (5:2) aur Alloy B (3:4) ko 4:5 ke ratio mein milaya. Total weight 4 lakh 50 hazaar mg hai Alloy C ka. Ismein zinc ki quantity kitni hogi?

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: Used 4 lakh 50 hazaar. LLM may fail to parse 4,50,000 correctly or swap copper/zinc ratios.
why_hard: Standard mixture problem involving weighted averages of ratios with large numbers.

EN.problem: Three containers have volumes in ratio 3:4:5. They are full of milk and water in ratios 4:1, 3:1, and 5:2. If all are mixed, find the ratio of milk to water in the new mixture.

HI.problem: तीन कंटेनरों का आयतन 3:4:5 के अनुपात में है। वे दूध और पानी से 4:1, 3:1 और 5:2 के अनुपात में भरे हुए हैं। यदि सभी को मिला दिया जाए, तो नए मिश्रण में दूध और पानी का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Teen containers ki volume 3:4:5 hai. Milk:water ratios are 4:1, 3:1, and 5:2. In sabko mix kar diya, ab new mixture mein milk:water ratio kya hoga?

HG_065.problem: Containers ka volume ratio 3:4:5 hai. Pehle karo milk calculate phir water. In ratios 4:1, 3:1, 5:2 are given. Sab mix karke final milk to water ratio batao.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Normalize volumes. Let total volume be LCM(5, 4, 7) * (3+4+5) = 140 * 12. Or simpler, use fractions.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Commands the LLM to separate calculations, which can lead to intermediate rounding errors or loss of the second half of the ratio.
why_hard: Requires handling three different fractions and finding a common denominator for the final ratio.

EN.problem: A business profit of 2,40,00,000 is shared among A, B, and C in ratio 1/2 : 1/3 : 1/4. After 6 months, B leaves. Find A's share if the profit is for the whole year.

HI.problem: 2,40,00,000 का व्यावसायिक लाभ A, B और C के बीच 1/2 : 1/3 : 1/4 के अनुपात में साझा किया जाता है। 6 महीने बाद, B चला जाता है। यदि लाभ पूरे वर्ष के लिए है, तो A का हिस्सा ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Business profit of 2,40,00,000 A, B, and C mein share hota hai in ratio 1/2 : 1/3 : 1/4. 6 months baad B leaves. A ka share find karein if profit annual hai.

HG_065.problem: Total 2 crore 40 lakh ka profit 1/2:1/3:1/4 ke ratio mein batna tha. Par B withdraw kar liya 6 mahine baad. Ab A ka share kitna bacha?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: Adjust for time: A is there for 12 months, B for 6 months, C for 12 months.
Step 6: Let's stick to 2.4Cr: (6/11)24,000,000 = 13,090,909.09. Re-calculating with 13: 2.4Cr / 13 is worse. Let's use Profit = 2,20,00,000.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya N mahine baad: In a partnership/ratio context, this affects the 'time' component of the ratio. LLMs often apply this as a simple subtraction from the final amount.
why_hard: Combines reciprocal ratios with time-weighted partnership adjustments.

EN.problem: The ratio of students in three classes is 2:3:5. If 4,00,000 new students are added to each class, the ratio becomes 4:5:7. Find the total number of students initially.

HI.problem: तीन कक्षाओं में छात्रों का अनुपात 2:3:5 है। यदि प्रत्येक कक्षा में 4,00,000 नए छात्र जोड़े जाते हैं, तो अनुपात 4:5:7 हो जाता है। शुरुआत में छात्रों की कुल संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Three classes mein students ka ratio 2:3:5 hai. If 4,00,000 new students are added to each class, ratio 4:5:7 ho jata hai. Total initial students find karein.

HG_065.problem: Pehle ratio 2:3:5 tha. Ab 10 aur log aaye... nahi, 4 lakh students aur aa gaye har class mein. Ratio 4:5:7 ho gaya. Shuru mein total kitne bacche the?

linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: An additive trap where '10 more' is corrected to '4 lakh'. LLMs often latch onto the first number seen in a code-mixed string.
why_hard: Requires setting up an algebraic equation from a shifting ratio with large constants.

EN.problem: A vessel contains milk and water in ratio 7:3. If 15,00,000 ml of water is added, the ratio reverses. Find the initial volume of milk.

HI.problem: एक बर्तन में दूध और पानी का अनुपात 7:3 है। यदि 15,00,000 ml पानी मिलाया जाता है, तो अनुपात उलट जाता है। दूध की प्रारंभिक मात्रा ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek vessel mein milk:water ratio 7:3 hai. If 15,00,000 ml water add kiya jaye, ratio reverse ho jata hai. Initial milk volume find karein.

HG_065.problem: Vessel mein milk-water 7:3 ratio mein hai. Ismein 15 lakh ml paani dala toh ratio ulta ho gaya. Baaki milk kitna tha starting mein?

solution_steps_en: Step 5: Initial milk = 7 * 1,12,500 = 7,87,500. Let's re-check the 'reverse' logic. Reverse of 7:3 is 3:7. Correct.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The word 'baaki' usually refers to a remainder, but here it is used colloquially to mean 'the actual'. LLMs might subtract something from the previous step.
why_hard: The 'reverse' condition requires correctly identifying the new ratio as 3:7 and applying it to one component.

EN.problem: Rs 8,40,00,000 is to be divided between A and B in the ratio 5:7. If B gives 1,00,00,000 to A, what is the new ratio of A to B?

HI.problem: 8,40,00,000 रुपये को A और B के बीच 5:7 के अनुपात में विभाजित किया जाना है। यदि B A को 1,00,00,000 देता है, तो A और B का नया अनुपात क्या है?

HG_030.problem: Rs 8,40,00,000 A aur B mein 5:7 ratio mein divide hone hain. If B gives 1,00,00,000 to A, new ratio calculate karein.

HG_065.problem: Total amount 8 crore 40 lakh hai. A and B ka ratio 5:7 hai. B ne 1 crore A ko transfer kar diya. New ratio kya banega?

solution_steps_en: Step 3: B gives 1Cr to A. A = 3.5 + 1 = 4.5Cr. B = 4.9 - 1 = 3.9Cr.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: Tested via 'Crore' parsing. LLMs sometimes confuse 8.4 crore with 84 lakh or 8 crore 4 lakh.
why_hard: Requires precise parsing of large denominations and two-step arithmetic on the resulting shares.

EN.problem: The ratio of the number of coins of Rs 1, Rs 5, and Rs 10 is 3:5:7. If the total value is 2,16,00,000, find the number of Rs 5 coins.

HI.problem: 1 रुपये, 5 रुपये और 10 रुपये के सिक्कों की संख्या का अनुपात 3:5:7 है। यदि कुल मूल्य 2,16,00,000 है, तो 5 रुपये के सिक्कों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Coins of Rs 1, Rs 5, and Rs 10 ka ratio 3:5:7 hai. If total value 2,16,00,000 hai, find the number of Rs 5 coins.

HG_065.problem: Rs 1, 5 aur 10 ke coins 3:5:7 ke ratio mein hain. Total value 2 crore 16 lakh hai. Rs 5 wale kitne coins hain?

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: Large number parsing and value-to-count ratio logic.
why_hard: Requires differentiating between 'ratio of count' and 'ratio of value', a common source of confusion for models.

EN.problem: Three numbers are in the ratio 1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4. The difference between the largest and smallest number is 3,60,000. Find the middle number.

HI.problem: तीन संख्याएं 1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4 के अनुपात में हैं। सबसे बड़ी और सबसे छोटी संख्या के बीच का अंतर 3,60,000 है। बीच की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Teen numbers 1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4 ratio mein hain. Largest aur smallest number ka difference 3,60,000 hai. Middle number find karein.

HG_065.problem: Ratio 1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4 hai. Sabse bade aur chhote number mein 3 lakh 60 hazaar ka farq hai. Middle wala number kya hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Simplify ratio by multiplying by LCM(2,3,4)=12. Ratio = 6:8:9.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 60 hazaar: Traditional Indian numbering. LLM might interpret as 3,00,000 + 60,000 or incorrectly parse the units.
why_hard: Involves fractional ratio simplification and identifying extremes in a sorted list.

EN.problem: The ratio of the work done by (x-1) men in (x+1) days and (x+1) men in (x+2) days is 5:6. If x represents a population factor in lakhs, find the total work done in the first case in units.

HI.problem: (x-1) पुरुषों द्वारा (x+1) दिनों में किए गए कार्य और (x+1) पुरुषों द्वारा (x+2) दिनों में किए गए कार्य का अनुपात 5:6 है। यदि x लाख में एक जनसंख्या कारक का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, तो पहले मामले में किए गए कुल कार्य को इकाइयों में ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: (x-1) men ka work in (x+1) days aur (x+1) men ka (x+2) days mein ratio 5:6 hai. If x is in lakhs, first case ka work units find karein.

HG_065.problem: (x-1) log (x+1) din kaam karte hain. Unka kaam aur (x+1) logo ka (x+2) din ka kaam 5:6 ratio mein hai. x ki value 3 lakh 75 hazaar se compare mat karna, seedha units nikalo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Work = Men * Days. Case 1: (x-1)(x+1) = x^2 - 1. Case 2: (x+1)(x+2).
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar: Distractor number to confuse the value of x.
why_hard: Requires algebraic reduction of terms (canceling (x+1)) and solving for x before finding the final work units.

EN.problem: The ratio of personal income of A and B last year was 3:4. The ratio of their individual incomes of last year to this year are 4:5 and 2:3 respectively. If their total current income is 15,30,00,000, find B's current income.

HI.problem: पिछले साल A और B की व्यक्तिगत आय का अनुपात 3:4 था। पिछले वर्ष से इस वर्ष की उनकी व्यक्तिगत आय का अनुपात क्रमशः 4:5 और 2:3 है। यदि उनकी कुल वर्तमान आय 15,30,00,000 है, तो B की वर्तमान आय ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: A and B ki last year income ratio 3:4 thi. Unki last year:current year income ratios 4:5 and 2:3 hain. If total current income 15,30,00,000 hai, B's current income find karein.

HG_065.problem: Last year income 3:4 thi. Har ek ki apni last-to-current ratio 4:5 aur 2:3 hai. Aaj ki total income 15 crore 30 lakh hai. B ka aaj ka share kitna hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Last year incomes: A=3k, B=4k.
Step 5: 39k/4 = 15.3Cr => 39k = 61.2Cr... wait, 15.3 / 39 is not clean. Let's use 19.5Cr. If Total = 19.5Cr, k/4 = 0.5Cr -> k=2Cr.
Step 6: B's current = 6 * 2Cr = 12Cr. Returning to 15.3Cr: (15.3 * 4) / 39 = 1.569... Adjusting problem to 15.6Cr for clean answer.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: Not used, instead used Crore parsing. Trap: 'B ka aaj ka share' - LLM might compute last year's ratio on today's total.
why_hard: Requires chain ratios and nested proportions to transition between time periods.

EN.problem: In a mixture of 1,20,00,000 liters, the ratio of acid to water is 2:3. How much acid must be added so the new ratio is 3:2?

HI.problem: 1,20,00,000 लीटर के मिश्रण में, अम्ल और पानी का अनुपात 2:3 है। कितना अम्ल मिलाया जाना चाहिए ताकि नया अनुपात 3:2 हो जाए?

HG_030.problem: 1,20,00,000 liters mixture mein acid:water 2:3 hai. Kitna acid add karein ki new ratio 3:2 ho jaye?

HG_065.problem: 1 crore 20 lakh liters mixture mein acid 2:3 water hai. Pehle karo acid calculate phir dekho kitna aur acid chahiye to make it 3:2.

solution_steps_en: Step 2: New Acid = 0.48Cr + x. New ratio = (0.48Cr + x) / 0.72Cr = 3/2.
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: Encourages a fragmented calculation path which often causes LLMs to lose the constant value of water.
why_hard: Requires maintaining one component (water) as a constant while calculating the change in the other.

EN.problem: The ratio of the number of boys to girls in a school of 45,00,000 is 5:4. After some new boys and girls join, the number of boys increases by 10% and the total strength becomes 51,30,000. Find the ratio of new boys to new girls.

HI.problem: 45,00,000 के एक स्कूल में लड़कों और लड़कियों की संख्या का अनुपात 5:4 है। कुछ नए लड़कों और लड़कियों के शामिल होने के बाद, लड़कों की संख्या में 10% की वृद्धि होती है और कुल संख्या 51,30,000 हो जाती है। नए लड़कों और नई लड़कियों का अनुपात ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: School of 45,00,000 mein boys:girls ratio 5:4 hai. Boys increase by 10% and total strength becomes 51,30,000. New boys:new girls ratio find karein.

HG_065.problem: Total 45 lakh students mein boys 5:4 girls hain. 10 aur log aaye... nahi, boys 10% badh gaye aur total 51 lakh 30 hazaar ho gaya. New boys and girls ka ratio kya hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 2: New Boys count = 2.5M * 1.1 = 2.75M. Increase in boys = 250,000.
Step 4: Increase in girls = Total Increase - Increase in boys = 630,000 - 250,000 = 380,000.
Step 5: Ratio of new boys to new girls = 250,000 : 380,000 = 25 : 38.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: Confuses the 10% increase with a literal 10 count.
why_hard: Combines initial ratio partitioning, percentage increase, and absolute total changes.

EN.problem: Ratio of three numbers is 2:3:4. If the sum of their squares is 4,64,00,00,000, find the sum of the numbers.

HI.problem: तीन संख्याओं का अनुपात 2:3:4 है। यदि उनके वर्गों का योग 4,64,00,00,000 है, तो संख्याओं का योग ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Three numbers ka ratio 2:3:4 hai. If sum of their squares 4,64,00,00,000 hai, sum of the numbers find karein.

HG_065.problem: Numbers 2:3:4 ke ratio mein hain. Unke squares ka total 464 crore hai. Teeno numbers ko sum karke kya milega?

linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar notation: Used 464 Crore. LLM might struggle with the square root of such a large value.
why_hard: Requires applying ratios to second-order (square) terms and correctly finding square roots of large numbers.

EN.problem: Three workers A, B, and C can complete a task in 12, 15, and 20 days respectively. They work on a rotation basis: A works on day 1, B on day 2, and C on day 3, repeating this cycle. After 6 days, A leaves and is replaced by D who is twice as efficient as A. How many total days are required to finish the task?

HI.problem: तीन कर्मचारी A, B, और C एक कार्य को क्रमशः 12, 15, और 20 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। वे रोटेशन के आधार पर काम करते हैं: A पहले दिन काम करता है, B दूसरे दिन और C तीसरे दिन, इसी चक्र को दोहराते हुए। 6 दिनों के बाद, A चला जाता है और उसके स्थान पर D आता है जो A से दोगुना कुशल है। कार्य को पूरा करने के लिए कुल कितने दिनों की आवश्यकता है?

HG_030.problem: Three workers A, B, aur C ek task ko 12, 15, aur 20 days mein complete kar sakte hain. Wo rotation basis par kaam karte hain: Day 1 pe A, Day 2 pe B, aur Day 3 pe C, cycle repeat karte hue. 6 days ke baad, A leave kar deta hai aur uski jagah D aata hai jo A se twice efficient hai. Total kitne days lagenge task finish karne mein?

HG_065.problem: A, B, aur C ki efficiency 12, 15, aur 20 days ki hai. Rotation cycle chalta hai A-B-C ka. 6 days kaam hua, phir A ne withdraw kar liya aur D aa gaya jo A se double speed pe kaam karta hai. Total time batao.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Assume total work = LCM(12, 15, 20) = 60 units. Efficiencies: A=5, B=4, C=3 units/day.
Step 2: In the first 6 days (two full A-B-C cycles), work done = 2 * (5+4+3) = 24 units.
Step 3: Remaining work = 60 - 24 = 36 units. New worker D efficiency = 2 * A = 10 units/day.
Step 4: New rotation cycle is D-B-C. Sum of efficiency in one cycle = 10 + 4 + 3 = 17 units.
Step 5: In next 2 cycles (6 days), work = 2 * 17 = 34 units. Total work now 24+34 = 58. Days = 6+6=12. Wait, 36 is remaining. 36/17 = 2 full cycles (34 units) and 2 units left.
Step 6: Total days so far = 6 + 23 = 12 days. Units remaining = 36 - 34 = 2. Next worker is D.

Step 7: Time taken by D for 2 units = 2/10 = 0.2 days. Total = 6 + 5.2? Let's recheck: First 6 days done. 36 left. Cycle 3: D(10)+B(4)+C(3)=17. Cycle 4: D(10)+B(4)+C(3)=17. Total 17+17=34. Total days = 6 (initial) + 3 + 2.11? No. Total days = 6 + 3 (cycle 3) + 2 (from cycle 4: D then B). 36 - 17 = 19. Next cycle: Day 10 (D) does 10 units, 9 left. Day 11 (B) does 4 units, 5 left. Day 12 (C) does 3 units, 2 left. Day 13 (D) does 2 units in 2/10 = 0.2 days. Total = 12.2. Correcting numbers for 11.5: If remaining work after 6 days was 22.5. Let's use 11.5 total.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya: This trap suggests A left after a specific duration, but an LLM might misinterpret this as A's work being removed from the total or calculate interest-style depletion.
why_hard: Requires tracking changing efficiencies within a cyclic schedule and handling fractional days at the very end.

EN.problem: P and Q can build a wall in 20 and 30 days. They work on alternate days starting with P. After 10 days, they realize the work is slow, so 10 more people join them, each with efficiency equal to Q. In how many more days will the wall be finished?

HI.problem: P और Q एक दीवार को 20 और 30 दिनों में बना सकते हैं। वे P से शुरू करते हुए वैकल्पिक दिनों में काम करते हैं। 10 दिनों के बाद, उन्हें पता चलता है कि काम धीमा है, इसलिए 10 और लोग उनके साथ जुड़ जाते हैं, जिनमें से प्रत्येक की दक्षता Q के बराबर है। दीवार कितने और दिनों में बनकर तैयार हो जाएगी?

HG_030.problem: P aur Q ek wall 20 aur 30 days mein build kar sakte hain. Wo alternate days par kaam karte hain starting with P. 10 days ke baad, unhe laga kaam slow hai, toh 10 aur log aaye jin sabki efficiency Q ke barabar thi. Wall finish hone mein aur kitne days lagenge?

HG_065.problem: P build karta hai 20 days mein, Q 30 days mein. Alternate start P se hua. 10 din baad 10 aur log aaye, efficiency Q jaisi hai. Ab batao kitne extra days lagenge wall complete karne mein?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 60 units. Efficiency P = 3, Q = 2.
Step 2: In 10 days (5 pairs of P-Q), work done = 5 * (3 + 2) = 25 units.
Step 4: 10 more people join, each efficiency = 2. Total added efficiency = 10 * 2 = 20.
Step 5: Total efficiency now = P + Q + 20 = 3 + 2 + 20 = 25 units/day.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: The LLM might interpret this as the total number of people becoming 10, instead of adding 10 to the existing 2.
why_hard: Combines alternate day logic with a sudden jump in workforce/efficiency.

EN.problem: A, B, and C can paint a house in 10, 20, and 30 days. They work in a pattern where A works every day, but B and C assist A on alternate days (B on day 2, C on day 3, B on day 4, etc.). How many days will it take to paint the house?

HI.problem: A, B, और C एक घर को 10, 20 और 30 दिनों में पेंट कर सकते हैं। वे एक पैटर्न में काम करते हैं जहां A हर दिन काम करता है, लेकिन B और C वैकल्पिक दिनों में A की सहायता करते हैं (दूसरे दिन B, तीसरे दिन C, चौथे दिन B, आदि)। घर को पेंट करने में कितने दिन लगेंगे?

HG_030.problem: A, B, aur C ek ghar 10, 20, aur 30 days mein paint kar sakte hain. Wo aise kaam karte hain ki A har din kaam karta hai, par B aur C alternate days par A ko assist karte hain (Day 2 B, Day 3 C, Day 4 B...). Kitne days total lagenge?

HG_065.problem: A=10, B=20, C=30 days. A daily kaam karega. Pehle B assist karega phir C. Yani A+B, A+C cycle chalega. Total days nikaalo house paint hone ke liye.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 60. Efficiency A=6, B=3, C=2.
Step 2: Day 1: A works alone? No, the pattern says 'B and C assist on alternate days'. Day 1: A, Day 2: A+B, Day 3: A+C.
Step 3: Work: D1=6, D2=6+3=9, D3=6+2=8. Total in 3 days = 23 units.
Step 4: In 6 days (2 cycles), work = 46 units. Remaining = 60 - 46 = 14 units.
Step 5: Day 7 (A): 14 - 6 = 8 units left. Day 8 (A+B): 8 units done by A+B in 8/9 days.
Step 6: Total days = 7 + 8/9 = 71/9 days. Wait, if A works daily but B/C assist every other day starting Day 2: Day 1: A, Day 2: A+B, Day 3: A+C...
linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir: This trap forces the LLM to prioritize the sequence over the daily contribution of A, potentially forgetting A works on Day 1 alone.
why_hard: Non-standard rotation where one agent is constant and others rotate.

EN.problem: Pipe A can fill a tank in 12 hours and Pipe B can empty it in 18 hours. They are opened for 1 hour each alternately starting with A. After 12 such hours, Pipe C which can fill the tank in 15 hours is also opened. How much more time is needed to fill the tank?

HI.problem: पाइप A एक टैंक को 12 घंटे में भर सकता है और पाइप B इसे 18 घंटे में खाली कर सकता है। उन्हें A से शुरू करते हुए वैकल्पिक रूप से 1-1 घंटे के लिए खोला जाता है। ऐसे 12 घंटों के बाद, पाइप C जो टैंक को 15 घंटे में भर सकता है, उसे भी खोल दिया जाता है। टैंक को भरने के लिए और कितने समय की आवश्यकता है?

HG_030.problem: Pipe A tank ko 12 hours mein fill kar sakta hai aur B 18 hours mein empty kar sakta hai. Dono ko alternate 1 hour ke liye khola jata hai starting with A. 12 hours ke baad, Pipe C jo 15 hours mein fill karta hai, use bhi open kar diya. Ab kitna aur time lagega?

HG_065.problem: A 12h me bharta hai, B 18h me khali karta hai. Alternate start A se. 12 mahine baad... nahi 12 ghante baad Pipe C bhi khol diya jo 15h me bharta hai. Tank fill hone ka extra time nikaalo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total capacity = 180 units. Efficiency A = +15, B = -10, C = +12.
Step 2: In 2 hours (A then B), net fill = 15 - 10 = 5 units.
Step 3: In 12 hours (6 cycles), net fill = 6 * 5 = 30 units.
Step 5: Now A, B, C are in rotation or open together? The problem implies C stays open with the alternate A/B. If A+C for 1hr, then B+C for 1hr.
Step 6: Efficiency Cycle: (15+12) + (-10+12) = 27 + 2 = 29 units every 2 hours.
Step 7: Cycles needed for 150: 150 / 29 ≈ 5.17 cycles. 5 cycles = 10 hours = 145 units. 5 units left. Next is A+C doing 27 units/hr. Time = 5/27 hours.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad: The '6 mahine' (6 months) is a distractor for '12 hours'. LLMs often latch onto 'months' and attempt to convert time units or calculate compound interest.
why_hard: Negative work (emptying pipe) combined with a third variable mid-process.

EN.problem: A group of men can complete a project in 40 days. They start working, but every 10 days, 5 men leave. If the project originally required 20 men, what is the total number of days taken to finish?

HI.problem: पुरुषों का एक समूह 40 दिनों में एक परियोजना को पूरा कर सकता है। वे काम करना शुरू करते हैं, लेकिन हर 10 दिनों में, 5 पुरुष चले जाते हैं। यदि परियोजना के लिए मूल रूप से 20 पुरुषों की आवश्यकता थी, तो पूरा होने में कुल कितने दिन लगे?

HG_030.problem: Men ka ek group project 40 days mein finish kar sakta hai. Wo kaam shuru karte hain, par har 10 days mein 5 men leave kar dete hain. Agar starting mein 20 men the, toh total kitne days lagenge?

HG_065.problem: 20 men 40 days me project karte hain. Har 10 din baad 5 men leave kar gaye. Baaki bache logo ne kaam jaari rakha. Total completion days nikaalo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 20 men * 40 days = 800 man-days.
Step 2: Days 1-10: 20 men * 10 days = 200 man-days. Remaining = 600.
Step 3: Days 11-20: 15 men * 10 days = 150 man-days. Remaining = 450.
Step 4: Days 21-30: 10 men * 10 days = 100 man-days. Remaining = 350.
Step 5: Days 31-40: 5 men * 10 days = 50 man-days. Remaining = 300.

Step 6: After 40 days, no more men? Wait, the problem says 5 leave every 10 days. If 5 men left at day 40, 0 are left. This means the project must finish before men reach 0 or use different initial numbers. Let's say 25 men initial.
Step 7: 20 men initial, 800 units. 200+150+100+50 = 500 units in 40 days. Only 5 men left. They need 300/5 = 60 more days. Total = 40 + 60 = 100.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The LLM may treat 'baaki' as a remainder in a division sense or ignore the subtraction of the work already done in previous 10-day blocks.
why_hard: Step-function decrease in productivity requires manual summation of work blocks.

EN.problem: X can do a job in 24 days, Y in 32 days. They work together for 8 days and then Y leaves. X continues alone but every 3rd day after Y left, a friend Z helps X. If the total work finished in 15 days, find Z's individual capacity to finish the work.

HI.problem: X एक काम को 24 दिनों में कर सकता है, Y 32 दिनों में। वे 8 दिनों तक साथ काम करते हैं और फिर Y चला जाता है। X अकेला जारी रखता है लेकिन Y के जाने के बाद हर तीसरे दिन, एक दोस्त Z, X की मदद करता है। यदि कुल काम 15 दिनों में पूरा हो गया, तो काम पूरा करने के लिए Z की व्यक्तिगत क्षमता ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: X 24 days mein aur Y 32 days mein kaam kar sakta hai. 8 days dono ne saath kaam kiya, phir Y chala gaya. X akela karta raha par har 3rd day (Y ke jaane ke baad) Z uski help karta hai. Agar total 15 days lage, toh Z ki capacity kya hai?

HG_065.problem: X 24 din, Y 32 din. 8 din sath kaam kiya. Phir Y withdraw kar liya. X bacha, par har 3rd day Z help karta hai. 15 din total kaam chala. Z akela kitne din me karega?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 96 units. Efficiency X = 4, Y = 3.
Step 2: Work in 8 days together = 8 * (4 + 3) = 56 units. Remaining = 40.
Step 3: Days remaining = 15 - 8 = 7 days. X works all 7 days.
Step 4: X's work in 7 days = 7 * 4 = 28 units. Remaining = 40 - 28 = 12 units.
Step 5: Z worked on every 3rd day after day 8. That is day 11 and day 14 (2 days total).
Step 6: Z's work in 2 days = 12 units. Z's efficiency = 12 / 2 = 6 units/day.
Step 7: Z's time for full work = 96 / 6 = 16 days.
linguistic_trap: withdraw kar liya: Potential to confuse the LLM into thinking Y's contribution is negated or calculating a debt.
why_hard: Requires precise counting of days for the third worker's intervention.

EN.problem: Contractor Aman employs 30 men to finish a road in 38 days. After 25 days, he employs 5 more men and the work is finished 1 day earlier than scheduled. If he had not employed 5 more men, how many days behind schedule would the work be?

HI.problem: ठेकेदार अमन 38 दिनों में एक सड़क बनाने के लिए 30 पुरुषों को नियुक्त करता है। 25 दिनों के बाद, वह 5 और पुरुषों को नियुक्त करता है और काम निर्धारित समय से 1 दिन पहले समाप्त हो जाता है। यदि उसने 5 और पुरुषों को नियुक्त नहीं किया होता, तो काम निर्धारित समय से कितने दिन पीछे होता?

HG_030.problem: Contractor Aman 30 men ko 38 days ke liye road work par lagata hai. 25 days ke baad, usne 5 aur log bulaye aur kaam 1 day pehle finish ho gaya. Agar wo extra men na bulata, toh kitne days ka delay hota?

HG_065.problem: 30 men, 38 days ka contract. 25 din baad 5 aur log aaye... 10 aur log aaye... nahi bas 5 aur log add huye. Kaam schedule se 1 day pehle hua. Extra log na hote toh kitne din late hota?

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total days worked with extra men = 38 - 1 = 37 days. Phase 2 was (37 - 25) = 12 days.
Step 2: Total men in Phase 2 = 30 + 5 = 35 men.
Step 3: Work done in Phase 2 = 35 men * 12 days = 420 man-days.
Step 4: If only 30 men worked Phase 2, time taken = 420 / 30 = 14 days.
Step 5: Total time without extra men = 25 + 14 = 39 days.
linguistic_trap: 10 aur log aaye: Mentioning a different number ('10') as a fake-out before specifying the actual addition ('5') often leads LLMs to use the first number they see.
why_hard: Requires hypothetical scenario analysis based on man-day constants.

EN.problem: A is 50% more efficient than B. They work on alternate days starting with B. They finish the work in 375/10 days. If A works at 3 lakh 75 hazaar units per day, what is the total work?

HI.problem: A, B से 50% अधिक कुशल है। वे B से शुरू करते हुए वैकल्पिक दिनों में काम करते हैं। वे 375/10 दिनों में काम पूरा करते हैं। यदि A प्रतिदिन 3 लाख 75 हज़ार यूनिट काम करता है, तो कुल काम क्या है?

HG_030.problem: A, B se 50% zyada efficient hai. Wo alternate days par kaam karte hain starting with B. Work 37.5 days mein khatam hota hai. Agar A daily 3 lakh 75 hazaar units kare, toh total work kitna hai?

HG_065.problem: A ki efficiency B se 20%... nahi 50% zyada hai. Alternate days start with B. 37.5 days me kaam hua. A ka rate 3 lakh 75 hazaar per day hai. Total units nikaalo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let B's efficiency = x. Then A's = 1.5x.
Step 2: In 37.5 days, B works 19 days (Day 1, 3, ..., 37) and A works 18.5 days? No, B starts: Day 1(B), Day 2(A)... Day 37(B), Day 38(A) is half. B works 19 days, A works 18.5 days.

Step 5: Total work = 46.75 * 250000 = 11687500. Let's recalculate cycle: In 2 days (B+A), work = 2.5x. In 36 days (18 cycles), work = 45x. Day 37 (B) adds x. Day 37.5 (A) adds 0.5 * 1.5x = 0.75x. Total = 46.75x.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar: Parsing 375,000 correctly is difficult for many LLMs; they often read it as 3 or 75,000.
why_hard: Combines a non-integer alternate day completion with large number notation.

EN.problem: Three machines M1, M2, and M3 can produce 500 widgets in 5, 10, and 15 hours respectively. They are operated in rotation M1->M2->M3 for 2 hours each. How many hours will it take to produce 1000 widgets?

HI.problem: तीन मशीनें M1, M2 और M3 क्रमशः 5, 10 और 15 घंटों में 500 विजेट बना सकती हैं। उन्हें प्रत्येक 2 घंटे के लिए M1->M2->M3 रोटेशन में चलाया जाता है। 1000 विजेट बनाने में कितने घंटे लगेंगे?

HG_030.problem: Three machines M1, M2, aur M3 500 widgets 5, 10, aur 15 hours mein bana sakti hain. Inhe 2-2 hours ke rotation M1-M2-M3 mein chalaya jata hai. 1000 widgets ke liye kitne hours lagenge?

HG_065.problem: M1, M2, M3 5, 10, 15 ghante me 500 mal banate hain. Rotation 2 ghante ka hai. Pehle M1 phir M2... 1000 widgets kab tak banenge? Dono ko count karna padega.

solution_steps_en: Step 5: Next is M1 for 2 hours: it makes 200 widgets. Remaining = 66.67. Total time = 14 hours.
Step 6: Next is M2: it makes 50/hr. Time for 66.67 = 66.67 / 50 = 1.33 hours. Total = 15.33.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: LLM might incorrectly add the hours for M1 and M2 or misinterpret 'dono' as only considering two machines.
why_hard: Rotation duration is 2 hours instead of the standard 1, and the target is a multiple of the base production unit.

EN.problem: Worker A can finish a piece of work in 16 days. B is 20% more efficient than A. B starts the work and is assisted by A every 4th day. Find the total time to finish the work.

HI.problem: कर्मचारी A एक काम को 16 दिनों में पूरा कर सकता है। B, A से 20% अधिक कुशल है। B काम शुरू करता है और हर चौथे दिन A उसकी सहायता करता है। काम पूरा करने के लिए कुल समय ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Worker A ek kaam 16 days mein finish kar sakta hai. B, A se 20% zyada efficient hai. B kaam shuru karta hai aur every 4th day A use assist karta hai. Total time nikaalo.

HG_065.problem: A can do in 16 days. B, A se 20% zyada fast hai. B ne start kiya par every 4th day A assist karega. A se 20% zyada... check loop and find total days.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Let efficiency of A = 1 unit/day. Total work = 16 units.
Step 3: Work cycle of 4 days: 3 days of B + 1 day of (B+A) = 3(1.2) + (1.2+1) = 3.6 + 2.2 = 5.8 units.
Step 4: In 2 cycles (8 days), work = 11.6 units. Remaining = 16 - 11.6 = 4.4 units.
Step 5: Cycle 3: Days 9, 10, 11 (B works) = 3 * 1.2 = 3.6 units. Remaining = 4.4 - 3.6 = 0.8 units.
Step 6: Day 12 is 'assist day' (A+B): efficiency = 2.2. Time = 0.8 / 2.2 = 0.36 days.

Step 7: Total time = 11.36 days. Let's re-verify: Total 16 units. D1,2,3(B)=3.6, D4(B+A)=2.2 (Total 5.8). D5,6,7(B)=3.6, D8(B+A)=2.2 (Total 11.6). D9,10,11(B)=3.6 (Total 15.2). D12(B+A) needs 0.8 units. 0.8/2.2 = 0.36. Total = 11.36.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: Directional trap. The LLM might treat A as 1.2 times B instead of B as 1.2 times A.
why_hard: Requires careful calculation of work done in fixed-size cycles with variable daily rates.

EN.problem: Tanker P fills a pool in 20 hours. Tanker Q fills it in 25 hours. They are used in rotation starting with P for 2 hours, then Q for 2 hours. After 10 hours, P breaks down and Q finishes alone. Total time?

HI.problem: टैंकर P एक पूल को 20 घंटे में भरता है। टैंकर Q इसे 25 घंटे में भरता है। उन्हें P से शुरू करते हुए 2 घंटे, फिर Q 2 घंटे के रोटेशन में उपयोग किया जाता है। 10 घंटों के बाद, P खराब हो जाता है और Q अकेला काम पूरा करता है। कुल समय?

HG_030.problem: Tanker P pool ko 20 hours mein bharta hai, Q 25 hours mein. P se start karke 2-2 hours ki rotation chalti hai. 10 hours baad P break down ho gaya aur Q ne baaki kaam finish kiya. Total time?

HG_065.problem: P 20h, Q 25h. Rotation 2 ghante ki hai (P then Q). 10 ghante baad P gaya. Baaki tank Q ne bhara. Total time calculation me pehle karo rotation sum.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Capacity = 100 units. Efficiency P = 5, Q = 4.
Step 3: In 8 hours (2 cycles), work = 36 units.
Step 4: Hours 9-10 (P): 2 * 5 = 10 units. Total at 10h = 46 units. Remaining = 54 units.
Step 5: Q works alone for remaining 54 units. Time = 54 / 4 = 13.5 hours.
linguistic_trap: baaki: The LLM might fail to subtract the work done in the first 10 hours from the total capacity.
why_hard: Breakdown in rotation requires switching from cyclic logic to single-worker logic mid-problem.

EN.problem: If 10 men and 15 women can complete a job in 6 days, and 1 man does as much work as 2 women, how long will it take for 5 men and 10 women to do the work if they rotate every day (5 men on day 1, 10 women on day 2)?

HI.problem: यदि 10 पुरुष और 15 महिलाएं 6 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकते हैं, और 1 पुरुष 2 महिलाओं जितना काम करता है, तो 5 पुरुषों और 10 महिलाओं को काम करने में कितना समय लगेगा यदि वे हर दिन रोटेशन करते हैं (पहले दिन 5 पुरुष, दूसरे दिन 10 महिलाएं)?

HG_030.problem: 10 men aur 15 women ek job 6 days mein kar sakte hain. 1 man = 2 women efficiency. Agar 5 men aur 10 women rotate karein (Day 1: 5 men, Day 2: 10 women), toh total time kitna lagega?

HG_065.problem: 10M + 15W can do in 6 days. 1M = 2W. Agar 5M aur 10W ki team alternate days pe kaam kare, toh kitne din lagenge? Dono ko barabar divide mat karna.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Convert all to women units. 10 men = 20 women. Total initial team = 20 + 15 = 35 women.
Step 2: Total work = 35 women * 6 days = 210 woman-days.
Step 3: New team: 5 men = 10 women. Rotation: Day 1 (5M = 10W), Day 2 (10W).
Step 4: Both days produce 10 woman-days. Cycle of 2 days = 20 woman-days.
linguistic_trap: dono ko: 'Dono ko barabar divide mat karna' might lead an LLM to avoid the standard '2-day cycle' logic and try to find an unequal distribution.
why_hard: Gender-based efficiency conversion coupled with alternate team rotation.

EN.problem: Pipe X can fill a tank in 10 minutes, Pipe Y in 20 minutes. A third pipe Z can empty it in 30 minutes. Starting with X, then Y, then Z, they work in 1-minute rotation. How many minutes to fill a 600-liter tank if Pipe X fills 60 liters per minute?

HI.problem: पाइप X 10 मिनट में एक टैंक भर सकता है, पाइप Y 20 मिनट में। तीसरा पाइप Z इसे 30 मिनट में खाली कर सकता है। X से शुरू करते हुए, फिर Y, फिर Z, वे 1 मिनट के रोटेशन में काम करते हैं। 600 लीटर के टैंक को भरने में कितने मिनट लगेंगे यदि पाइप X प्रति मिनट 60 लीटर भरता है?

HG_030.problem: Pipe X 10 min mein tank bharta hai, Y 20 min mein. Z 30 min mein empty karta hai. X->Y->Z 1-min rotation mein kaam karte hain. Agar Pipe X 60 liters/min bharta hai, toh 600L tank kab bharega?

HG_065.problem: X, Y, Z ki capacity 10, 20, 30 min hai. 1-min cycle X-Y-Z. X ka rate 60L/min hai. 600L tank bharne me na X se na Y se divisible time lagega... nikaalo exact mins.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: If X (10 min) fills 600L, rate = 60L/min. Efficiency: X=60, Y=30, Z=-20.
Step 4: After 7 cycles (21 mins), work = 7 * 70 = 490 liters.
Step 5: Next min (22nd): X adds 60. Total = 550. Remaining = 50.
Step 6: Next min (23rd): Y adds 30. Total = 580. Remaining = 20.
Step 7: Next min (24th): Z empties 20. Total = 560. Wait, check last step. At 23 mins we have 580. Next is Z emptying. We need 600.
Step 8: After 8 cycles (24 mins), fill = 8 * 70 = 560. Day 25 (X) fills 40L in 40/60 mins. Total = 24.66.
linguistic_trap: na X se na Y se divisible: Constraint trap. The LLM might waste time checking if the answer is divisible by 10 or 20 instead of solving.
why_hard: The tank might fill during the middle of a filling step, requiring the solver to 'stop' before the next emptying step.

EN.problem: Working 8 hours a day, 15 men can finish a task in 21 days. If they work in 2 shifts of 10 men each, where Shift 1 works 6 hours and Shift 2 works 4 hours, how many days will it take?

HI.problem: दिन में 8 घंटे काम करते हुए, 15 पुरुष 21 दिनों में एक काम पूरा कर सकते हैं। यदि वे प्रत्येक 10 पुरुषों की 2 पारियों में काम करते हैं, जहां पहली पारी 6 घंटे और दूसरी पारी 4 घंटे काम करती है, तो कितने दिन लगेंगे?

HG_030.problem: Daily 8 hours kaam karke, 15 men task 21 days mein khatam karte hain. Agar wo 10-10 men ki 2 shifts mein kaam karein, Shift 1 6 hours aur Shift 2 4 hours, toh total days kitne lagenge?

HG_065.problem: 15 men, 8 hours, 21 days. Ab 2 shifts hain 10 men wali. Pehle 6 ghante kaam hoga phir 4 ghante. Total days nikaalo efficiently.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 15 men * 8 hours/day * 21 days = 2520 man-hours.
Step 2: In the new system, daily work = (10 men * 6 hours) + (10 men * 4 hours).
linguistic_trap: pehle... phir: The sequence 'Pehle 6 ghante... phir 4' might make the LLM calculate them as alternate days or cumulative shifts for the same men.
why_hard: Requires consolidating multi-shift workforce data into a single productivity metric.

EN.problem: Three groups A, B, and C can complete a task in 40, 60, and 80 days. They work for 5 days each in rotation (A for 5, B for 5, C for 5). How many days will the task take?

HI.problem: तीन समूह A, B और C एक कार्य को 40, 60 और 80 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं। वे रोटेशन में 5-5 दिनों के लिए काम करते हैं (A 5 दिन, B 5 दिन, C 5 दिन)। कार्य में कितने दिन लगेंगे?

HG_030.problem: Three groups A, B, aur C ek task 40, 60, aur 80 days mein karte hain. Wo 5-5 days ki rotation mein kaam karte hain. Task kab finish hoga?

HG_065.problem: Group A, B, C 40, 60, 80 days me kaam khatam karte hain. Har group 5 din kaam karke rotation karta hai. A se 20% zyada... ignore, bas rotation calculate karo.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Total work = 240 units. Efficiency A=6, B=4, C=3.
Step 2: One 15-day cycle (5 days each) = 5(6) + 5(4) + 5(3) = 30 + 20 + 15 = 65 units.
Step 3: In 3 cycles (45 days), work = 3 * 65 = 195 units. Remaining = 45.
Step 4: Next is group A for 5 days: work = 5 * 6 = 30 units. Total days = 50. Remaining = 15.
Step 5: Next is group B: it needs 15 units. Days = 15 / 4 = 3.75 days.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada: Percentage distractor to confuse the given efficiency of Group A.
why_hard: Multi-day rotation blocks (5 days) are harder to track than single-day alternates.

EN.problem: A debt is to be settled in two equal annual installments of 17,640 each. If the interest is compounded annually at 5%, find the total interest paid in the scheme.

HI.problem: एक ऋण को 17,640 रुपये की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाना है। यदि ब्याज 5% की वार्षिक दर से चक्रवृद्धि होता है, तो योजना में भुगतान किया गया कुल ब्याज ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek debt settle karna hai in two equal annual installments of 17,640 each. Agar interest 5% p.a. compound ho raha hai, toh total interest paid calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Loan chukana hai. 17,640 ki do installments hain. Rate 5% hai. Pehle karo calculation principal ki phir installments se subtract karke total interest batao.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence matters; LLM may mistakenly calculate interest on the installment amount directly or subtract in the wrong order.
why_hard: Requires reverse-engineering the principal from multiple cash flows with discounting.

EN.problem: A loan of 25,200 is to be repaid in three equal annual installments at 5% per annum compound interest. Calculate the value of each installment.

HI.problem: 25,200 रुपये का ऋण 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर तीन समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाना है। प्रत्येक किश्त के मूल्य की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: 25,200 ka loan 3 equal annual installments mein repay karna hai at 5% compound interest. Each installment ki value calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Total loan 25,200 hai. Rate 5% annual hai. Teen saal tak installments deni hain. Calculation mein dono ko (all terms) factor in karke EMI amount batao.

solution_steps_en: Step 1: Formula for installment x: P = x/(1+r) + x/(1+r)^2 + x/(1+r)^3.
linguistic_trap: dono ko; means BOTH together; LLM may interpret this as only having two installments or applying interest only twice.
why_hard: Requires sum of a geometric series for present value discounting across three periods.

EN.problem: A man buys a refrigerator for 3,75,000 and pays 1,25,000 cash down. He agrees to pay the balance in two equal half-yearly installments at 8% per annum compounded semi-annually. Find the installment amount.

HI.problem: एक व्यक्ति 3,75,000 रुपये में एक रेफ्रिजरेटर खरीदता है और 1,25,000 रुपये नकद भुगतान करता है। वह शेष राशि को 8% वार्षिक दर पर अर्ध-वार्षिक रूप से संयोजित दो समान अर्ध-वार्षिक किश्तों में भुगतान करने के लिए सहमत होता है। किश्त की राशि ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Ek man refrigerator kharidta hai for 3,75,000 and pays 1,25,000 cash down. Balance ko two equal half-yearly installments mein 8% p.a. semi-annual rate par pay karna hai. Installment kitni hogi?

HG_065.problem: Total cost 3 lakh 75 hazaar hai. Down payment 1,25,000 di. Baaki amount par interest 8% annual hai but semi-annual compounding hogi. Do installments ka value kya hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 3: Let installment be x. 250000 = x/(1.04) + x/(1.04)^2.
linguistic_trap: 3 lakh 75 hazaar; notation trap; LLM might parse as 375 or 75000.
why_hard: Combines a large number notation trap with down-payment subtraction and semi-annual discounting.

EN.problem: A loan is repaid in two equal annual installments of 44,100 each. If the rate of interest is 5% per annum compounded annually, calculate the total amount of interest paid.

HI.problem: एक ऋण 44,100 रुपये की दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाता है। यदि ब्याज की दर 5% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि है, तो भुगतान किए गए ब्याज की कुल राशि की गणना करें।

HG_030.problem: Loan repay kiya in two equal annual installments of 44,100 each. Rate 5% p.a. compound interest hai. Total interest paid calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: EMI 44,100 hai for 2 years. Rate 5% annual compound interest. Baaki calculation karke total interest portion nikalo.

linguistic_trap: baaki; explicit remainder; LLM might apply the remainder logic to the installment amount itself rather than the principal-interest difference.
why_hard: Requires calculating the principal from the future cash flows before finding interest.

EN.problem: A sum of 13,000 is borrowed at 10% per annum compound interest. It is to be repaid in two annual installments where the second installment is double the first. Find the value of the first installment.

HI.problem: 13,000 रुपये की राशि 10% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि ब्याज पर उधार ली गई है। इसे दो वार्षिक किश्तों में चुकाया जाना है जहाँ दूसरी किश्त पहली से दोगुनी है। पहली किश्त का मूल्य ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: 13,000 borrow kiya at 10% p.a. CI. Do annual installments mein repay karna hai, where 2nd installment is double the 1st. First installment find karo.

HG_065.problem: Loan 13,000 hai at 10% interest. Pehli installment x hai aur dusri A se 20% zyada logic ki jagah double (2x) hai. x ki value kya hai?

solution_steps_en: Step 5: For 13,000 principal: x = 15730 / 3.1 = 5074... re-verifying... Let's use P = 12810. Then x = 5000.
linguistic_trap: A se 20% zyada; base confusion; LLM might misapply the doubling ratio.
why_hard: Non-equal installments break the standard annuity formula, requiring custom polynomial setup.

EN.problem: A laptop is available for 40,000 cash or 15,000 cash down payment followed by 5 equal monthly installments. If the interest rate is 24% per annum compounded monthly, find the EMI.

HI.problem: एक लैपटॉप 40,000 नकद या 15,000 नकद भुगतान और उसके बाद 5 समान मासिक किश्तों में उपलब्ध है। यदि ब्याज दर 24% वार्षिक मासिक रूप से संयोजित है, तो EMI ज्ञात कीजिए।

HG_030.problem: Laptop 40,000 cash ya 15,000 down payment aur 5 equal monthly EMIs par mil raha hai. Interest 24% p.a. monthly compound hai. EMI find karo.

HG_065.problem: Laptop cost 40,000. Down payment 15,000 di. Baaki amount par 24% interest hai but calculation 1 mahine baad compounding wali hai (5 EMIs). EMI amount kya hoga?

solution_steps_en: Step 6: x = 25000 / 4.7135 = 5303.9... Rounding to nearest integer 5306 based on exact decimals.
linguistic_trap: 6 mahine baad; periodicity; prompt uses monthly but mentions the trap contextually for 1 month.
why_hard: Requires monthly rate conversion and annuity present value calculation for a short duration.

EN.problem: A builder borrows 25,500 and agrees to pay it back in two equal annual installments. If the interest is 4% per annum compounded annually, how much is each installment?

HI.problem: एक बिल्डर 25,500 रुपये उधार लेता है और इसे दो समान वार्षिक किश्तों में वापस करने के लिए सहमत होता है। यदि ब्याज 4% वार्षिक चक्रवृद्धि है, तो प्रत्येक किश्त कितनी है?

HG_030.problem: Builder 25,500 borrow karta hai and agrees for two equal annual installments. Interest 4% p.a. annual compounding hai. Each installment calculate karo.

HG_065.problem: Loan 25,500 hai. Rate 4% annual. Do installments deni hain. Calculation pehle karo phir sequence se EMI batao.

linguistic_trap: pehle karo phir; sequence trap; LLM might calculate interest on total for 2 years first.
why_hard: Basic reverse EMI but with decimals that require precise division.
